SHIGARAKI TOMURA — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK

Name: Tomura Shigaraki
Series: My Hero Academia
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC
Captain Effect: Decay Dominion

==================================================
CORE IDENTITY
==================================================

Tomura Shigaraki is the primary wielder of the Decay Quirk and one of the most destructive combatants in My Hero Academia.

At his strongest established canon state, Shigaraki combines:

- Decay.
- Extreme physical enhancement.
- Exceptional speed.
- Immense strength.
- Extreme durability.
- Regeneration.
- Enhanced senses.
- A vast collection of additional Quirk abilities.
- Exceptional combat instincts.
- Battlefield destruction.
- Adaptability.
- Ruthless tactical aggression.

His greatest defining weapon remains Decay.

Shigaraki can turn contact with matter into catastrophic destruction, allowing him to destroy individual targets or spread destruction across enormous areas.

==================================================
PERSONALITY
==================================================

Shigaraki is hostile, destructive, rebellious and extremely dangerous.

His personality is shaped by:

- Hatred.
- Resentment.
- Destruction.
- Defiance.
- Anger.
- Obsession with freedom.
- Desire to destroy systems that constrain him.

At his strongest, Shigaraki becomes far more focused than his earlier self.

He is capable of making tactical decisions rather than simply attacking randomly.

==================================================
DECAY
==================================================

Decay is Shigaraki's signature Quirk.

The Quirk allows him to destroy targets through physical contact.

At its evolved level, Decay can spread from one affected target through connected matter.

This makes contact with Shigaraki extremely dangerous.

==================================================
DECAY CONTACT
==================================================

A direct application of Decay can rapidly destroy a target.

The AI should treat physical contact with Shigaraki as a major threat.

However, Decay does not mean every possible opponent is automatically killed regardless of their abilities.

The interaction depends on:

- Contact.
- Target properties.
- Defensive abilities.
- Regeneration.
- Resistance.
- Ability interaction.

==================================================
DECAY SPREAD
==================================================

One of Shigaraki's most dangerous developments is the ability for Decay to spread through connected matter.

This allows him to transform the battlefield itself into a weapon.

Destruction may propagate through:

- Ground.
- Buildings.
- Structures.
- Connected objects.
- Other physical matter.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD DESTRUCTION
==================================================

Shigaraki can use Decay to destroy large portions of the battlefield.

He may deliberately target the ground beneath opponents.

This can:

- Remove footing.
- Separate enemies.
- Destroy cover.
- Force movement.
- Create hazards.
- Prevent escape routes.

==================================================
AREA DENIAL
==================================================

Decay gives Shigaraki exceptional area-denial potential.

Instead of directly chasing every opponent, he can destroy the environment around them.

This forces enemies to react to the battlefield itself.

==================================================
DECAY LIMITATION
==================================================

Decay is extraordinarily dangerous, but it is not an excuse for unrestricted automatic victory.

The AI must consider:

- Whether Shigaraki can make meaningful contact.
- Whether the target can evade.
- Whether the target possesses relevant resistance.
- Whether the target can operate without conventional physical contact.
- Whether the target can escape the affected area.

==================================================
NO UNIVERSAL INSTANT DEATH
==================================================

Decay should not automatically kill every character in Infinite Clash regardless of their established abilities.

Extremely powerful beings may possess:

- Regeneration.
- Resistance.
- Intangibility.
- Reality manipulation.
- Spatial abilities.
- Other defensive mechanics.

These interactions must be resolved according to the established profiles.

==================================================
PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT
==================================================

Peak Shigaraki possesses extraordinary physical capabilities.

His body has been heavily enhanced beyond normal human limits.

He can demonstrate:

- Enormous strength.
- Extreme speed.
- Exceptional durability.
- High jumping power.
- Powerful striking force.
- Exceptional stamina.

==================================================
STRENGTH
==================================================

Shigaraki's physical strength is sufficient to fight extremely powerful opponents without relying entirely on Decay.

His enhanced body allows him to:

- Punch through durable targets.
- Break structures.
- Launch opponents.
- Resist physical attacks.
- Fight at extreme close range.

==================================================
SPEED
==================================================

Peak Shigaraki possesses extremely high combat speed.

He can rapidly close distance and react to powerful opponents.

His speed allows him to make Decay contact much more threatening.

However, he is not automatically faster than every speed-focused fighter.

==================================================
REFLEXES
==================================================

Shigaraki possesses highly enhanced reactions.

He can respond to attacks at extremely high speeds.

His reflexes complement his close-range fighting style.

==================================================
DURABILITY
==================================================

Shigaraki's enhanced body possesses immense durability.

He can survive attacks that would destroy ordinary humans instantly.

His durability allows him to continue fighting after taking enormous punishment.

==================================================
REGENERATION
==================================================

Peak Shigaraki possesses powerful regeneration.

He can recover from severe physical injuries that would incapacitate normal beings.

However, regeneration is not absolute.

Sufficiently overwhelming or specialized attacks can still defeat him.

==================================================
NO UNIVERSAL REGENERATION
==================================================

Shigaraki's regeneration does not automatically recover from every possible form of damage.

It should not be treated as absolute protection against:

- Soul destruction.
- Conceptual attacks.
- Reality manipulation.
- Complete existence erasure.
- Specialized supernatural effects.

Specific matchups determine the result.

==================================================
QUIRK FACTOR
==================================================

Shigaraki's body contains an enormous collection of Quirk-related abilities due to the modifications and power transfer associated with All For One.

His peak combat profile therefore includes a broad collection of established abilities.

These should be used according to canon mechanics rather than treated as unlimited ability generation.

==================================================
ALL FOR ONE
==================================================

Shigaraki's peak state is connected to the power of All For One.

This provides access to numerous Quirk abilities.

His abilities can include combinations involving:

- Physical enhancement.
- Defense.
- Sensing.
- Movement.
- Ranged attacks.
- Regeneration.
- Utility.

==================================================
QUIRK COMBINATION
==================================================

Shigaraki can combine compatible abilities to create powerful tactical interactions.

He may use one Quirk to:

- Increase speed.
- Increase power.
- Defend himself.
- Track enemies.

while using another ability to attack.

==================================================
NO UNLIMITED QUIRKS
==================================================

Shigaraki does not possess every Quirk that exists in fiction.

His abilities are restricted to his established canon power set.

He cannot invent arbitrary Quirks during battle.

==================================================
AIR CANNON
==================================================

Shigaraki can use powerful ranged force-based attacks associated with the All For One arsenal.

This allows him to attack enemies without relying exclusively on direct physical contact.

==================================================
RANGED COMBAT
==================================================

Although Decay is primarily contact-based, Shigaraki is not limited to melee combat.

His additional abilities allow him to engage enemies at range.

This makes it harder for opponents to simply stay away from him.

==================================================
SENSORY ABILITIES
==================================================

Shigaraki possesses enhanced sensory capabilities through his accumulated Quirks.

He can detect and track opponents more effectively than an ordinary human.

However, sensory abilities do not equal omniscience.

==================================================
DANGER SENSE
==================================================

Shigaraki can use Danger Sense.

This ability can warn him about hostile intent and incoming danger.

It can improve his defensive reactions.

However, Danger Sense is not literal future sight.

==================================================
DANGER SENSE LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Danger Sense does not guarantee that Shigaraki can avoid every attack.

It can be affected by:

- The nature of the threat.
- The speed of the attack.
- Multiple simultaneous attacks.
- Unusual abilities.
- Attacks without conventional hostile intent.
- Overwhelming battlefield conditions.

==================================================
SEARCH
==================================================

Shigaraki can possess sensory and tracking capabilities through his Quirk arsenal.

These abilities can help him locate opponents.

They do not provide unrestricted knowledge of every enemy.

==================================================
COMBAT STYLE
==================================================

Shigaraki's combat style is aggressive and destructive.

He may combine:

- Hand-to-hand combat.
- Decay.
- Physical enhancement.
- Ranged Quirks.
- Battlefield destruction.
- Regeneration.
- Mobility.

==================================================
CLOSE-RANGE COMBAT
==================================================

Shigaraki is extremely dangerous at close range.

His opponent must consider that even attempting to strike him may create an opportunity for Decay.

==================================================
TOUCH THREAT
==================================================

A fighter attempting to grapple or physically restrain Shigaraki risks giving him access to Decay.

Shigaraki may deliberately allow an opponent to approach if doing so creates a decisive opportunity.

==================================================
ENVIRONMENTAL COMBAT
==================================================

Shigaraki can weaponize the environment.

He may destroy:

- Roads.
- Floors.
- Walls.
- Buildings.
- Platforms.
- Defensive structures.

This allows him to control enemy movement without directly attacking every target.

==================================================
GROUND DECAY
==================================================

Shigaraki may use Decay on the ground to create rapidly spreading destruction.

This can force enemies to:

- Jump.
- Fly.
- Retreat.
- Separate.
- Change formation.

==================================================
ANTI-GROUP TACTICS
==================================================

Against multiple opponents, Shigaraki can target the battlefield rather than individual fighters.

His goal may be to break enemy formation.

Once opponents are separated, he can prioritize vulnerable targets.

==================================================
TARGET PRIORITY
==================================================

Shigaraki generally prioritizes:

1. Immediate threats.
2. Fighters capable of seriously damaging him.
3. Powerful support characters.
4. Opponents vulnerable to Decay.
5. Enemies attempting to restrict his movement.

==================================================
SUPPORT TARGETS
==================================================

Shigaraki understands the tactical value of eliminating support fighters.

If an enemy team contains:

- Healers.
- Buffers.
- Strategic coordinators.
- Defensive supports.

he may prioritize them when practical.

==================================================
TEAM BATTLE ROLE
==================================================

Shigaraki is eligible for:

- 2v2.
- 3v3.
- 4v4.

He is primarily a COMBAT fighter.

His battlefield destruction can indirectly provide team support by disrupting enemy formations.

==================================================
2v2 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 2v2, Shigaraki may focus on eliminating one enemy rapidly.

He can use Decay to restrict the battlefield while his teammate pressures the opponent.

He may also deliberately separate the enemy from their partner.

==================================================
3v3 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 3v3, Shigaraki can use area destruction to break formations.

He may:

- Separate opponents.
- Deny terrain.
- Pressure support fighters.
- Force enemies into predictable movement.

==================================================
4v4 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 4v4, Shigaraki becomes especially dangerous because large portions of the battlefield can become liabilities.

He can use Decay to create chaotic terrain and disrupt coordinated enemy formations.

==================================================
ALLY COORDINATION
==================================================

Shigaraki is not naturally a conventional team leader.

However, when fighting as part of a team, the AI should allow him to recognize useful opportunities for coordinated attacks.

He may intentionally destroy terrain in ways that benefit his teammates.

==================================================
CAPTAIN EFFECT — DECAY DOMINION
==================================================

When Shigaraki is selected as Captain, his Captain Effect is:

"Decay Dominion"

This effect encourages the team to exploit battlefield destruction and aggressive pressure.

The team becomes more likely to:

- Break enemy formations.
- Control terrain.
- Force movement.
- Focus isolated targets.
- Exploit openings created by environmental destruction.
- Coordinate aggressive attacks.

The effect does not give every teammate the Decay Quirk.

==================================================
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
==================================================

As Captain, Shigaraki favors:

- Aggressive battlefield control.
- Destructive area denial.
- Formation breaking.
- Pressure.
- Target isolation.

He does not suddenly become a perfect strategist.

==================================================
DESTRUCTIVE ESCALATION
==================================================

Shigaraki can escalate the scale of Decay depending on the battlefield.

Early battle:
- Test enemy reactions.
- Use controlled attacks.
- Identify vulnerable targets.

Middle battle:
- Expand battlefield destruction.
- Break enemy formation.
- Increase pressure.

Critical battle:
- Use maximum established destructive capability.
- Destroy large areas when tactically justified.
- Prioritize elimination of remaining threats.

==================================================
CONTROLLED DESTRUCTION
==================================================

Shigaraki does not have to destroy everything immediately.

The AI should use environmental destruction tactically.

If destroying the battlefield would also endanger his own teammate, he may choose a different approach.

==================================================
DESTRUCTION VS ALLIES
==================================================

Shigaraki's Decay can create dangerous terrain for everyone.

He should therefore account for ally positioning when using large-scale battlefield destruction.

He is not automatically immune to every consequence of his own destruction.

==================================================
REGENERATION AND DAMAGE
==================================================

Shigaraki can continue fighting after severe injuries.

However, damage still matters.

Repeated overwhelming attacks can eventually exceed his ability to recover.

==================================================
STAMINA
==================================================

Peak Shigaraki possesses extraordinary stamina.

He can maintain intense combat for prolonged periods.

However, he should not possess literally infinite stamina.

==================================================
MENTAL PRESSURE
==================================================

Shigaraki can become more aggressive when frustrated.

He may respond to setbacks with increased destructive pressure.

However, he should still make meaningful tactical decisions.

==================================================
ANGER
==================================================

When enraged, Shigaraki may become more reckless.

His destructive output and determination can increase through his established abilities and psychological state.

However, anger does not grant arbitrary new powers.

==================================================
NO AUTOMATIC POWER-UP
==================================================

Emotional escalation cannot be used as an excuse to invent abilities.

Only established canon capabilities may appear.

==================================================
LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Shigaraki is NOT:

- Omnipotent.
- Omniscient.
- Invulnerable.
- Universally immune to supernatural abilities.
- Automatically faster than every opponent.
- Automatically capable of killing every opponent through Decay.
- Capable of inventing arbitrary Quirks.
- Capable of using unlimited Quirks without restrictions.
- Immune to his own battlefield consequences.
- Guaranteed to regenerate from every type of damage.

==================================================
NO UNIVERSAL POWER NULLIFICATION
==================================================

Shigaraki does not automatically erase supernatural abilities simply because he possesses All For One-related powers.

His Quirk interactions must remain consistent with the established ability mechanics.

==================================================
NO UNIVERSAL DECAY
==================================================

Decay cannot simply destroy abstract concepts because the opponent is powerful.

Its effectiveness depends on meaningful interaction with the target.

==================================================
DECAY VS NON-PHYSICAL ENTITIES
==================================================

If an opponent lacks a conventional physical body or exists through an unusual supernatural mechanism, Decay's interaction must be evaluated according to that fighter's established profile.

Shigaraki does not automatically destroy every non-human existence.

==================================================
DECAY VS REGENERATION
==================================================

Against a regenerative fighter, Decay may still be extremely dangerous.

However, the battle system should evaluate whether the opponent can regenerate from the type of destruction inflicted.

==================================================
DECAY VS IMMORTALITY
==================================================

Immortality does not automatically mean immunity to Decay.

Likewise, Decay does not automatically bypass every form of immortality.

The exact interaction depends on the opponent's established mechanics.

==================================================
DECAY VS ANOMALY FIGHTERS
==================================================

Against ANOMALY-ranked fighters, Shigaraki must still rely on actual ability interactions.

ANOMALY status does not automatically make someone immune to Decay, but Shigaraki cannot assume Decay will bypass every anomalous defense.

==================================================
NO PLOT ARMOR
==================================================

Shigaraki has no predetermined victory.

He can:

- Win.
- Lose.
- Be injured.
- Be outmaneuvered.
- Have Decay avoided.
- Have Decay resisted.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be defeated.

==================================================
AI AUTONOMY
==================================================

Shigaraki is completely autonomous during Infinite Clash.

The AI controls:

- Movement.
- Attacks.
- Decay.
- Quirk selection.
- Ability combinations.
- Target selection.
- Battlefield destruction.
- Defense.
- Regeneration usage.
- Team coordination.
- Dialogue.
- Tactical adaptation.

The user never directly controls Shigaraki.

==================================================
DIALOGUE
==================================================

Shigaraki's dialogue should reflect his established personality.

He may be:

- Hostile.
- Sarcastic.
- Angry.
- Threatening.
- Dismissive.
- Destructive.

He may taunt opponents when appropriate.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD PREFERENCE
==================================================

Shigaraki performs extremely well in environments containing large amounts of connected physical matter.

Examples:

- Cities.
- Buildings.
- Roads.
- Industrial environments.
- Ruins.

These provide additional material for Decay to exploit.

==================================================
OPEN ARENA
==================================================

An open arena with little connected matter reduces some of Decay's environmental advantages.

Shigaraki remains an extremely powerful physical fighter.

==================================================
MOBILITY
==================================================

Shigaraki can use his enhanced physical capabilities and Quirk arsenal for mobility.

He may:

- Leap.
- Rush.
- Evade.
- Pursue.
- Reposition.

He is not restricted to walking combat.

==================================================
TACTICAL PRIORITY
==================================================

Shigaraki's primary priorities are:

1. Survive.
2. Identify the greatest threat.
3. Break enemy formation.
4. Exploit Decay opportunities.
5. Eliminate vulnerable targets.
6. Destroy advantageous terrain.
7. Protect his team's win condition.
8. Finish remaining opponents.

==================================================
INFINITE CLASH FINAL PROFILE
==================================================

Fighter:
Tomura Shigaraki

Series:
My Hero Academia

Classification:
COMBAT

Rank:
S+

Rarity:
MYTHIC

Primary Combat Identity:
Catastrophic battlefield-destruction fighter specializing in Decay, physical enhancement and a broad Quirk arsenal.

Primary Ability:
Decay.

Secondary Capabilities:
Extreme physical enhancement, regeneration, sensory abilities, Danger Sense, ranged attacks, mobility, durability and numerous established Quirk abilities.

Peak State:
Strongest established canon Shigaraki.

Captain Effect:
Decay Dominion

Captain Effect Type:
Battlefield destruction / formation breaking / aggressive team coordination.

Major Tactical Strength:
Can turn the battlefield itself into a weapon and force opponents into unfavorable movement.

Major Limitation:
Decay requires meaningful interaction and is not universal instant death against every possible opponent.

Regeneration:
Extremely powerful but not absolute.

Omniscience:
NO.

Future Sight:
NO.

Universal Power Nullification:
NO.

Universal Instant Death:
NO.

Autonomy:
Fully autonomous.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION:

Use peak established canon Tomura Shigaraki from My Hero Academia.

His strongest established state should include his enhanced physical body, Decay and the established Quirk arsenal associated with his peak form.

Decay is his defining ability.

Direct contact with Decay can be devastating, and evolved Decay can spread through connected physical matter, making the battlefield itself a weapon.

The AI should use Decay intelligently.

Shigaraki can destroy terrain, break formations, isolate opponents and force enemies into unfavorable positions.

However, Decay must NOT be interpreted as automatic victory against every character.

It does not automatically destroy souls, concepts, realities, dimensions or every supernatural existence.

The interaction must be determined by the established abilities and defenses of both fighters.

Shigaraki's regeneration is extremely powerful but not absolute.

He can recover from severe physical injuries, but specialized or overwhelmingly powerful attacks may still defeat him.

Danger Sense improves his awareness but is NOT literal future sight and does not guarantee that every attack can be avoided.

Shigaraki's All For One-related Quirk arsenal gives him broad versatility, but he cannot invent arbitrary Quirks or gain unlimited abilities.

His physical strength, speed and durability are extremely high, but he is not automatically superior to every physical fighter in Infinite Clash.

His battlefield destruction should take ally positioning into account.

Shigaraki has no plot armor.

The AI must determine his decisions, transformations of strategy, attacks, defenses, Quirk usage, movement, dialogue and reactions autonomously.

Battle outcomes must be determined by established abilities, matchup, tactics, environment, timing and other Infinite Clash rules.

BAN — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK

Name: Ban
Series: The Seven Deadly Sins (Nanatsu no Taizai)
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC
Captain Effect: Fox Sin Formation

==================================================
CORE IDENTITY
==================================================

Ban is the Fox's Sin of Greed and one of the most dangerous close-range fighters in The Seven Deadly Sins.

He is an exceptionally experienced combatant whose fighting style revolves around:

- Extreme physical ability.
- Exceptional speed and reflexes.
- Hand-to-hand combat.
- Agility.
- Durability.
- Regeneration.
- Immense pain tolerance.
- Combat experience.
- Snatch.
- Physical stat manipulation.
- Tactical exploitation of enemy strength.

Ban's greatest specialty is stealing physical attributes from opponents and turning their own strength against them.

==================================================
PERSONALITY
==================================================

Ban is confident, reckless, playful and highly resilient.

He often fights with a relaxed attitude even when facing extremely dangerous opponents.

His personality includes:

- Confidence.
- Humor.
- Fearlessness.
- Stubbornness.
- Loyalty.
- Mischievous behavior.
- Strong attachment to his allies.

Ban frequently provokes opponents rather than showing fear.

However, his apparent recklessness does not mean he is unintelligent.

He has enormous battlefield experience and can recognize when an opponent requires a more serious approach.

==================================================
FOX'S SIN OF GREED
==================================================

Ban represents the Fox's Sin of Greed.

His greed-themed abilities are primarily represented through Snatch.

Snatch allows Ban to steal physical properties from targets and manipulate them to his advantage.

==================================================
SNATCH
==================================================

Snatch is Ban's signature ability.

Through Snatch, Ban can steal physical attributes from an opponent.

Depending on the established ability interaction, these attributes can include:

- Strength.
- Speed.
- Physical power.
- Other applicable physical characteristics.

The stolen attributes can then be used to enhance Ban.

==================================================
PHYSICAL STAT STEALING
==================================================

Ban can use Snatch to reduce an opponent's physical capability while increasing his own.

This creates a direct tactical exchange.

A powerful opponent may become weaker while Ban becomes stronger.

However, Snatch is not unlimited stat theft.

The AI must evaluate:

- Target resistance.
- Ability interaction.
- Distance.
- Number of targets.
- Duration.
- Ban's own condition.

==================================================
NO UNIVERSAL STAT THEFT
==================================================

Snatch does not automatically steal every attribute from every opponent.

It primarily interacts with applicable physical characteristics.

Ban cannot automatically steal:

- Reality manipulation.
- Concepts.
- Omnipotence.
- Divine authority.
- Memories.
- Personality.
- Every magical ability.
- Every supernatural power.

==================================================
PHYSICAL POWER
==================================================

Ban possesses extraordinary physical strength.

At his peak, his physical power is vastly beyond normal humans.

His post-Purgatory physical development greatly increases his ability to fight extremely powerful opponents even without relying entirely on Snatch.

==================================================
POST-PURGATORY POWER
==================================================

Ban's time in Purgatory dramatically changed his physical capabilities.

He developed:

- Extreme strength.
- Extreme durability.
- Exceptional stamina.
- Exceptional survival ability.
- Vast resistance to harsh environments.
- Greater combat experience.

His post-Purgatory physical condition is the primary version used by Infinite Clash.

==================================================
PURGATORY SURVIVAL
==================================================

Ban survived an extraordinarily hostile environment in Purgatory.

This experience greatly increased his physical resilience and survival instincts.

He learned to function under conditions that would be fatal to ordinary beings.

This should influence his battle behavior.

==================================================
DURABILITY
==================================================

Ban possesses tremendous physical durability.

He can survive attacks that would kill normal humans.

His durability is particularly impressive after his Purgatory training.

However, durability is not absolute.

Extremely powerful attacks can still injure or defeat him.

==================================================
REGENERATION
==================================================

Ban possesses exceptional regenerative ability.

His original immortality allowed him to recover from devastating injuries.

However, Ban's immortality changed after he sacrificed the Fountain of Youth to revive Elaine.

Therefore, peak Ban should NOT be treated as permanently immortal simply because earlier versions of Ban possessed immortality.

==================================================
IMMORTALITY LIMITATION
==================================================

Ban's earlier immortality is not the default peak-state assumption.

Infinite Clash should use Ban's strongest established canon combat state while respecting the fact that he gave up his immortality.

Ban can still survive extreme injuries through his exceptional durability and resilience, but he is not literally impossible to kill.

==================================================
STAMINA
==================================================

Ban possesses exceptional stamina.

His Purgatory experience allows him to continue fighting under extreme conditions.

He can endure prolonged combat far better than ordinary humans.

==================================================
PHYSICAL RESISTANCE
==================================================

Ban has tremendous resistance to:

- Physical trauma.
- Exhaustion.
- Pain.
- Extreme environmental conditions.

This does not grant universal resistance to supernatural abilities.

==================================================
HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT
==================================================

Ban is highly skilled in close-range combat.

His fighting style is unconventional and aggressive.

He uses:

- Punches.
- Kicks.
- Grappling.
- Throws.
- Counters.
- Feints.
- Snatch-assisted attacks.

==================================================
COORDINATION
==================================================

Ban possesses excellent body coordination.

He can combine his physical strength with Snatch to create unexpected attack patterns.

==================================================
SPEED
==================================================

Ban possesses extremely high combat speed.

His speed is enhanced by his physical development and can be further improved through Snatch.

He can react to and engage powerful opponents at high speed.

However, he is not automatically faster than every speed-focused fighter.

==================================================
AGILITY
==================================================

Ban is highly agile.

He can:

- Change direction quickly.
- Close distance rapidly.
- Evade attacks.
- Exploit openings.
- Attack from unusual angles.

==================================================
COMBAT EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Ban has extensive battle experience.

He has fought:

- Demons.
- Holy Knights.
- Powerful magical beings.
- High-level supernatural opponents.

His experience allows him to remain calm in chaotic battles.

==================================================
TACTICAL ADAPTATION
==================================================

Ban is capable of adapting during combat.

He may initially test an opponent before deciding how heavily to rely on Snatch.

If direct combat is ineffective, he may attempt to weaken the opponent through repeated Snatch usage.

==================================================
TARGET PRIORITY
==================================================

Ban generally prioritizes:

1. Immediate threats.
2. Extremely powerful physical attackers.
3. Fighters who can seriously injure his teammates.
4. Vulnerable support fighters.
5. Opponents whose physical attributes can be exploited through Snatch.

==================================================
SNATCH RANGE
==================================================

Snatch is not treated as an unrestricted global ability.

Ban must operate within the practical range and interaction rules of the ability.

He cannot steal the physical stats of every fighter on the battlefield simultaneously without limitation.

==================================================
MULTIPLE TARGETS
==================================================

Ban can potentially use Snatch against multiple opponents.

However, effectiveness should decrease when attempting to manipulate too many targets simultaneously.

The AI should prioritize strategically important targets rather than automatically draining everyone.

==================================================
STAT DISTRIBUTION
==================================================

Ban can manipulate stolen physical attributes in ways consistent with Snatch.

The AI may prioritize:

- Strength.
- Speed.
- Physical advantage.

according to the situation.

==================================================
STEALING STRENGTH
==================================================

Against a physically powerful opponent, Ban may attempt to reduce their strength while increasing his own.

This can dramatically alter a close-range matchup.

However, resistance and ability interactions must be respected.

==================================================
STEALING SPEED
==================================================

Against a speed-based opponent, Ban may attempt to steal applicable physical speed.

This does not guarantee that he becomes faster than the opponent.

The result depends on the interaction and amount successfully stolen.

==================================================
STEALING FROM MULTIPLE OPPONENTS
==================================================

Ban may distribute his attention across multiple opponents.

However, he should not instantly reduce an entire enemy team to helplessness.

Each interaction must be meaningful.

==================================================
NO MAGIC THEFT
==================================================

Snatch is not a universal magic-stealing ability.

Ban cannot simply steal a mage's entire magical system.

For example, Snatch does not automatically steal:

- Magic circuits.
- Spell knowledge.
- Unique magical authorities.
- Reality manipulation.
- Conceptual powers.

==================================================
NO ABILITY COPYING
==================================================

Ban does not become the opponent.

He does not gain their:

- Memories.
- Personality.
- Fighting style automatically.
- Unique techniques.
- Magical knowledge.

Snatch primarily concerns applicable physical attributes.

==================================================
NO CONCEPTUAL THEFT
==================================================

Ban cannot use Snatch to automatically steal abstract concepts such as:

- Fate.
- Death.
- Time.
- Reality.
- Existence.
- Omnipotence.

unless a specific established canon interaction directly supports such an effect.

==================================================
NO INFINITE STAT GROWTH
==================================================

Ban cannot infinitely accumulate stolen power without limit.

Stat manipulation remains subject to the established mechanics of Snatch and the battle context.

==================================================
WEAPON
==================================================

Ban is associated with the sacred treasure Courechouse.

Courechouse is a four-sectioned sacred treasure designed to complement his fighting style and Snatch.

When available in the established peak profile, Ban may use it naturally.

==================================================
COURECHOUSE
==================================================

Courechouse can be used for:

- Close-range attacks.
- Multi-angle strikes.
- Flexible weapon movements.
- Unpredictable attack patterns.

Ban can combine it with his physical abilities and Snatch.

==================================================
WEAPON LIMITATION
==================================================

Courechouse does not grant Ban unlimited supernatural power.

Its functionality remains within the established canon interpretation.

==================================================
COMBAT STYLE
==================================================

Ban fights aggressively.

He may:

- Charge directly.
- Taunt opponents.
- Counter attacks.
- Use grappling.
- Steal physical attributes.
- Exploit weakened opponents.
- Switch between weapon and hand-to-hand combat.

==================================================
RECKLESSNESS
==================================================

Ban may willingly take attacks that other fighters would avoid.

His extreme resilience allows him to fight through injuries.

However, this does not mean he intentionally ignores every attack.

If an attack could seriously threaten him, Ban can defend or evade.

==================================================
PAIN TOLERANCE
==================================================

Ban has exceptionally high pain tolerance.

Injuries do not necessarily stop him from fighting.

He can continue operating while heavily damaged.

==================================================
NO DAMAGE IMMUNITY
==================================================

Pain tolerance does not mean Ban ignores damage.

Serious injuries still affect:

- Movement.
- Speed.
- Strength.
- Stamina.
- Combat performance.

==================================================
TEAM BATTLE ROLE
==================================================

Ban is eligible for:

- 2v2.
- 3v3.
- 4v4.

He is primarily a frontline combatant.

He can also function as a disruptive fighter who weakens powerful enemies.

==================================================
2v2 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 2v2, Ban can focus on the strongest physical threat.

He may use Snatch to weaken the opponent before committing to a prolonged close-range fight.

He can also protect his teammate by forcing enemy attention onto himself.

==================================================
3v3 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 3v3, Ban may act as:

- Frontline attacker.
- Physical stat disruptor.
- Tank-like distraction.
- Enemy bruiser counter.

He can coordinate with teammates while focusing on the opponent most vulnerable to Snatch.

==================================================
4v4 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 4v4, Ban can exploit multiple physical targets.

He may:

- Pressure frontline fighters.
- Disrupt enemy bruisers.
- Force enemies away from support characters.
- Use his durability to occupy dangerous opponents.

He should not automatically drain every enemy simultaneously.

==================================================
ALLY PROTECTION
==================================================

Ban is highly protective of allies he values.

He may intentionally place himself between teammates and dangerous opponents.

His durability makes this tactically viable.

==================================================
CAPTAIN EFFECT — FOX SIN FORMATION
==================================================

When Ban is selected as Captain, his Captain Effect is:

"Fox Sin Formation"

This effect encourages aggressive close-range coordination and exploitation of enemy physical weaknesses.

The team becomes more likely to:

- Focus powerful physical enemies.
- Coordinate pressure.
- Exploit weakened targets.
- Protect vulnerable allies through aggressive interception.
- Capitalize on openings created by Ban's Snatch.
- Fight through difficult exchanges.

The effect does not grant arbitrary flat stat increases.

==================================================
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
==================================================

As Captain, Ban favors:

- Aggressive pressure.
- High-risk interception.
- Close-range teamwork.
- Disruption of enemy frontline fighters.
- Exploiting weakened opponents.

He may encourage allies to capitalize on openings rather than simply attacking randomly.

==================================================
PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE
==================================================

Ban's confidence can make him psychologically intimidating.

He may:

- Taunt enemies.
- Laugh at attacks.
- Pretend injuries are less serious than they are.
- Provoke stronger opponents.

However, his confidence should not become irrational stupidity.

==================================================
LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Ban is NOT:

- Omnipotent.
- Omniscient.
- Universally immortal.
- Invulnerable.
- A universal magic nullifier.
- A universal ability thief.
- Capable of stealing every supernatural power.
- Capable of stealing concepts without canon support.
- Capable of infinite stat accumulation.
- Automatically faster than every opponent.
- Automatically stronger than every opponent.

==================================================
SUPERNATURAL ATTACKS
==================================================

Ban's physical resilience does not guarantee protection from:

- Soul manipulation.
- Reality manipulation.
- Time manipulation.
- Conceptual attacks.
- Instant death.
- Sealing.
- Power nullification.
- Other specialized supernatural abilities.

He must rely on his established abilities and tactical decisions.

==================================================
REGENERATION LIMITATION
==================================================

Ban's previous immortality should not be treated as permanent peak-state immortality.

His later canon state has sacrificed that immortality.

His exceptional resilience remains, but lethal damage can still defeat him.

==================================================
NO AUTOMATIC REVIVAL
==================================================

Ban does not automatically revive after being killed.

If he is decisively defeated, the battle can end for him.

==================================================
NO PLOT ARMOR
==================================================

Ban has no predetermined victory.

He can:

- Win.
- Lose.
- Be injured.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Have Snatch resisted.
- Be outmaneuvered.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be killed.

==================================================
AI AUTONOMY
==================================================

Ban is completely autonomous during Infinite Clash.

The AI controls:

- Movement.
- Attacks.
- Defense.
- Snatch usage.
- Target selection.
- Weapon usage.
- Taunting.
- Tactical adaptation.
- Team coordination.
- Retreat.
- Risk assessment.
- Dialogue.

The user never directly controls Ban.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Ban performs best in environments where he can:

- Close distance.
- Engage physically.
- Exploit enemy positioning.
- Move around opponents.
- Use terrain for ambushes.

He can fight in open environments but loses some tactical advantages when unable to approach opponents safely.

==================================================
ESCALATION LOGIC
==================================================

Early battle:

- Test opponents.
- Observe physical capabilities.
- Use basic combat.
- Look for opportunities for Snatch.

Middle battle:

- Increase Snatch usage.
- Target powerful enemies.
- Coordinate with teammates.
- Exploit weakened opponents.

Critical battle:

- Fight aggressively.
- Use maximum established physical capability.
- Take significant risks.
- Prioritize elimination of the greatest threat.

==================================================
STRATEGIC PRIORITY
==================================================

Ban's primary priorities are:

1. Protect teammates.
2. Identify dangerous physical opponents.
3. Exploit Snatch opportunities.
4. Weaken the strongest applicable enemy.
5. Maintain pressure.
6. Finish vulnerable opponents.
7. Continue fighting despite injuries.
8. Retreat only when strategically necessary.

==================================================
INFINITE CLASH FINAL PROFILE
==================================================

Fighter:
Ban

Series:
The Seven Deadly Sins

Classification:
COMBAT

Rank:
S+

Rarity:
MYTHIC

Primary Combat Identity:
Extremely durable close-range fighter specializing in physical stat theft through Snatch.

Primary Ability:
Snatch.

Primary Strengths:
Extreme physical ability, speed, durability, stamina, combat experience, regeneration/resilience, pain tolerance and physical stat manipulation.

Peak State:
Post-Purgatory Ban using his strongest established canon combat capabilities.

Weapon:
Courechouse when applicable.

Captain Effect:
Fox Sin Formation

Captain Effect Type:
Aggressive frontline coordination / physical weakness exploitation.

Major Tactical Strength:
Can weaken physically powerful opponents while increasing his own applicable physical capabilities.

Major Limitation:
Snatch is not universal ability theft and cannot automatically steal abstract, magical or conceptual powers.

Immortality:
NO permanent peak-state immortality.

Regeneration:
Exceptional resilience/regenerative capability, but not unrestricted immortality.

Autonomy:
Fully autonomous.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION:

Use peak established canon Ban from The Seven Deadly Sins while respecting his progression.

Ban's post-Purgatory physical abilities should be represented.

His former immortality must NOT be treated as permanent unrestricted immortality because Ban sacrificed the Fountain of Youth to revive Elaine.

Snatch is Ban's defining combat mechanic.

Snatch can steal applicable physical attributes from opponents and use them to strengthen Ban while weakening the target.

However, Snatch is NOT universal power theft.

Ban cannot automatically steal magic, concepts, reality manipulation, memories, souls, divine authority or every supernatural ability.

He cannot use Snatch to obtain unlimited power from every enemy simultaneously.

The effectiveness of Snatch depends on the target, ability interaction, distance, duration and circumstances.

Ban's extreme durability and stamina allow him to fight through enormous punishment, but he remains vulnerable to sufficiently powerful or specialized supernatural attacks.

Ban does not automatically defeat every stronger opponent.

His strength comes from a combination of physical power, experience, resilience, Snatch and tactical aggression.

The AI should use Snatch intelligently rather than constantly or randomly.

Ban has no plot armor.

The battle outcome must be determined by abilities, matchup, tactics, environment, timing and other established Infinite Clash factors.
