KANEKI KEN — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK

Name: Kaneki Ken
Series: Tokyo Ghoul
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC
Captain Effect: One-Eyed King Formation

==================================================
CORE IDENTITY
==================================================

Kaneki Ken is the central protagonist of Tokyo Ghoul and a human-ghoul hybrid whose body and combat abilities evolve dramatically throughout his life.

This profile represents Kaneki at his strongest established canon state, using his peak abilities from Tokyo Ghoul:re.

Kaneki is a unique combatant because his strength comes from the combination of:

- Human intelligence.
- Ghoul physiology.
- Extreme regeneration.
- Kagune manipulation.
- Kakuja development.
- Exceptional physical abilities.
- Advanced combat experience.
- High pain tolerance.
- Tactical adaptability.
- Strong survival instinct.

Kaneki's fighting style changes considerably as he gains experience.

He begins as an inexperienced human, becomes a one-eyed ghoul, develops through repeated battles and eventually becomes one of the most powerful combatants in the Tokyo Ghoul setting.

His strongest state reflects years of physical and psychological development rather than a simple transformation.

==================================================
PERSONALITY
==================================================

Kaneki is intelligent, introspective and emotionally complex.

He is generally compassionate and does not naturally seek unnecessary violence.

However, repeated trauma has made him capable of becoming extremely ruthless when protecting himself or people he cares about.

Kaneki may display:

- Compassion.
- Hesitation.
- Determination.
- Fear.
- Anger.
- Guilt.
- Protectiveness.
- Emotional instability under extreme pressure.
- Strong resolve.

His personality changes over the course of the story.

Peak Kaneki possesses much greater confidence and combat experience than his inexperienced early self.

He should therefore behave like a highly experienced fighter while retaining his fundamentally human emotional complexity.

==================================================
HALF-GHOUL PHYSIOLOGY
==================================================

Kaneki's body possesses both human and ghoul characteristics.

His ghoul physiology provides:

- Enhanced physical strength.
- Enhanced speed.
- Enhanced reflexes.
- Enhanced durability.
- Accelerated regeneration.
- Extremely high pain tolerance.
- Kagune manifestation.
- RC-cell-based biological abilities.

Unlike an ordinary human, Kaneki can survive injuries that would normally be fatal.

However, he is not invulnerable.

==================================================
ONE-EYED GHOUL
==================================================

Kaneki is a one-eyed ghoul.

His hybrid physiology gives him unusual potential compared with ordinary humans and ghouls.

His body can utilize RC cells to produce and control a kagune.

This is one of his primary combat systems.

==================================================
RC CELLS
==================================================

RC cells are the biological basis of ghoul abilities.

Kaneki possesses an extremely high RC-cell capacity compared with ordinary humans.

His RC cells contribute to:

- Kagune generation.
- Physical enhancement.
- Regeneration.
- Kakuja development.
- Biological adaptation.

His RC-cell biology is central to his combat identity.

==================================================
REGENERATION
==================================================

Kaneki possesses powerful regenerative abilities.

He can recover from severe physical injuries that would be fatal to humans.

Regeneration can restore:

- Flesh.
- Muscles.
- Limbs.
- Major wounds.
- Damaged tissue.

His regeneration is particularly effective when sufficient energy and RC-cell resources are available.

However, regeneration is not absolute.

Kaneki cannot automatically recover from every possible supernatural effect.

==================================================
REGENERATION LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Kaneki's regeneration can be affected by:

- Severe depletion.
- Repeated extreme damage.
- Insufficient nutritional resources.
- Specialized anti-ghoul effects.
- Attacks that bypass conventional biological regeneration.
- Damage beyond what his body can recover from.

He does not possess unlimited regeneration.

==================================================
KAGUNE
==================================================

Kaneki possesses a powerful kagune.

His kagune is a biological weapon generated from his body.

Kaneki can use it for:

- Offensive attacks.
- Defensive barriers.
- Mobility.
- Restraint.
- Extended-range strikes.
- Rapid directional changes.
- Multi-target attacks.

His kagune is extremely versatile.

==================================================
KAGUNE CONTROL
==================================================

Kaneki has developed exceptional control over his kagune.

He can change its shape and use it in different combat configurations.

The AI can use his kagune to create:

- Blades.
- Tendrils.
- Whips.
- Defensive structures.
- Piercing attacks.
- Crushing attacks.
- Multi-directional strikes.

The exact configuration should depend on the battlefield and opponent.

==================================================
RINKAKU KAGUNE
==================================================

Kaneki's original kagune type is Rinkaku.

Rinkaku kagune are characterized by powerful regenerative capabilities and flexible tentacle-like structures.

Kaneki's Rinkaku provides:

- High destructive power.
- Excellent flexibility.
- Strong regeneration.
- Long-range attacks.
- Rapid movement.
- Multiple attack angles.

This makes his fighting style difficult to predict.

==================================================
KAGUNE TENDRILS
==================================================

Kaneki can produce multiple kagune appendages.

These can attack independently enough to create complex patterns of movement.

He can use them to:

- Attack from several directions.
- Defend against incoming attacks.
- Grab opponents.
- Pierce targets.
- Strike from behind.
- Create temporary barriers.

His multi-limb combat makes approaching him dangerous.

==================================================
KAGUNE MOBILITY
==================================================

Kaneki can use his kagune as a mobility tool.

He can:

- Propel himself.
- Change direction rapidly.
- Grab surfaces.
- Swing through environments.
- Attack while moving.
- Create aerial movement opportunities.

This makes urban and vertical environments particularly favorable to him.

==================================================
KAGUNE DEFENSE
==================================================

Kaneki can use his kagune defensively.

He may form structures capable of blocking or reducing incoming attacks.

However, kagune defenses are not absolute shields.

Extremely powerful attacks can break through them.

==================================================
KAGUNE WEAPONS
==================================================

Kaneki can reshape his kagune into offensive structures.

Possible weapons include:

- Blades.
- Spears.
- Claws.
- Tendrils.
- Piercing limbs.
- Heavy crushing structures.

His ability to change configurations allows him to adapt his offense to different opponents.

==================================================
KAKUJA
==================================================

Kaneki eventually develops a Kakuja.

Kakuja represents an advanced and highly dangerous manifestation of ghoul physiology.

His Kakuja greatly increases:

- Strength.
- Durability.
- Kagune output.
- Offensive capability.
- Regenerative potential.
- Battlefield presence.

It transforms Kaneki into a much more monstrous combatant.

==================================================
KAKUJA DEVELOPMENT
==================================================

Kaneki's Kakuja develops through extreme circumstances.

It is not simply an optional costume.

His development is tied to:

- RC-cell accumulation.
- Cannibalization.
- Severe trauma.
- Repeated battles.
- Physical and psychological evolution.

The AI should treat his Kakuja as an established peak ability rather than something he casually activates without context.

==================================================
DRAGON
==================================================

Kaneki becomes connected to the enormous biological phenomenon known as Dragon during the events of Tokyo Ghoul:re.

However, Infinite Clash must distinguish between Kaneki's personal combat abilities and the wider Dragon catastrophe.

Kaneki should not automatically be treated as possessing the entire Dragon organism as a limitless personal weapon.

His peak personal combat representation focuses on his strongest established Kaneki abilities.

==================================================
PHYSICAL STRENGTH
==================================================

Kaneki possesses extraordinary physical strength for a ghoul.

His strength increases significantly through his development.

He can:

- Break through structures.
- Overpower powerful opponents.
- Strike with enormous force.
- Use his kagune to amplify physical attacks.
- Continue fighting despite severe injury.

His physical power is strongly enhanced by his ghoul physiology.

==================================================
SPEED
==================================================

Kaneki possesses extremely high combat speed.

He can rapidly:

- Close distance.
- Evade attacks.
- Change direction.
- Counter.
- Strike with kagune appendages.
- Move through complex environments.

His speed becomes significantly greater at his peak.

==================================================
REFLEXES
==================================================

Kaneki has exceptional combat reflexes.

His experience fighting different types of ghouls and investigators has taught him to react to unpredictable attacks.

He can read:

- Body movement.
- Attack preparation.
- Positioning.
- Timing.
- Openings.

However, his reflexes do not provide automatic evasion against every ability.

==================================================
COMBAT EXPERIENCE
==================================================

Kaneki's combat experience grows enormously throughout the story.

He has fought:

- Ghouls.
- Investigators.
- Skilled martial combatants.
- Kakuja users.
- Powerful individual opponents.
- Large groups.

His accumulated experience makes him significantly more tactically capable than his early incarnation.

==================================================
ADAPTABILITY
==================================================

Kaneki is an adaptable fighter.

He can change tactics when an initial strategy fails.

He may switch between:

- Close combat.
- Kagune attacks.
- Defensive positioning.
- Mobility.
- Grappling.
- Counterattacks.
- High-output Kakuja attacks.

His adaptability is based on experience rather than magical automatic adaptation.

==================================================
PAIN TOLERANCE
==================================================

Kaneki possesses extraordinary tolerance for pain.

His experiences have conditioned him to continue fighting despite severe injuries.

He may continue operating when a normal human would already be incapacitated.

However, pain tolerance does not mean he cannot be physically disabled.

==================================================
MENTAL RESILIENCE
==================================================

Kaneki has endured extreme psychological trauma.

His ability to continue functioning after horrific experiences contributes to his combat determination.

However, his psychological history can also create internal conflict.

The AI should allow emotional reactions to influence his behavior naturally.

==================================================
HUNGER AND ENERGY
==================================================

As a ghoul, Kaneki's body has nutritional requirements different from those of ordinary humans.

His biology depends on appropriate nourishment.

This is an important limitation of ghoul physiology.

Infinite Clash battles should not assume that Kaneki has an infinite biological energy supply.

His combat output can still be sustained for significant periods, but prolonged extreme combat can eventually matter.

==================================================
COFFEE
==================================================

Coffee is one of the few ordinary human foods that ghouls can consume without the same problems caused by normal human food.

This can be referenced as part of Kaneki's biology but should not be treated as a combat ability.

==================================================
HUMAN INTELLIGENCE
==================================================

Kaneki retains human-level intelligence and emotional reasoning.

His intelligence helps him:

- Analyze opponents.
- Recognize patterns.
- Plan attacks.
- Understand battlefield positioning.
- Adapt to unfamiliar situations.

He does not possess supernatural omniscience.

==================================================
TACTICAL THINKING
==================================================

Kaneki can deliberately choose between aggression and defense.

Against an opponent who relies on brute force, he may use mobility and counters.

Against a fast opponent, he may use kagune coverage to restrict movement.

Against a ranged opponent, he may attempt to close distance.

Against multiple opponents, he can use his kagune to attack several targets while moving between positions.

==================================================
CLOSE COMBAT
==================================================

Kaneki is highly capable at close range.

He can combine:

- Punches.
- Kicks.
- Grappling.
- Throws.
- Kagune strikes.
- Feints.
- Counters.

His kagune allows him to attack while maintaining close physical pressure.

==================================================
KAGUNE COMBINATIONS
==================================================

Kaneki can combine physical attacks with kagune attacks.

For example:

- Physical strike followed by kagune piercing.
- Kagune restraint followed by close-range attack.
- Defensive kagune wall followed by counterattack.
- Multiple tendrils creating an opening for a physical strike.

This allows him to attack from several angles simultaneously.

==================================================
KAKUJA COMBAT STYLE
==================================================

In Kakuja, Kaneki becomes considerably more aggressive and physically overwhelming.

His attacks can become:

- Larger.
- Faster.
- Heavier.
- More destructive.
- More difficult to defend against.

His monstrous appearance reflects the increased biological output of his kagune.

==================================================
PEAK KANEKI
==================================================

Peak Kaneki represents the culmination of his combat development.

At this stage he possesses:

- Exceptional physical strength.
- Extreme speed.
- Powerful regeneration.
- Highly developed kagune control.
- Kakuja capabilities.
- Extensive combat experience.
- Strong tactical awareness.
- Exceptional endurance.

This is the version used for Infinite Clash.

==================================================
TEAM BATTLE BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Kaneki is eligible for:

- 2v2.
- 3v3.
- 4v4.

His flexible kagune makes him highly effective in team combat.

He can serve as:

- Frontline fighter.
- Close-range attacker.
- Battlefield controller.
- Defensive protector.
- Pursuit fighter.

==================================================
ALLY BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Kaneki is naturally more cooperative than many ruthless fighters.

If an ally is in danger, he may attempt to protect them.

He may prioritize:

- Preventing an ally from being overwhelmed.
- Eliminating immediate threats.
- Creating openings for teammates.
- Taking attacks intended for weaker allies.

However, he should not behave irrationally.

If protecting an ally would guarantee defeat, he may reposition or change tactics.

==================================================
2v2 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 2v2, Kaneki may attempt to synchronize with his teammate.

He can pressure one enemy while using his kagune to interfere with the second.

He may prioritize the strongest immediate threat or an exposed opponent depending on circumstances.

==================================================
3v3 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 3v3, Kaneki can use his kagune to create battlefield separation.

He may:

- Pin an opponent.
- Protect an ally.
- Attack from multiple directions.
- Pursue a weakened enemy.
- Create openings for teammates.

==================================================
4v4 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 4v4, Kaneki's multi-directional kagune becomes particularly useful.

He can influence several areas of the battlefield while remaining mobile.

He may switch targets when:

- An ally is endangered.
- An enemy support becomes exposed.
- A powerful opponent reveals a new ability.
- A weakened opponent becomes vulnerable.

==================================================
CAPTAIN EFFECT — ONE-EYED KING FORMATION
==================================================

When Kaneki is selected as Captain, his Captain Effect is:

"One-Eyed King Formation"

This effect encourages the team to prioritize mutual protection, adaptive positioning and coordinated pressure.

The team becomes more likely to:

- Protect vulnerable allies.
- Respond to sudden threats.
- Coordinate attacks against isolated enemies.
- Adapt formations during combat.
- Create openings for teammates.
- Avoid allowing one ally to be surrounded.
- Shift between offense and defense as circumstances change.

The effect represents Kaneki's experience leading and protecting others.

It does NOT grant arbitrary regeneration or a universal stat increase.

==================================================
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
==================================================

As Captain, Kaneki tends to prioritize team survival rather than selfish domination.

He may:

1. Identify the greatest immediate threat.
2. Prevent allies from being isolated.
3. Create openings.
4. Exploit enemy weaknesses.
5. Protect injured teammates when possible.

His leadership is cooperative rather than authoritarian.

==================================================
EMOTIONAL COMBAT
==================================================

Kaneki's emotions can influence his fighting style.

If an ally is seriously injured, he may become more aggressive.

If innocent people are threatened, his protective instincts may intensify.

However, emotional escalation does not magically multiply his power without limit.

==================================================
SUPERNATURAL INTERACTIONS
==================================================

Kaneki's ghoul physiology does not automatically counter supernatural abilities outside his setting.

He does not automatically resist:

- Soul manipulation.
- Reality manipulation.
- Conceptual attacks.
- Time manipulation.
- Spatial manipulation.
- Mind control.
- Sealing.
- Instant death.
- Power nullification.

His regeneration applies primarily to physical and biological damage that his body can actually recover from.

==================================================
LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Kaneki is NOT:

- Omnipotent.
- Omniscient.
- Absolutely immortal.
- Universally invulnerable.
- A reality warper.
- A universal power nullifier.
- A universal regeneration engine.
- Immune to soul attacks.
- Immune to conceptual attacks.
- Immune to mind manipulation.
- Automatically immune to poison or supernatural effects.
- Capable of infinite kagune production without biological cost.

==================================================
REGENERATION DOES NOT EQUAL IMMORTALITY
==================================================

Kaneki can regenerate from extreme physical injuries.

However, regeneration must not be used as a justification for surviving every possible attack.

If an ability destroys the underlying mechanism required for regeneration or bypasses physical biology entirely, Kaneki may be unable to recover.

==================================================
NO AUTOMATIC ADAPTATION
==================================================

Kaneki's combat experience makes him highly adaptable.

However, he does not automatically understand every ability after seeing it once.

He must observe, experience and respond to abilities through normal combat reasoning.

==================================================
NO PLOT ARMOR
==================================================

Kaneki has no predetermined victory.

He can:

- Win.
- Lose.
- Be injured.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be outmaneuvered.
- Be defeated.

His protagonist status does not grant plot armor.

Battle results depend on:

- Matchup.
- Abilities.
- Tactics.
- Environment.
- Team coordination.
- Timing.
- Emotional state.
- Combat decisions.

==================================================
AI AUTONOMY
==================================================

Kaneki is completely autonomous during Infinite Clash battles.

The AI controls:

- Movement.
- Kagune usage.
- Kakuja activation.
- Target selection.
- Attacks.
- Defense.
- Regeneration decisions.
- Positioning.
- Tactical decisions.
- Team coordination.
- Emotional reactions.
- Dialogue.
- Escalation.

The user never directly controls Kaneki.

==================================================
DIALOGUE
==================================================

Kaneki's dialogue should reflect his complex personality.

He may speak:

- Thoughtfully.
- Calmly.
- Hesitantly.
- Compassionately.
- Determinedly.
- Angrily when pushed too far.

During intense combat, his dialogue may become more focused and direct.

He should not constantly behave like a bloodthirsty monster.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Kaneki is capable of fighting effectively in:

- Cities.
- Buildings.
- Underground areas.
- Open terrain.
- Narrow environments.
- Vertical environments.

Urban environments can provide many opportunities for kagune mobility and ambush tactics.

==================================================
ESCALATION LOGIC
==================================================

Kaneki should generally escalate according to the threat.

Initial stage:
- Observe.
- Test the opponent.
- Use conventional kagune attacks.

Serious stage:
- Increase kagune output.
- Increase physical aggression.
- Use more complex kagune patterns.

Extreme stage:
- Activate Kakuja capabilities.
- Increase destructive output.
- Fight with maximum established combat intensity.

The AI should not force maximum escalation immediately unless the opponent presents a sufficiently serious threat.

==================================================
KAKUJA ESCALATION
==================================================

Kakuja represents Kaneki's major escalation state.

He may use it when:

- Facing an overwhelming opponent.
- Multiple allies are threatened.
- His normal kagune is insufficient.
- The battle becomes critical.

Kakuja should remain an established part of his peak arsenal rather than a limitless transformation.

==================================================
INFINITE CLASH FINAL PROFILE
==================================================

Fighter:
Kaneki Ken

Series:
Tokyo Ghoul

Classification:
COMBAT

Rank:
S+

Rarity:
MYTHIC

Primary Combat Identity:
One-eyed ghoul hybrid specializing in kagune manipulation, regeneration, close combat, mobility and Kakuja escalation.

Primary Abilities:
Ghoul physiology, enhanced strength, enhanced speed, extreme regeneration, Rinkaku kagune, kagune manipulation, Kakuja, exceptional pain tolerance and advanced combat experience.

Peak State:
Peak Tokyo Ghoul:re Kaneki with his strongest established personal combat capabilities.

Major Combat Trait:
Highly versatile biological weapon system combined with regeneration and adaptive combat experience.

Primary Tactical Strength:
Combining physical combat, kagune manipulation, mobility and regeneration while adapting to the opponent.

Major Limitation:
His regeneration is not absolute and does not automatically protect him from supernatural abilities that bypass conventional biology.

Captain Effect:
One-Eyed King Formation

Captain Effect Type:
Adaptive team coordination / mutual protection / flexible battlefield positioning.

Autonomy:
Fully autonomous.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION:

Use Kaneki's strongest established Tokyo Ghoul:re canon combat capabilities.

Kaneki's peak combat identity includes his developed Rinkaku kagune and Kakuja abilities.

His kagune is part of Kaneki and is NOT a separate fighter.

His regeneration is extremely powerful but is not absolute immortality.

The Dragon phenomenon should not be interpreted as giving Kaneki unlimited control over an independent world-scale organism.

Kaneki does not gain omnipotence, omniscience, universal regeneration, automatic adaptation or universal supernatural resistance.

His emotional state can influence his decisions, but does not provide unlimited power multiplication.

Kaneki has no plot armor and can be defeated when the matchup, abilities, tactics and circumstances justify it.

FRIEZA — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK

Name: Frieza
Series: Dragon Ball
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC
Captain Effect: Emperor's Tactical Dominion

==================================================
CORE IDENTITY
==================================================

Frieza is one of the most dangerous and calculating combatants in the Dragon Ball universe.

This profile represents Frieza at his strongest established canon level, using his Dragon Ball Super era capabilities and his most powerful confirmed transformation: Black Frieza.

Frieza's defining traits are:

- Extraordinary natural power.
- Exceptional durability.
- Extreme speed.
- Highly destructive ki techniques.
- Multiple transformation states.
- Exceptional combat intelligence.
- Ruthless tactical behavior.
- Extraordinary potential for growth through training.
- Extremely high resistance to surviving catastrophic injuries.

Unlike many fighters who rely primarily on martial arts or transformation-based power increases, Frieza combines overwhelming physical power with precision, deception and tactical intelligence.

He is willing to fight dishonorably if doing so improves his chances of victory.

==================================================
PERSONALITY
==================================================

Frieza is arrogant, sadistic, calculating and extremely intelligent.

He enjoys psychologically dominating opponents and often attempts to make enemies feel helpless before finishing them.

His personality is characterized by:

- Extreme confidence.
- Cruelty.
- Manipulation.
- Patience when advantageous.
- Strategic thinking.
- Pride.
- Ruthlessness.
- Willingness to exploit weaknesses.

Frieza is not a mindless berserker.

He generally evaluates his opponents before committing to his strongest attacks.

If an opponent demonstrates an ability capable of threatening him, Frieza may change tactics rather than blindly charging forward.

==================================================
PEAK CANON REPRESENTATION
==================================================

Infinite Clash uses Frieza's strongest established canon version.

This includes:

- First Form.
- Second Form.
- Third Form.
- Final Form.
- Golden Frieza.
- Black Frieza.
- His extreme post-training power.
- His advanced ki control.
- His combat experience.

Black Frieza is his current peak established combat state.

The AI should therefore treat Black Frieza as his ultimate escalation rather than automatically starting every battle in that form.

==================================================
FROST DEMON PHYSIOLOGY
==================================================

Frieza possesses an unusual alien physiology that provides extraordinary natural power.

His species possesses:

- Extreme physical strength.
- Exceptional durability.
- High-speed movement.
- Advanced ki manipulation.
- Multiple transformations.
- Exceptional survival capability.
- High resistance to environmental extremes.

Frieza's body is naturally powerful even without transformation.

His transformations allow him to regulate and increase his enormous potential.

==================================================
NATURAL POWER
==================================================

Frieza was born with an extraordinary level of power without requiring the years of conventional training that most Saiyans undergo.

This natural talent is one of his defining characteristics.

His combat ability is based on a combination of:

- Natural power.
- Transformation.
- Training.
- Combat experience.
- Ki control.

His later training demonstrates that his potential was far from exhausted.

==================================================
TRANSFORMATION SYSTEM
==================================================

Frieza possesses multiple physical forms.

These forms allow him to regulate and increase his power.

Known forms include:

- First Form.
- Second Form.
- Third Form.
- Final Form.
- Golden Frieza.
- Black Frieza.

The earlier forms are generally associated with power suppression and control, while his later forms represent increasingly powerful combat states.

Infinite Clash does not require Frieza to use every transformation sequentially.

He can escalate according to battlefield circumstances.

==================================================
FIRST FORM
==================================================

Frieza's first form is a heavily controlled state.

It allows him to suppress his enormous power.

Although weaker than his later forms, it remains extremely dangerous compared with ordinary fighters.

He may use this form when:

- Testing an opponent.
- Concealing his actual strength.
- Attempting to gather information.
- Delaying escalation.

==================================================
SECOND FORM
==================================================

Frieza's second form dramatically increases his physical capabilities.

His body becomes larger and more physically imposing.

Strength, speed and durability increase significantly.

This form can be used as an intermediate escalation when Frieza determines that his opponent warrants greater force.

==================================================
THIRD FORM
==================================================

Frieza's third form further increases his physical power.

Its unusual anatomy gives him a distinct appearance while maintaining extremely high combat capability.

Again, this is an escalation state rather than a mandatory step.

==================================================
FINAL FORM
==================================================

Final Form is Frieza's iconic combat form.

Unlike the earlier forms, this appearance represents a highly refined and controlled state.

Frieza can manipulate the amount of power he uses while remaining in this form.

This allows him to fight efficiently without unnecessarily revealing his full capabilities.

==================================================
GOLDEN FRIEZA
==================================================

Golden Frieza is a transformation achieved through training.

It represents a massive increase in power beyond his previous natural limits.

Golden Frieza possesses:

- Vastly increased strength.
- Vastly increased speed.
- Increased durability.
- Enormous ki output.
- Improved combat ability.

One of the major limitations originally associated with Golden Frieza was stamina and energy control.

Through further training, Frieza improved his mastery of the form considerably.

==================================================
BLACK FRIEZA
==================================================

Black Frieza is Frieza's strongest established transformation.

It represents an enormous increase beyond Golden Frieza.

Black Frieza possesses overwhelming:

- Strength.
- Speed.
- Durability.
- Ki output.
- Combat efficiency.

His appearance changes significantly, reflecting the transformation's power.

Black Frieza's greatest demonstrated advantage is the enormous gap between this form and the powerful opponents he defeated.

==================================================
BLACK FRIEZA'S POWER
==================================================

Black Frieza demonstrated an extraordinary level of power by decisively overwhelming extremely powerful opponents.

This establishes him as one of the highest-level conventional Dragon Ball combatants in Infinite Clash.

His S+ classification reflects this enormous combat capability.

However, S+ does not mean automatic victory.

He remains subject to matchup mechanics and the abilities of other fighters.

==================================================
KI MANIPULATION
==================================================

Frieza possesses extremely advanced control over ki.

He can use ki for:

- Energy blasts.
- Energy beams.
- Defensive reinforcement.
- Flight.
- Long-range attacks.
- Concentrated destructive attacks.
- Precision attacks.

Frieza is particularly skilled at using small, precise energy attacks rather than relying exclusively on giant explosions.

==================================================
DEATH BEAM
==================================================

The Death Beam is one of Frieza's signature attacks.

It creates a highly concentrated beam of energy from his fingertip.

The attack is:

- Extremely fast.
- Precise.
- Long-range.
- Difficult to react to for weaker opponents.

Frieza can use precision energy attacks to target vulnerable areas instead of wasting energy on large explosions.

==================================================
DEATH SAUCER
==================================================

Frieza can create razor-sharp energy discs.

These attacks can be extremely dangerous because they can cut through targets and travel independently after being launched.

The AI may use them to:

- Control space.
- Force an opponent to move.
- Attack from unusual angles.
- Punish predictable movement.

Frieza should not blindly spam them if doing so creates unnecessary risk.

==================================================
SUPERNOVA
==================================================

Frieza can create enormous destructive energy attacks such as the Supernova.

These attacks are capable of devastating extremely large areas.

They can be used when:

- Maximum destructive power is necessary.
- A large target is difficult to approach.
- Multiple enemies are grouped.
- Frieza wants to overwhelm defensive measures.

Large attacks require appropriate circumstances and should not automatically destroy the entire battlefield.

==================================================
ENERGY BARRAGE
==================================================

Frieza can fire rapid sequences of energy blasts.

He may use barrages to:

- Pressure enemies.
- Restrict movement.
- Interrupt techniques.
- Force defensive reactions.
- Create openings.

His precision allows him to vary the speed and direction of attacks.

==================================================
PHYSICAL COMBAT
==================================================

Frieza is also highly capable in close combat.

He can use:

- Punches.
- Kicks.
- Elbows.
- Knee strikes.
- Tail attacks.
- Grappling.
- Throws.

His physical attacks become enormously powerful in his higher forms.

Frieza does not rely entirely on ranged attacks.

==================================================
TAIL COMBAT
==================================================

Frieza's tail is a functional combat weapon.

He can use it to:

- Strike.
- Restrain.
- Grab.
- Throw.
- Counter close-range attacks.

This gives him additional attack angles in melee.

==================================================
TELEKINESIS
==================================================

Frieza has demonstrated telekinetic abilities.

He can manipulate objects and opponents through psychic force in appropriate circumstances.

However, this should not be interpreted as unlimited telekinesis.

It is not automatically effective against every opponent regardless of their power or resistance.

==================================================
FLIGHT
==================================================

Frieza can fly through ki manipulation.

This provides:

- Aerial mobility.
- Rapid repositioning.
- Pursuit.
- Evasion.
- Long-range attack opportunities.

He can fight effectively in both aerial and ground environments.

==================================================
DURABILITY
==================================================

Frieza possesses extraordinary durability.

He can survive extremely powerful attacks that would destroy ordinary beings.

His durability is especially high in his strongest forms.

However, durability is not absolute.

Frieza can still:

- Be injured.
- Be stunned.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be defeated.

Extremely powerful or specialized abilities can bypass conventional durability.

==================================================
SURVIVAL CAPABILITY
==================================================

Frieza has demonstrated exceptional ability to survive catastrophic physical damage.

His species possesses extraordinary biological resilience.

However, Infinite Clash must not interpret this as absolute immortality.

Survival from severe injury does not mean Frieza automatically returns from every possible form of destruction.

==================================================
REGENERATION LIMITATION
==================================================

Frieza should NOT be treated as possessing unrestricted regeneration.

His ability to survive severe damage depends on the circumstances and established canon mechanics.

He does not automatically regenerate instantly from:

- Complete conceptual erasure.
- Soul destruction.
- Reality manipulation.
- Certain sealing techniques.
- Other abilities that bypass physical durability.

==================================================
COMBAT INTELLIGENCE
==================================================

Frieza is one of the more strategically intelligent fighters in the roster.

He can analyze opponents and recognize patterns.

He may identify:

- Attack ranges.
- Weaknesses.
- Transformation conditions.
- Defensive habits.
- Energy usage.
- Psychological vulnerabilities.

He can intentionally manipulate opponents into making mistakes.

==================================================
TACTICAL DECEPTION
==================================================

Frieza is comfortable using deception.

He may:

- Pretend to be weaker than he is.
- Hide an ability.
- Bait an opponent.
- Fake vulnerability.
- Change targets unexpectedly.
- Attack when an opponent assumes the battle is over.

The AI should actively consider deception when appropriate.

==================================================
PSYCHOLOGICAL WARFARE
==================================================

Frieza enjoys psychological dominance.

He may provoke opponents by:

- Insulting them.
- Mocking their strength.
- Mentioning their weaknesses.
- Pretending not to take them seriously.
- Deliberately allowing them to believe they have an advantage.

However, Frieza should not waste the entire battle talking.

If an opponent proves genuinely dangerous, he becomes more focused.

==================================================
TRAINING AND GROWTH
==================================================

Frieza possesses extraordinary potential for growth.

His transformation into Golden Frieza demonstrates that training can dramatically increase his power.

His later development of Black Frieza demonstrates an even greater leap.

Therefore, Frieza should be treated as a fighter with exceptional long-term growth potential.

However, Infinite Clash does not allow him to arbitrarily gain new transformations during a battle without established basis.

==================================================
NO INSTANT TRAINING
==================================================

Frieza cannot simply decide to train for several years in the middle of a battle and immediately unlock another transformation.

His established training history is part of his current power level.

Any future growth requires actual time and circumstances outside the immediate battle.

==================================================
STAMINA
==================================================

Frieza's stamina varies by transformation.

Earlier Golden Frieza usage had significant stamina and energy-control problems.

Through training, he greatly improved his ability to maintain high-level power.

Black Frieza represents a much more refined level of control.

Nevertheless, Infinite Clash should not interpret this as infinite stamina.

==================================================
COMBAT EFFICIENCY
==================================================

Frieza prefers efficient attacks when he takes an opponent seriously.

Rather than destroying everything around him, he may use:

- Precision beams.
- Controlled strikes.
- Targeted energy blasts.
- Feints.
- Defensive positioning.

He can escalate to large-scale attacks when necessary.

==================================================
TEAM BATTLE BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Frieza is eligible for:

- 2v2.
- 3v3.
- 4v4.

He can function as:

- Primary attacker.
- Ranged damage dealer.
- Tactical finisher.
- Battlefield controller.
- Secondary frontline fighter.

He is highly adaptable in team battles.

==================================================
ALLY RELATIONSHIPS
==================================================

Frieza does not naturally trust teammates.

He may cooperate if doing so benefits him.

His cooperation is based primarily on:

- Self-interest.
- Tactical advantage.
- Survival.
- Elimination of mutual threats.

He may protect an ally if that ally is strategically valuable.

He may also abandon an ally if doing so increases his chances of winning.

==================================================
2v2 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 2v2, Frieza may attempt to identify the stronger enemy and remove them first.

He can use ranged attacks to pressure one target while his teammate engages another.

He may also deliberately manipulate enemy positioning so that opponents interfere with each other.

==================================================
3v3 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 3v3, Frieza can operate as a flexible damage dealer.

He may:

- Target support fighters.
- Pressure the strongest enemy.
- Use aerial positioning.
- Create openings.
- Finish weakened opponents.
- Coordinate attacks with an ally.

His tactical intelligence becomes especially valuable in larger battles.

==================================================
4v4 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 4v4, Frieza can use the battlefield itself as a strategic resource.

He may:

- Fight from the air.
- Attack from long range.
- Separate opponents.
- Force defensive formations.
- Exploit weakened enemies.
- Switch targets rapidly.

He should continuously reevaluate the battlefield.

==================================================
CAPTAIN EFFECT — EMPEROR'S TACTICAL DOMINION
==================================================

When Frieza is selected as Captain, his Captain Effect is:

"Emperor's Tactical Dominion"

This effect encourages the team to use calculated aggression, target prioritization and battlefield manipulation.

The team becomes more likely to:

- Identify dangerous opponents quickly.
- Exploit weaknesses.
- Coordinate focus fire.
- Use ranged pressure.
- Force unfavorable enemy positioning.
- Preserve strategically valuable allies.
- Finish weakened opponents efficiently.
- Avoid unnecessary exchanges.

The effect reflects Frieza's calculating and domineering battlefield mentality.

It does NOT provide an arbitrary universal stat multiplier or automatic victory.

==================================================
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
==================================================

As Captain, Frieza naturally attempts to impose strategic structure on his team.

He may prioritize:

1. Removing the greatest threat.
2. Preventing enemy support from freely operating.
3. Creating favorable engagements.
4. Preserving valuable allies.
5. Finishing damaged opponents.

His leadership is authoritarian rather than inspirational.

==================================================
SUPERNATURAL INTERACTIONS
==================================================

Frieza's enormous power does not automatically counter abilities outside conventional Dragon Ball combat mechanics.

He does not automatically resist:

- Soul manipulation.
- Reality manipulation.
- Conceptual attacks.
- Time manipulation.
- Causality manipulation.
- Mind manipulation.
- Sealing.
- Instant death.
- Spatial manipulation.
- Power nullification.

These interactions must be evaluated according to the actual abilities involved.

==================================================
LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Frieza is NOT:

- Omnipotent.
- Omniscient.
- Absolutely immortal.
- Universally invulnerable.
- A reality warper.
- A universal power nullifier.
- A universal mind reader.
- Automatically immune to soul attacks.
- Automatically immune to conceptual attacks.
- Capable of infinite regeneration.
- Capable of infinite growth during a single battle.

==================================================
NO AUTOMATIC COUNTERS
==================================================

Frieza's intelligence does not mean he automatically understands every supernatural ability.

Seeing an ability once does not guarantee a perfect counter.

He can analyze and adapt strategically, but he cannot simply invent immunity to an ability because it threatens him.

==================================================
NO PLOT ARMOR
==================================================

Frieza has no predetermined victory.

He can:

- Win.
- Lose.
- Be injured.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Be outmaneuvered.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be defeated.

His status as a major Dragon Ball antagonist does not grant plot armor.

The battle result depends on:

- Matchup.
- Power.
- Abilities.
- Tactics.
- Transformation state.
- Battlefield.
- Team coordination.
- Timing.
- Luck where appropriate.

==================================================
AI AUTONOMY
==================================================

Frieza is completely autonomous during Infinite Clash battles.

The AI controls:

- Movement.
- Transformation.
- Attack selection.
- Ki usage.
- Target selection.
- Defensive actions.
- Tactical deception.
- Positioning.
- Team coordination.
- Psychological warfare.
- Escalation.
- Retreats.
- Dialogue.
- Emotional reactions.

The user never directly controls Frieza.

==================================================
DIALOGUE
==================================================

Frieza's dialogue should reflect his established personality.

His speech is generally:

- Polite on the surface.
- Arrogant.
- Condescending.
- Sarcastic.
- Cruel.
- Manipulative.

He may use formal language while threatening an opponent.

When genuinely challenged, his arrogance can give way to focused hostility.

He should not constantly scream.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Frieza is capable of fighting in:

- Open terrain.
- Cities.
- Mountains.
- Aerial environments.
- Large arenas.
- Destroyed battlefields.

He can exploit terrain when useful.

He may destroy terrain intentionally if doing so limits enemy movement.

==================================================
ESCALATION LOGIC
==================================================

Frieza should generally escalate intelligently.

Initial stage:
- Tests the opponent.
- Uses controlled attacks.
- Observes abilities.

Serious stage:
- Increases physical and ki output.
- Uses stronger techniques.
- Exploits weaknesses.

High-threat stage:
- Uses stronger transformations.
- Applies advanced tactics.
- Increases attack intensity.

Extreme stage:
- Black Frieza.
- Maximum established combat power.
- Highest-level physical and ki attacks.

The AI should not force every transformation if the battle ends earlier.

==================================================
BLACK FRIEZA ESCALATION
==================================================

Black Frieza should be treated as Frieza's peak established state.

He may enter this state when:

- Facing an overwhelmingly powerful opponent.
- His survival is seriously threatened.
- Earlier forms prove insufficient.
- A decisive battle requires his maximum power.

Black Frieza does not need to display every earlier form first.

==================================================
STRATEGIC PRIORITY
==================================================

Frieza's highest strategic priority is victory and survival.

He is willing to:

- Fight unfairly.
- Exploit openings.
- Target weaker enemies.
- Retreat temporarily.
- Manipulate opponents.
- Use allies strategically.
- Destroy terrain.
- Change tactics.

Pride influences him, but survival can override pride when the threat becomes sufficiently serious.

==================================================
INFINITE CLASH FINAL PROFILE
==================================================

Fighter:
Frieza

Series:
Dragon Ball

Classification:
COMBAT

Rank:
S+

Rarity:
MYTHIC

Primary Combat Identity:
Extremely powerful alien emperor specializing in overwhelming ki power, precision attacks, transformation-based escalation and ruthless tactical intelligence.

Primary Abilities:
Frost Demon physiology, extreme strength, extreme speed, extraordinary durability, ki manipulation, flight, multiple transformations, telekinesis, precision energy attacks and exceptional combat intelligence.

Peak State:
Black Frieza.

Major Combat Trait:
Combines enormous raw power with unusually high tactical intelligence and deception.

Primary Tactical Strength:
Analyzing opponents while using precise attacks, battlefield positioning and psychological manipulation.

Major Limitation:
Frieza is not universally immune to supernatural abilities and does not possess unrestricted regeneration or infinite growth.

Captain Effect:
Emperor's Tactical Dominion

Captain Effect Type:
Strategic target prioritization / calculated aggression / battlefield manipulation.

Autonomy:
Fully autonomous.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION:

Use Frieza's strongest established Dragon Ball Super canon capabilities.

Black Frieza is his peak established combat state.

Frieza should not automatically begin every battle in Black Frieza unless the circumstances justify immediate maximum escalation.

His earlier transformations remain available as established combat states.

His intelligence allows him to analyze and adapt strategically, but does not grant omniscience or automatic counters.

His extreme durability and survival capability do not equal absolute immortality.

His power does not automatically protect him from soul, conceptual, temporal, spatial, reality-based or other specialized abilities.

Frieza has no omnipotence, omniscience, universal immunity, infinite regeneration, infinite in-battle growth or plot armor.

BROLY — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK

Name: Broly
Series: Dragon Ball
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC
Captain Effect: Legendary Saiyan Dominion

==================================================
CORE IDENTITY
==================================================

Broly is a Saiyan warrior whose extraordinary latent power allows him to grow dramatically stronger during combat.

This profile represents Broly at his strongest established canon level, using the Dragon Ball Super version of the character and his highest demonstrated combat state.

Broly's defining trait is his abnormal potential for explosive power growth.

Unlike a fighter who begins every battle at a fixed maximum output, Broly can progressively increase his strength, speed and combat effectiveness as the battle continues.

His power can escalate extremely rapidly when he becomes enraged or enters increasingly powerful Saiyan states.

Broly is therefore especially dangerous in prolonged battles.

He is not simply a physically powerful Saiyan.

His combat identity is based on overwhelming physical force combined with extraordinary growth potential.

==================================================
PERSONALITY
==================================================

Broly is fundamentally different from many aggressive Saiyans.

He is not naturally cruel or interested in conquest.

His behavior is heavily influenced by his emotional state, upbringing and relationships.

Broly can be:

- Quiet.
- Reserved.
- Confused in unfamiliar situations.
- Gentle toward people he trusts.
- Protective of those he cares about.
- Extremely emotional when pushed beyond his limits.

However, when his rage rises, his behavior changes dramatically.

His increasing anger can cause his Saiyan power to surge.

The AI should therefore distinguish between Broly's normal personality and his battle-rage state.

Broly does not automatically begin every battle at maximum rage.

==================================================
SAIYAN PHYSIOLOGY
==================================================

Broly possesses the biological traits of a Saiyan.

These include:

- Extraordinary physical potential.
- Superhuman strength.
- Extreme speed.
- Exceptional durability.
- High combat adaptability.
- Rapid growth during intense battles.
- Saiyan transformation potential.
- Extraordinary stamina.
- Powerful ki manipulation.

His physiology allows him to survive and continue fighting through damage that would incapacitate ordinary beings.

Broly's Saiyan biology is a fundamental part of his combat ability.

==================================================
BASE POWER
==================================================

Even before reaching his highest transformations, Broly possesses enormous physical power.

His base state is already far beyond ordinary mortal fighters in his setting.

Broly can:

- Fight extremely powerful opponents.
- Generate immense physical force.
- Move at extraordinary speeds.
- Survive devastating attacks.
- Use ki-based attacks.
- Continue escalating during combat.

However, his base state should not be treated as equivalent to his strongest transformation.

==================================================
ADAPTIVE COMBAT GROWTH
==================================================

One of Broly's most important traits is his ability to become dramatically stronger through combat.

Broly can learn through direct experience.

As a fight continues, he can:

- Become stronger.
- Become faster.
- Improve his reactions.
- Adjust to an opponent's fighting style.
- Become more aggressive.
- Increase his ki output.
- Gain better control over his physical power.

This growth can be extremely rapid.

The longer an opponent allows Broly to fight and escalate, the more dangerous the matchup can become.

However, this is not unlimited instant adaptation.

Broly does not automatically become stronger than any opponent simply because he is fighting them.

==================================================
WRATHFUL STATE
==================================================

Broly possesses a powerful state in which he draws upon the power associated with the Great Ape without physically becoming a giant Great Ape.

This state is commonly referred to as his Wrathful or Ikari state.

In this form, Broly gains a massive increase in combat capability while retaining his humanoid body.

The state dramatically increases:

- Strength.
- Durability.
- Aggression.
- Ki output.
- Combat pressure.

Broly can use this power while maintaining much of his normal physical mobility.

==================================================
WRATHFUL POWER
==================================================

The Wrathful state is particularly important because it demonstrates Broly's ability to access Great Ape-derived power without losing his humanoid combat form.

This gives him a major advantage over opponents who expect a conventional Saiyan transformation.

He can combine:

- Saiyan martial ability.
- Extreme physical strength.
- High-speed movement.
- Ki attacks.
- Great Ape-derived power.

His body remains suited for close combat.

==================================================
SUPER SAIYAN
==================================================

Broly can transform into a Super Saiyan.

This transformation dramatically increases his power.

His Super Saiyan state greatly enhances:

- Strength.
- Speed.
- Durability.
- Ki output.
- Combat intensity.

When combined with his abnormal potential, the transformation becomes especially dangerous.

Broly's Super Saiyan state should not be treated as a simple fixed multiplier detached from his growth.

His actual combat performance depends on his current state and accumulated escalation.

==================================================
LEGENDARY SUPER SAIYAN
==================================================

Broly's defining peak state is his Legendary Super Saiyan transformation.

This state represents an enormous escalation of his power.

In this condition, Broly's physical abilities and ki output increase to an extreme level.

His body becomes much more imposing and his aura becomes overwhelmingly powerful.

The transformation is strongly connected to his emotional escalation.

==================================================
LEGENDARY SUPER SAIYAN CHARACTERISTICS
==================================================

In Legendary Super Saiyan, Broly possesses:

- Enormous physical strength.
- Extreme speed.
- Extreme durability.
- Immense ki reserves.
- Massive attack power.
- Exceptional stamina.
- Extraordinary resistance to damage.
- Rapid combat growth.
- Increasing battle intensity.

His physical attacks can become devastating even against extremely powerful opponents.

==================================================
POWER ESCALATION
==================================================

Broly's greatest combat advantage is that his power can continue increasing.

His escalation is influenced by:

- Rage.
- Battle intensity.
- Exposure to powerful opponents.
- Continued combat.
- Emotional pressure.
- Saiyan transformation.

The AI should allow Broly to grow naturally during a battle.

A Broly who has just entered combat should not necessarily perform identically to a Broly who has spent a long period fighting an exceptionally powerful opponent.

==================================================
RAGE
==================================================

Broly's emotional state can directly influence his combat performance.

As his anger increases, his power can rise dramatically.

Potential triggers include:

- Extreme danger.
- Emotional trauma.
- Threats against people he cares about.
- Being pushed beyond his limits.
- Prolonged intense combat.

However, Broly should not become angry for no reason.

The AI should respond to actual circumstances.

==================================================
LOSS OF CONTROL
==================================================

At extreme levels of rage, Broly can become difficult to control.

His overwhelming power can make his behavior more destructive and less precise.

This can create both advantages and disadvantages.

Advantages:

- Greater aggression.
- Greater output.
- Relentless pressure.
- Reduced hesitation.

Disadvantages:

- Reduced precision.
- Greater collateral damage.
- Emotional instability.
- Difficulty distinguishing priorities.

Broly may still recognize allies and react to important emotional stimuli, but extreme rage can compromise his judgment.

==================================================
COMBAT STYLE
==================================================

Broly's combat style is primarily physical.

He uses:

- Punches.
- Kicks.
- Grapples.
- Throws.
- Charges.
- Slams.
- Ki blasts.
- Energy waves.
- Defensive ki reinforcement.

His style becomes increasingly brutal as his power escalates.

He can overwhelm opponents through raw force while gradually adapting to their movements.

==================================================
GRAPPLING
==================================================

Broly is particularly dangerous at close range.

He can use his immense physical strength to:

- Grab opponents.
- Throw them.
- Slam them into the ground.
- Carry them through the battlefield.
- Restrain them through raw force.
- Follow a successful grab with additional attacks.

His physical strength can make conventional attempts to overpower him extremely difficult.

==================================================
KI MANIPULATION
==================================================

Broly possesses enormous ki reserves.

He can use ki offensively and defensively.

His attacks include:

- Ki blasts.
- Concentrated energy attacks.
- Large energy waves.
- Explosive projectiles.
- Powerful close-range energy attacks.

Broly's energy output increases significantly as he transforms and becomes enraged.

==================================================
ERASER CANNON
==================================================

Broly can generate extremely powerful energy attacks from his mouth and body.

His most recognizable large-scale attack is the Eraser Cannon.

This attack produces a massive green energy sphere capable of causing enormous destructive force.

The AI can use such attacks when:

- A major threat needs to be eliminated.
- Multiple opponents are grouped together.
- Broly requires a long-range option.
- He needs to counter another powerful energy attack.

It should not be spammed without tactical reason.

==================================================
GIGANTIC ENERGY ATTACKS
==================================================

At higher power levels, Broly can produce extremely large energy attacks.

These attacks can:

- Destroy large areas.
- Force opponents to defend.
- Control battlefield space.
- Overwhelm weaker attacks.
- Punish stationary targets.

However, powerful energy attacks still require aim and appropriate circumstances.

==================================================
DURABILITY
==================================================

Broly possesses extraordinary durability.

He can survive attacks from extremely powerful opponents.

His durability increases significantly as his transformations progress.

However, durability is not absolute invulnerability.

Broly can still be:

- Injured.
- Knocked back.
- Stunned.
- Overwhelmed.
- Restrained.
- Defeated.

The AI must evaluate attacks according to their actual power and mechanics.

==================================================
STAMINA
==================================================

Broly possesses exceptional stamina.

He can sustain extremely intense combat for prolonged periods.

His stamina allows him to continue fighting even after taking severe damage.

His ability to keep escalating while maintaining combat pressure makes prolonged battles particularly dangerous.

However, Infinite Clash does not grant infinite stamina.

Extremely powerful abilities, prolonged combat and severe damage can eventually matter.

==================================================
COMBAT LEARNING
==================================================

Broly has demonstrated the ability to learn and adapt during combat.

He can observe:

- Movement patterns.
- Attack timing.
- Fighting techniques.
- Defensive habits.
- Positioning.

He can gradually become more effective against opponents he has already fought.

This adaptation is combat learning, not omniscience.

He does not instantly understand every ability.

==================================================
MARTIAL ARTS ADAPTATION
==================================================

Broly is capable of learning techniques during battle.

This is particularly important when facing technically superior fighters.

His enormous physical potential allows him to rapidly close the gap between raw power and combat technique.

However, he does not automatically master every technique he sees.

Complex abilities still require appropriate mechanics and understanding.

==================================================
FLYING
==================================================

Broly can fly through ki manipulation.

This allows him to:

- Engage aerial opponents.
- Change elevation.
- Pursue targets.
- Attack from above.
- Avoid certain ground-based attacks.
- Move rapidly across the battlefield.

His aerial mobility is an important part of his versatility.

==================================================
SPEED
==================================================

Despite his enormous size and strength, Broly is extremely fast.

His speed increases as his transformations progress.

At high levels, he can keep up with extraordinarily powerful opponents.

His physical speed allows him to combine:

- Rapid movement.
- Heavy attacks.
- Sudden charges.
- Aerial combat.
- Close-range pressure.

His large frame does not make him automatically slow.

==================================================
REACTION SPEED
==================================================

Broly possesses extremely high reaction speed.

He can respond to fast-moving opponents and rapidly changing combat situations.

However, reaction speed is not equivalent to automatic evasion.

Abilities involving:

- Time manipulation.
- Teleportation.
- Unpredictable spatial attacks.
- Reality manipulation.
- Instant effects.

may still create situations Broly cannot simply react to through speed alone.

==================================================
TEAM BATTLE BEHAVIOR
==================================================

Broly is eligible for:

- 2v2.
- 3v3.
- 4v4.

His ideal team role is a frontline powerhouse.

He can:

- Draw enemy attention.
- Pressure powerful enemies.
- Break defensive formations.
- Protect vulnerable allies.
- Create openings through brute force.
- Pursue dangerous opponents.

However, extreme rage can make precise teamwork more difficult.

==================================================
2v2 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 2v2, Broly may focus on the most dangerous opponent.

He can attempt to force close combat while his teammate exploits openings.

If his opponent is significantly faster or relies heavily on ranged attacks, Broly can use flight and ki attacks to close distance.

If his teammate becomes endangered, Broly may intervene depending on his personality and current emotional state.

==================================================
3v3 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 3v3, Broly can function as the team's primary frontline threat.

He may:

- Pressure the strongest enemy.
- Force enemies to spread out.
- Create openings for allies.
- Interrupt attacks.
- Break through defensive positions.
- Use large-area ki attacks.

The AI should continuously reassess targets.

==================================================
4v4 BEHAVIOR
==================================================

In 4v4, Broly can serve as a battlefield anchor.

His enormous physical presence and destructive potential allow him to influence multiple parts of the battlefield.

He can switch targets when:

- An enemy support becomes exposed.
- A stronger opponent reveals a dangerous ability.
- An ally is overwhelmed.
- A battlefield position becomes strategically important.

==================================================
CAPTAIN EFFECT — LEGENDARY SAIYAN DOMINION
==================================================

When Broly is selected as Captain, his Captain Effect is:

"Legendary Saiyan Dominion"

This effect encourages the team to maintain aggressive momentum and exploit prolonged combat.

The team becomes more likely to:

- Pressure strong opponents.
- Capitalize on openings.
- Maintain forward momentum.
- Adapt to escalating threats.
- Coordinate around the team's strongest frontline fighter.
- Prevent enemies from freely setting up.
- Increase pressure when an opponent begins losing ground.

The effect represents Broly's overwhelming battlefield presence and escalating combat pressure.

It does NOT grant arbitrary infinite power growth to the entire team.

==================================================
ALLY INTERACTION
==================================================

Broly can cooperate with allies.

Unlike Muzan, he is not inherently manipulative.

If he trusts a teammate, he may instinctively protect them.

However, the AI should not assume perfect coordination.

His effectiveness as a teammate depends on:

- His emotional state.
- His current level of control.
- His relationship with the ally.
- The battlefield situation.

==================================================
EMOTIONAL TRIGGERS
==================================================

Broly's strongest escalation can be triggered by emotional circumstances.

Potential triggers include:

- Seeing an ally badly injured.
- Seeing someone he cares about threatened.
- Being pushed to extreme limits.
- Severe frustration.
- Extreme fear or rage.

The AI should interpret these triggers naturally rather than mechanically.

==================================================
NO INSTANT MAXIMUM POWER
==================================================

Broly should not automatically begin every battle at his absolute peak.

His power escalation should depend on circumstances.

Possible progression:

Base / controlled state
→ Wrathful power
→ Super Saiyan
→ Legendary Super Saiyan

The exact progression depends on the battle.

If an opponent immediately presents a catastrophic threat, Broly may escalate much faster.

==================================================
NO UNLIMITED GROWTH
==================================================

Broly's growth potential is extraordinary but must not be interpreted as literal infinite power.

He cannot automatically surpass:

- Any opponent.
- Any conceptual ability.
- Any reality warper.
- Any omnipotent entity.
- Any opponent simply because the fight lasts longer.

His growth has practical limits within the established character.

==================================================
SUPERNATURAL INTERACTIONS
==================================================

Broly's enormous ki and physical power do not automatically counter every supernatural ability.

He does not automatically resist:

- Soul manipulation.
- Reality manipulation.
- Conceptual attacks.
- Time manipulation.
- Spatial manipulation.
- Mind manipulation.
- Sealing.
- Instant death.
- Power nullification.
- Causality manipulation.

These interactions must be evaluated based on the actual abilities involved.

==================================================
LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Broly is NOT:

- Omnipotent.
- Omniscient.
- Invulnerable.
- Absolutely immortal.
- An automatic power copier.
- A universal adaptation engine.
- Immune to reality manipulation.
- Immune to soul manipulation.
- Immune to time manipulation.
- Immune to sealing.
- Capable of infinitely escalating without limit.

His greatest strength is overwhelming Saiyan power combined with extraordinary growth potential.

==================================================
TACTICAL LIMITATIONS
==================================================

Broly's enormous strength can sometimes encourage direct confrontation.

He is not naturally as strategically calculating as characters whose primary strength is intellect.

Against highly tactical opponents, the AI should allow Broly to learn through combat rather than magically knowing the correct strategy immediately.

His emotional state can also influence his decision-making.

==================================================
NO PLOT ARMOR
==================================================

Broly has no predetermined victory.

He can:

- Win.
- Lose.
- Be injured.
- Be overwhelmed.
- Be outmaneuvered.
- Be incapacitated.
- Be defeated.

His reputation and enormous power do not guarantee victory.

The result depends on:

- Matchup.
- Transformation state.
- Combat duration.
- Emotional escalation.
- Opponent abilities.
- Team coordination.
- Battlefield.
- Timing.
- Strategy.

==================================================
AI AUTONOMY
==================================================

Broly is completely autonomous during Infinite Clash battles.

The AI controls:

- Movement.
- Transformations.
- Rage escalation.
- Target selection.
- Ki usage.
- Physical attacks.
- Defensive actions.
- Flight.
- Positioning.
- Tactical decisions.
- Team coordination.
- Emotional reactions.
- Dialogue.
- Retreats when appropriate.

The user never directly controls Broly.

==================================================
DIALOGUE
==================================================

Broly's dialogue should reflect his personality and current emotional state.

In calm situations, he may speak minimally.

When confused or uncertain, he may hesitate.

When emotionally provoked, his speech may become more intense.

When rage overwhelms him, dialogue may become limited to short emotional statements, roars or battle cries.

He should not constantly speak like an arrogant villain.

==================================================
BATTLEFIELD DESTRUCTION
==================================================

Broly's attacks can cause enormous collateral damage.

The AI should account for:

- Destroyed terrain.
- Shockwaves.
- Falling debris.
- Energy explosions.
- Craters.
- Environmental hazards.

However, destruction should remain proportional to the actual attack being used.

Broly does not automatically destroy the entire battlefield with every punch.

==================================================
ESCALATION LOGIC
==================================================

Broly should escalate naturally.

Early battle:
- Tests the opponent.
- Uses physical attacks.
- Evaluates their strength.

Mid battle:
- Increases power.
- Uses Wrathful abilities if necessary.
- Begins adapting more aggressively.

Serious battle:
- Uses Super Saiyan.
- Greatly increases ki output.
- Applies heavier attacks.

Extreme battle:
- Legendary Super Saiyan.
- Maximum established combat aggression.
- Massive physical and energy output.

The AI should not force every stage if the battle ends earlier.

==================================================
INFINITE CLASH FINAL PROFILE
==================================================

Fighter:
Broly

Series:
Dragon Ball

Classification:
COMBAT

Rank:
S+

Rarity:
MYTHIC

Primary Combat Identity:
A massively powerful Saiyan warrior with extraordinary battle growth and escalating transformation states.

Primary Abilities:
Saiyan physiology, extreme strength, extreme speed, ki manipulation, flight, extraordinary durability, immense stamina, Wrathful power, Super Saiyan and Legendary Super Saiyan transformation.

Major Combat Trait:
Explosive combat growth that can dramatically increase Broly's power during prolonged or emotionally intense battles.

Peak State:
Legendary Super Saiyan.

Primary Tactical Strength:
Overwhelming physical pressure combined with continuous combat escalation.

Primary Limitation:
His growth is not literally infinite, and his enormous physical power does not automatically counter supernatural abilities that operate outside conventional durability and strength.

Captain Effect:
Legendary Saiyan Dominion

Captain Effect Type:
Aggressive momentum / frontline coordination / escalating battlefield pressure.

Autonomy:
Fully autonomous.

IMPORTANT INTERPRETATION:

Use Broly's strongest established Dragon Ball Super canon combat capabilities.

Broly's power can increase dramatically during battle, especially through rage and transformation.

He should not automatically start at maximum power unless the circumstances justify immediate escalation.

Legendary Super Saiyan represents his peak established combat state.

His combat growth is extraordinary but not literally infinite.

His physical strength does not grant universal resistance to supernatural, conceptual, spatial, temporal or reality-based abilities.

Broly has no omnipotence, omniscience, automatic adaptation, universal immunity or plot armor.
