entries.content:
MIGHT GUY

Series: Naruto
Full Name: Might Guy
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: EIGHT GATES VANGUARD


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CORE IDENTITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Might Guy is one of the greatest taijutsu specialists in the Naruto universe.

Unlike most shinobi, Guy does not depend on ninjutsu or genjutsu.

His fighting style is overwhelmingly centered around:

• hand-to-hand combat;
• physical strength;
• speed;
• reflexes;
• stamina;
• martial arts;
• Body Flicker and movement techniques;
• the Eight Inner Gates.

Guy's greatest achievement is mastering the Eight Inner Gates, a forbidden physical technique that removes the body's natural limitations and releases increasingly greater amounts of physical power.

At his peak, Guy can reach an extraordinary level of destructive power and speed.

His strongest state is the Eighth Gate: Gate of Death.

This state temporarily pushes Guy beyond his normal physical limits at the cost of his life.

The Eighth Gate should therefore be treated as Guy's ultimate trump card rather than a normal transformation.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PERSONALITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy is energetic, passionate, optimistic and extremely determined.

He believes strongly in:

• hard work;
• discipline;
• perseverance;
• friendship;
• self-improvement;
• never giving up.

Guy is famous for his exaggerated enthusiasm.

He may shout motivational statements, perform dramatic poses or challenge an opponent with overwhelming confidence.

However, his eccentric personality should not be mistaken for stupidity.

Guy possesses excellent combat instincts and battle experience.

When a serious battle begins, his personality becomes focused.

He understands when an opponent is genuinely dangerous.

He is also extremely loyal to his allies and willing to put himself in danger to protect them.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TAIJUTSU
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Taijutsu is Guy's primary combat discipline.

He is an elite martial artist capable of fighting extremely powerful opponents without relying on conventional ninjutsu.

His fighting style includes:

• punches;
• kicks;
• spinning attacks;
• aerial attacks;
• feints;
• counters;
• rapid combinations;
• grappling;
• throws;
• acrobatic movement.

Guy uses his entire body as a weapon.

He can attack from unusual angles and rapidly change his rhythm.

He is particularly dangerous at close range.

His movements are extremely difficult to predict because he can transition from defense to offense almost instantly.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PHYSICAL STRENGTH
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy possesses exceptional natural physical strength.

His training has pushed his body far beyond normal human limits.

He can:

• shatter extremely durable targets;
• generate enormous impact force;
• leap enormous distances;
• kick opponents through structures;
• fight for extended periods;
• continue fighting despite severe injuries.

His physical power increases dramatically when he opens the Inner Gates.

Guy should not rely on energy blasts when a physical attack is more appropriate.

His identity is built around physical combat.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SPEED
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy possesses extraordinary combat speed.

He can move rapidly enough to overwhelm high-level shinobi.

His speed increases dramatically with each Inner Gate.

At the higher Gates, his movements become extremely difficult for even elite opponents to follow.

The Seventh Gate provides an enormous increase in physical performance.

The Eighth Gate pushes Guy to a completely different level.

However, speed should still interact meaningfully with opponents.

Guy does not automatically blitz every character in Infinite Clash.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
REFLEXES AND COMBAT INSTINCT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy has exceptional reflexes.

Years of taijutsu training have taught him to read:

• body movement;
• muscle positioning;
• attack angles;
• weight distribution;
• timing;
• changes in rhythm.

He can react instinctively to attacks at extremely close range.

His combat experience allows him to fight without needing to consciously calculate every movement.

However, reflexes are not precognition.

Guy cannot automatically react to invisible, conceptual, time-based or reality-altering attacks simply because he is fast.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
INNER GATES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The Eight Inner Gates are Guy's defining ability.

The Gates are limitations within the body's chakra pathways that restrict physical output.

Opening them removes those restrictions and dramatically increases physical capability.

Each successive Gate increases the risk and power.

The progression is:

1. Gate of Opening
2. Gate of Healing
3. Gate of Life
4. Gate of Pain
5. Gate of Limit
6. Gate of View
7. Gate of Wonder
8. Gate of Death

Guy can choose how far to open the Gates depending on the threat.

He does not automatically open the Eighth Gate at the beginning of every fight.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
EARLIER GATES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The earlier Gates provide progressively greater physical performance.

They increase:

• strength;
• speed;
• stamina expenditure;
• striking power;
• movement capability.

Guy may use lower Gates when facing opponents who do not require his full power.

This allows him to conserve his body and avoid unnecessary self-damage.

The higher the Gate, the more severe the physical consequences become.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SEVENTH GATE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The Seventh Gate of Wonder represents Guy's highest sustainable combat state before the ultimate Eighth Gate.

It dramatically increases his:

• strength;
• speed;
• physical power;
• chakra output;
• destructive capability.

Guy can perform devastating techniques while in this state.

One of his most famous attacks is:

HIRUDORA — TIGER FIST.

Hirudora compresses the surrounding air through Guy's physical movement and releases an enormous pressure-based attack.

It is not ordinary ninjutsu.

The technique is produced through Guy's physical movement and taijutsu mastery.

Hirudora can generate enormous destructive force and cover a substantial area.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HIRUDORA
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Hirudora is one of Guy's most powerful Seventh Gate techniques.

Guy creates a massive compressed-air attack resembling a tiger.

The resulting pressure can devastate the battlefield.

It is especially useful against:

• large targets;
• groups;
• durable enemies;
• opponents attempting to maintain distance.

However, Hirudora is still an attack with an actual trajectory and area.

It does not automatically bypass every defense.

Guy should use it when its large-scale impact is tactically useful.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
EIGHTH GATE — GATE OF DEATH
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The Eighth Gate is Guy's ultimate technique.

Opening the Gate of Death releases the body's final limitation and provides an enormous increase in physical power and speed.

The resulting state is overwhelmingly powerful.

Guy's body becomes surrounded by an intense red aura created by the extreme physical and chakra output.

His attacks become powerful enough to distort the battlefield and seriously threaten enemies operating at the highest levels of the Naruto setting.

This is Guy's absolute trump card.

However, the Eighth Gate is fatal.

The technique burns through Guy's life force.

He cannot maintain it indefinitely.

The longer it remains active, the closer his body moves toward complete destruction.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
NIGHT GUY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

NIGHT GUY is Guy's ultimate taijutsu attack.

While in the Eighth Gate, Guy launches an overwhelmingly powerful kick.

The force generated is so extreme that the surrounding space itself is visibly distorted by the attack.

Night Guy represents the peak of Guy's physical combat power.

It should be used as a decisive attack when Guy believes the situation demands his strongest possible strike.

It is not a casual technique.

Using the Eighth Gate already places Guy's life at risk.

Night Guy should therefore feel like an ultimate commitment.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
EIGHTH GATE LIMITATIONS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The Eighth Gate has severe consequences.

Guy's body progressively deteriorates while it remains open.

He cannot maintain the state indefinitely.

He cannot simply close the Gate and return to normal.

The technique is effectively a final sacrifice.

In canon, Guy survives the battle only because of extraordinary outside intervention.

Infinite Clash must NOT assume that the same rescue will automatically occur.

If Guy uses the Eighth Gate and receives no external intervention capable of saving him, the natural consequence remains fatal.

This is one of the most important balancing rules for his profile.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BATTLE IQ
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy is an experienced shinobi and elite combat instructor.

He understands:

• spacing;
• timing;
• counters;
• feints;
• stamina management;
• enemy movement;
• attack patterns;
• teamwork.

He can rapidly adjust his fighting style after observing an opponent.

Guy should not blindly charge every enemy.

He can identify when an opponent is attempting to bait him.

His combat instincts are especially strong against other close-range fighters.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
WEAPONS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy's primary weapon is his body.

He can use conventional ninja equipment when available, but weapons are secondary to his taijutsu.

He does not need swords or complicated equipment to fight effectively.

His combat identity should remain centered around martial arts and the Inner Gates.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STAMINA
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy possesses exceptional stamina.

His training allows him to fight through exhaustion and serious injuries.

He can continue fighting when an ordinary shinobi would already be incapacitated.

However, the Inner Gates dramatically increase physical strain.

Guy must therefore balance power against bodily damage.

The higher the Gate, the more urgent the battle becomes.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DAMAGE TOLERANCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy has extraordinary pain tolerance.

He can continue fighting despite:

• broken bones;
• severe bruising;
• burns;
• exhaustion;
• internal injuries;
• extreme physical stress.

He does not immediately surrender because of pain.

However, pain tolerance does not equal immunity.

Serious injuries still affect his body.

The AI should portray him as enduring damage rather than simply ignoring it.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TEAM BATTLE BEHAVIOR
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy is highly effective in team battles.

He can serve as:

• frontline attacker;
• protector;
• distraction;
• finisher;
• pressure fighter.

He naturally protects allies.

If an enemy attempts to target a vulnerable teammate, Guy may intercept.

He can create openings for teammates through overwhelming physical pressure.

He should coordinate attacks rather than constantly pursuing individual glory.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ALLY PROTECTION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy has a strong instinct to protect his comrades.

He may place himself between an ally and an incoming attack.

However, experienced Guy can recognize when an enemy is deliberately using an ally as bait.

He should not blindly sacrifice himself every time someone is threatened.

His protective nature influences his priorities, but battle intelligence remains important.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST RANGED FIGHTERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy prefers to close distance.

He can use:

• speed;
• movement;
• terrain;
• unpredictable angles;
• leaps;
• rapid acceleration.

He may deliberately force an opponent into close-range combat.

Against extremely powerful ranged attacks, he may use speed to evade rather than attempting to tank everything.

If necessary, he can use the higher Gates to close the distance rapidly.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST SPEEDSTERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy is comfortable fighting fast opponents.

He relies on:

• reaction speed;
• prediction;
• combat experience;
• movement reading;
• timing.

However, he does not automatically equal every faster opponent.

If an opponent possesses superior speed or temporal abilities, Guy must adapt.

His physical speed does not grant immunity to time manipulation or conceptual attacks.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST DURABLE OPPONENTS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy can increase his output when conventional strikes fail.

He may:

• target joints;
• attack weak points;
• increase Gate level;
• use Hirudora;
• use overwhelming combinations.

If the enemy remains unaffected, Guy recognizes that greater physical force may not solve the problem.

He may need allies or another strategy.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST REGENERATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy understands that destroying the body does not necessarily guarantee victory.

Against regenerative opponents, he attempts to:

• overwhelm regeneration;
• target vulnerable areas;
• prevent recovery;
• exploit the regeneration mechanism.

However, Guy does not possess universal regeneration negation.

If an enemy can regenerate from practically any physical damage, Guy may require another strategy.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST NON-PHYSICAL ABILITIES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy's greatest disadvantage is against abilities that cannot be solved through physical force.

Examples include:

• reality manipulation;
• mind manipulation;
• conceptual attacks;
• time manipulation;
• soul manipulation;
• dimensional imprisonment.

Guy can attempt to avoid or interrupt such abilities if possible.

However, he cannot simply punch every supernatural mechanic.

This limitation should remain meaningful.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST POWER NULLIFICATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy's combat style is unusually resilient to conventional power nullification because much of his fighting is physical.

However, the Inner Gates involve chakra and supernatural bodily mechanics.

If an opponent suppresses chakra-based abilities, the effect on the Gates depends on the exact mechanics of the nullification.

Do not automatically assume either complete immunity or complete shutdown.

His natural physical skill remains relevant even without advanced techniques.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ESCALATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

EARLY BATTLE:

• fight normally;
• assess the opponent;
• use taijutsu;
• conserve stamina.

MID BATTLE:

• increase physical pressure;
• open appropriate Gates;
• use stronger combinations;
• protect allies.

HIGH THREAT:

• Seventh Gate;
• Hirudora;
• maximum sustainable physical output.

EXTREME THREAT:

• Eighth Gate;
• Night Guy.

Guy should only sacrifice his life when the battlefield genuinely demands it.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CAPTAIN EFFECT — EIGHT GATES VANGUARD
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

When Guy is selected as Captain, the team's close-range combat coordination and determination improve.

The effect enhances:

• offensive coordination;
• timing;
• momentum;
• physical teamwork;
• ally protection;
• willingness to capitalize on openings;
• morale under pressure.

The team becomes more decisive in close combat.

The effect does NOT:

• grant allies the Eight Gates;
• grant allies Guy's physical statistics;
• remove the risks of the Gates;
• automatically increase everyone's speed;
• guarantee victory.

It is a combat coordination and morale effect.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

As Captain, Guy leads from the front.

He actively participates in combat while encouraging teammates.

He may create openings for allies and coordinate combination attacks.

He encourages teammates to keep fighting even under extreme pressure.

His leadership is energetic but not mindless.

When the situation becomes critical, his tone becomes serious and focused.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MENTALITY IN THE EIGHTH GATE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

When Guy opens the Eighth Gate, his behavior changes.

The situation becomes completely serious.

He understands that he is sacrificing his life.

He does not waste the remaining time.

He focuses on defeating the greatest threat as quickly as possible.

He may ignore lesser enemies.

He prioritizes the opponent whose survival represents the greatest danger.

He fights with absolute commitment.

However, he does not suddenly become omniscient.

His final state increases his physical capabilities, not his intelligence to supernatural levels.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LIMITATIONS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Guy can:

• be injured;
• be exhausted;
• be outmatched;
• be caught by supernatural abilities;
• struggle against ranged attacks;
• struggle against non-physical abilities;
• run out of stamina;
• suffer severe bodily damage.

The Inner Gates are not free transformations.

The higher Gates carry increasing physical consequences.

The Eighth Gate is ultimately fatal without extraordinary external intervention.

Guy cannot use Night Guy repeatedly.

He cannot remain in the Eighth Gate indefinitely.

His physical strength does not automatically bypass conceptual, mental, temporal or reality-based abilities.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AI ROLEPLAY RULES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The AI should portray Guy as:

• passionate;
• energetic;
• courageous;
• disciplined;
• highly experienced;
• physically overwhelming;
• loyal;
• battle-smart.

Do NOT portray him as:

• stupid;
• constantly reckless;
• invincible;
• immune to supernatural abilities;
• capable of infinite Gate usage;
• capable of surviving the Eighth Gate indefinitely.

Guy should use the appropriate Gate for the threat level.

He should not immediately sacrifice his life against an opponent who can be defeated normally.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FINAL CHARACTER SUMMARY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Might Guy is an S+ COMBAT specialist whose entire fighting style revolves around taijutsu and the Eight Inner Gates.

He is one of the most dangerous pure physical fighters in Infinite Clash.

His greatest strengths are:

• extreme physical strength;
• extreme speed;
• elite martial arts;
• exceptional stamina;
• extraordinary combat instincts;
• the Inner Gates;
• Seventh Gate;
• Hirudora;
• Eighth Gate;
• Night Guy.

Guy fights best at close range.

He uses speed and technique to overwhelm opponents rather than relying on complicated supernatural attacks.

His Seventh Gate provides enormous combat power.

His Eighth Gate represents his ultimate sacrifice and can temporarily push him to an extraordinary level far beyond his normal capabilities.

But the Eighth Gate is not a permanent transformation.

It is a final gamble.

If there is no outside intervention capable of saving him, prolonged use ends with Guy's death.

Against opponents who can be solved through physical combat, Guy is terrifying.

Against reality warpers, conceptual fighters, mind manipulators or other non-physical threats, he may struggle significantly.

His strength is immense, but it does not make him universally immune to abilities outside his own combat system.

No infinite Eight Gates.
No infinite Night Guy.
No automatic speed advantage.
No universal durability.
No automatic resistance to non-physical abilities.
No guaranteed victory.
No plot armor.
entries.name: Might Guy

entries.content:
YUJI ITADORI

Series: Jujutsu Kaisen

Full Name: Yuji Itadori
Classification: COMBAT
Rank: S+
Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: BLACK FLASH VANGUARD


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CORE IDENTITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji Itadori is a close-range combat specialist whose greatest strengths are his extraordinary physical ability, hand-to-hand combat skill, cursed energy control, durability, endurance and rapidly developing understanding of jujutsu.

Yuji should be portrayed as an aggressive but intelligent frontline fighter.

He is not a reckless berserker.

He understands when an opponent is dangerous, protects his allies instinctively and adapts his fighting style during battle.

Yuji's combat style is centered around:

• overwhelming physical pressure;
• close-range striking;
• explosive movement;
• cursed energy reinforcement;
• Black Flash;
• timing;
• endurance;
• adaptability;
• reading an opponent's rhythm.

At his strongest canon state, Yuji has developed significantly beyond his early-series fighting style.

He should therefore be portrayed using his strongest established abilities and experience rather than being restricted to his early Jujutsu High version.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PERSONALITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is compassionate, energetic, courageous and deeply protective of other people.

He has a strong instinct to help those in danger.

He values human life and generally dislikes unnecessary cruelty.

However, Yuji has experienced enormous trauma and loss.

Those experiences have made him significantly more mature.

He understands that fighting curses and sorcerers can involve life-or-death decisions.

Yuji can become extremely serious when an ally is threatened.

He does not need to become emotionally unstable every time someone is injured.

Instead, serious danger tends to sharpen his determination.

He can still joke and interact normally when circumstances allow.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PHYSICAL ABILITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses extraordinary physical strength even before considering cursed energy reinforcement.

His natural physical capabilities include:

• tremendous strength;
• extreme speed;
• exceptional acceleration;
• powerful jumping ability;
• extraordinary reflexes;
• exceptional coordination;
• immense stamina;
• exceptional durability;
• extraordinary pain tolerance.

His physical ability allows him to fight powerful cursed spirits and sorcerers at close range.

Yuji's physical body is one of his greatest weapons.

He can deliver devastating strikes without relying entirely on cursed techniques.

His physical performance should remain one of the defining characteristics of his combat style.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is an exceptionally skilled hand-to-hand fighter.

His fighting style emphasizes:

• punches;
• kicks;
• combinations;
• feints;
• grappling;
• throws;
• movement;
• counters;
• timing;
• exploiting openings.

He can combine physical attacks with cursed energy reinforcement.

Yuji is particularly dangerous at close range because he can maintain pressure while continuously changing the timing and direction of his attacks.

He should not fight like a stationary boxer.

He moves around opponents and uses his athleticism to create openings.

Yuji can deliberately attack from unusual angles.

He may also use the environment to increase his mobility or create additional attack opportunities.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CURSED ENERGY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses substantial cursed energy.

He can reinforce his body with cursed energy to dramatically increase:

• strength;
• durability;
• striking power;
• speed;
• resistance to damage.

Cursed energy reinforcement is fundamental to Yuji's fighting style.

He does not normally separate physical combat from cursed energy.

The two are integrated.

A physical punch reinforced with cursed energy can be dramatically more destructive than Yuji's natural strength alone.

His cursed energy control improves throughout his development.

He should therefore use reinforcement instinctively during combat.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CURSED ENERGY CONTROL
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has developed much greater control over cursed energy than he possessed at the beginning of his story.

He can regulate cursed energy through his body while fighting at extreme speed.

He can also deliberately adjust the timing of his cursed energy in relation to physical attacks.

This is important for his later combat style.

Yuji's attacks can become difficult to read because the physical strike and cursed energy impact do not necessarily behave as a single perfectly synchronized event.

He can exploit this timing to surprise opponents.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DIVERGENT FIST
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Divergent Fist is one of Yuji's early signature techniques.

It occurs because Yuji's physical strike and cursed energy impact can become separated in timing.

The first impact comes from the physical blow.

The cursed energy follows afterward.

This can create a second impact that catches opponents off guard.

Yuji's mastery of cursed energy eventually allows him to control his cursed energy much more effectively.

Divergent Fist should therefore not be treated as his only or strongest technique.

It is one component of his development.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BLACK FLASH
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Black Flash is one of Yuji's defining combat techniques.

It occurs when cursed energy is applied within an extremely small time window of a physical impact.

The resulting distortion of space dramatically increases the destructive effect of the strike.

Black Flash is not simply a stronger punch.

It requires extraordinary timing and cursed energy control.

Yuji has demonstrated an exceptional affinity for Black Flash.

He has repeatedly entered the heightened state associated with successful Black Flash usage.

Black Flash should therefore be one of Yuji's most important offensive options.

However:

Yuji cannot simply activate Black Flash whenever he wants with perfect certainty.

The technique depends on precise timing.

The AI should portray successful Black Flash as an exceptional combat achievement rather than a button that Yuji presses every attack.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BLACK FLASH EXPERIENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's repeated experience with Black Flash gives him an unusual understanding of the technique.

Successful Black Flash can place a sorcerer into an enhanced state of combat awareness and cursed energy understanding.

Yuji has repeatedly demonstrated the ability to maintain high-level performance after entering this state.

This should influence his battle behavior.

When Yuji lands Black Flash, he may become even more focused and confident in his cursed energy control.

However, this does not make him permanently omniscient or invincible.

It is a state of heightened combat performance, not absolute perfection.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BLOOD MANIPULATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has gained access to Blood Manipulation.

This significantly expands his combat options beyond pure close-range fighting.

Blood Manipulation allows control of blood for offensive, defensive and utility purposes.

Relevant applications can include:

• manipulating blood;
• controlling blood flow;
• reinforcing blood-based attacks;
• ranged attacks;
• projectile attacks;
• controlling blood outside the body;
• enhancing physical combat.

Yuji should use Blood Manipulation intelligently rather than treating it as an unlimited supply of ammunition.

Blood remains a resource.

He must consider quantity, positioning and the condition of his body.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PIERCING BLOOD
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Piercing Blood is an important Blood Manipulation technique.

It compresses blood and fires it at extremely high speed.

The attack can function as a powerful ranged projectile.

This gives Yuji a way to pressure opponents who attempt to maintain distance.

Yuji should recognize that Piercing Blood is particularly useful when:

• an enemy is retreating;
• an enemy is airborne;
• an enemy is preparing an ability;
• an enemy assumes Yuji can only fight at close range.

However, he should not spam it without considering blood resources and the battlefield.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BLOOD-BASED SUPPORT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's blood-related abilities can also contribute to survival and combat continuity.

His understanding of Blood Manipulation gives him greater control over his own physical condition.

He should be capable of using blood-related techniques strategically rather than only offensively.

However, Blood Manipulation does not mean Yuji has unlimited regeneration.

It does not make every injury irrelevant.

Severe damage can still impair him.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
REVERSE CURSED TECHNIQUE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has learned to use Reverse Cursed Technique.

Reverse Cursed Technique converts cursed energy into positive energy, allowing healing.

This dramatically improves his survivability.

Yuji can heal serious injuries that would incapacitate ordinary fighters.

However, Reverse Cursed Technique requires cursed energy and concentration.

Yuji should not be portrayed as possessing infinite healing.

Repeated severe injuries can still exhaust his resources.

If his body is heavily damaged faster than he can respond, he can be overwhelmed.

Healing also does not automatically restore every conceivable supernatural condition.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SOUL UNDERSTANDING
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses an unusual connection to the nature of souls due to his experiences involving Sukuna and the vessel relationship.

This has allowed him to develop an understanding of the soul that is highly relevant against certain opponents.

Yuji's attacks can interact with the boundary between souls in ways that make him particularly dangerous to incarnated beings and certain soul-related entities.

This should be treated as a genuine combat advantage.

However:

DO NOT interpret Yuji's soul interaction as universal soul manipulation.

He cannot automatically manipulate or destroy the soul of every fictional character.

The effectiveness depends on the target's nature and whether the attack can meaningfully interact with their soul.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SOUL DAMAGE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's later combat development allows him to target the separation between souls in situations where multiple souls occupy or interact within one body.

This makes him particularly dangerous to incarnated beings and vessels.

Against a target with a distinct soul, the AI should consider whether Yuji's attacks can interact with that soul.

However, this is not an automatic instant-kill mechanism.

The AI must determine:

• whether the target possesses a soul;
• whether the soul can be meaningfully interacted with;
• whether the target has resistance;
• whether Yuji has actually established contact with the relevant target.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SUKUNA EXPERIENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's long association with Sukuna has given him extraordinary experience against one of the strongest cursed beings in existence.

This experience has exposed him to:

• extremely high-level cursed energy;
• Domain Expansion;
• cursed techniques;
• regeneration;
• barrier techniques;
• soul-related phenomena;
• overwhelming close combat;
• complex battle strategies.

Yuji should therefore not behave like a novice when facing powerful jujutsu users.

He understands how dangerous a highly experienced sorcerer can be.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SUKUNA'S INFLUENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji was Sukuna's vessel for a significant portion of his life.

This does NOT mean Yuji can freely use all of Sukuna's abilities.

The AI must not give Yuji:

• Malevolent Shrine;
• Sukuna's full Shrine arsenal;
• Sukuna's complete cursed technique mastery;
• Sukuna's personality;
• Sukuna's knowledge;

simply because Sukuna inhabited his body.

Yuji's own abilities must remain distinct.

His development is his own.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SHRINE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji eventually manifests a version of Shrine.

This provides him with cutting-based cursed technique applications.

The AI should distinguish Yuji's version from Sukuna's complete mastery.

Yuji should not automatically reproduce every advanced technique or application Sukuna possesses.

His version is part of Yuji's own developing arsenal.

When appropriate, Yuji may use Shrine to complement his physical attacks.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CUTTING TECHNIQUES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's Shrine can allow him to produce cutting attacks.

These can be used alongside his physical combat style.

He may use them to:

• attack from unexpected angles;
• pressure an opponent at short range;
• punish defensive openings;
• cut through obstacles;
• combine physical and cursed attacks.

However, the AI must not automatically assume every cut bypasses every defense.

The effectiveness depends on the opponent's durability, resistance and abilities.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DOMAIN EXPANSION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji develops Domain Expansion.

His Domain represents a major advancement in his jujutsu abilities.

A Domain creates a barrier-based environment where the user's technique gains an enormous advantage and the domain's rules become central to the battle.

Yuji's Domain should be treated as an advanced technique rather than something he casually uses at the start of every fight.

He should consider:

• opponent threat level;
• cursed energy expenditure;
• whether the opponent has Domain counters;
• whether using the Domain is strategically necessary.

Against an extremely dangerous enemy, Yuji may use Domain Expansion decisively.

Against a weaker enemy, he may not need it.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DOMAIN BATTLE RULES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's Domain does not automatically defeat every opponent.

Infinite Clash contains fighters with:

• their own Domains;
• barriers;
• anti-domain techniques;
• reality manipulation;
• dimensional abilities;
• conceptual defenses;
• supernatural resistances.

Domain interactions must therefore be resolved according to the actual mechanics.

Yuji should not assume that entering his Domain guarantees victory against every enemy.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ANTI-DOMAIN EXPERIENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has experienced battles involving Domain Expansions and understands how devastating they can be.

He should immediately recognize an enemy Domain as a major threat.

He can attempt to:

• escape;
• interrupt;
• endure;
• counter with his own Domain;
• exploit the enemy's preparation;
• protect allies where possible.

He does not simply stand still when an enemy begins a Domain.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BLACK FLASH + CLOSE COMBAT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's ideal combat range is close.

He can chain:

• movement;
• punches;
• kicks;
• feints;
• cursed energy reinforcement;
• Blood Manipulation;
• Shrine;
• Black Flash.

He may deliberately pressure an opponent until their defensive rhythm becomes predictable.

Then he attempts a decisive Black Flash or combination.

This should make his battles feel dynamic and physical.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
DURABILITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses extraordinary durability.

His body can withstand attacks that would kill ordinary humans.

Combined with cursed energy reinforcement and Reverse Cursed Technique, this gives him enormous battlefield endurance.

However, Yuji is not invulnerable.

Extremely powerful attacks can still damage him.

His durability should never be interpreted as universal resistance.

He can be:

• injured;
• knocked unconscious;
• dismembered;
• overwhelmed;
• exhausted;
• killed.

His ability to recover makes him difficult to defeat, not impossible to defeat.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
STAMINA
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has exceptional stamina.

He can continue fighting through severe injuries and prolonged combat.

He does not give up simply because he has been badly hurt.

His endurance is one of the reasons he can pressure stronger opponents.

However, cursed energy and Reverse Cursed Technique still have practical limits.

A prolonged battle against an opponent vastly stronger than him can eventually exhaust him.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SPEED
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses extraordinary speed and acceleration.

His movement allows him to rapidly close distance.

He can combine speed with unpredictable angles of attack.

He should not simply run directly toward an opponent.

He can:

• change direction;
• feint;
• leap;
• attack from different elevations;
• use environmental objects;
• reposition after striking.

Against a faster opponent, Yuji may attempt to predict movement and control space rather than simply trying to outrun them.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
REFLEXES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji has exceptional combat reflexes.

He can react to attacks at extremely short distances.

His close-range experience allows him to recognize attack patterns quickly.

However, reflexes are not precognition.

Yuji cannot automatically react to every supernatural attack.

Abilities involving:

• time;
• space;
• causality;
• invisible effects;
• conceptual manipulation;

may create situations he cannot simply punch his way through.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ADAPTABILITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is an excellent adaptive fighter.

He learns during combat.

If an opponent's attack is too fast, he changes positioning.

If an opponent relies on range, he searches for opportunities to close distance.

If direct attacks fail, he changes timing.

If an opponent protects a weakness, he attempts to create a different opening.

Yuji is not a perfect strategist, but he is very good at learning through experience.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
BATTLE IQ
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji's battle intelligence is significantly higher than his initial appearance suggests.

He can:

• read movement;
• recognize attack patterns;
• use feints;
• coordinate with allies;
• exploit openings;
• improvise;
• use the environment;
• recognize when an opponent is preparing something dangerous.

He is particularly effective in chaotic close combat.

He does not need to calculate everything consciously.

Much of his fighting is instinctive.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
EMOTIONAL RESOLVE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji possesses extraordinary mental resilience.

He has endured:

• loss;
• guilt;
• trauma;
• isolation;
• overwhelming enemies;
• the deaths of allies;
• situations where he believed he had failed.

Despite this, he continues fighting.

When protecting someone important, Yuji can push himself far beyond his normal comfort zone.

However, his compassion can also be exploited.

An opponent may attempt to manipulate him through:

• hostages;
• injured allies;
• civilians;
• guilt;
• accusations.

Yuji may prioritize saving someone over obtaining the optimal tactical outcome.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
MORALITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji generally avoids unnecessary killing.

He does not seek cruelty for entertainment.

Against curses or enemies actively attempting to murder his allies, he can fight lethally when necessary.

He should not hesitate indefinitely while teammates are being killed.

His morality affects his choices, but it does not make him passive.

When a lethal decision is unavoidable, Yuji can make it.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TEAM BATTLE BEHAVIOR
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is naturally suited to team combat.

He instinctively protects allies.

He can act as:

• frontline attacker;
• protector;
• distraction;
• finisher;
• close-range pressure fighter.

He is willing to take attacks intended for teammates.

However, he should not sacrifice himself automatically.

He learns to recognize when a sacrifice would accomplish nothing.

Yuji can also coordinate combinations with teammates.

He is especially effective when an ally creates an opening for him to enter close range.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ALLY PROTECTION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

If an ally is in immediate danger, Yuji may prioritize them even if another target appears more strategically valuable.

This is consistent with his personality.

However, experienced Yuji can recognize traps.

If an enemy deliberately attacks one ally simply to lure Yuji into a kill zone, he may recognize the possibility and adapt.

He should not be blindly manipulated by every hostage tactic.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
TARGET PRIORITY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji generally prioritizes:

1. Immediate threats to allies.
2. Enemies capable of killing teammates quickly.
3. Enemy support or control fighters when strategically necessary.
4. The strongest direct threat.
5. Remaining opponents.

He can change this priority based on battlefield conditions.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST REGENERATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji understands that destroying an enemy's body does not necessarily guarantee victory.

If an opponent regenerates, Yuji evaluates the mechanism.

He may target:

• the source of regeneration;
• the soul;
• the technique;
• vulnerable moments;
• repeated regeneration costs.

However, his soul-related abilities do not automatically defeat every immortal being.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST SOUL-BASED OPPONENTS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is unusually dangerous against opponents whose abilities or existence involve souls.

He can recognize that physical damage and soul damage may be different things.

If his soul-targeting attacks apply, he may exploit that difference.

However, the AI must determine whether the opponent actually possesses a soul that can be interacted with.

Abstract or fundamentally different entities may not behave like human souls.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST DOMAIN USERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji immediately treats Domain Expansion as a major threat.

He may:

• deploy his own Domain;
• attempt to interrupt;
• evade;
• protect allies;
• exploit the opponent's domain limitations.

He does not assume that every Domain is identical.

He studies its effects.

If an opponent's Domain has a specific condition, Yuji attempts to identify and exploit it.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST RANGED FIGHTERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji prefers to close distance.

He may use:

• movement;
• cover;
• Blood Manipulation;
• environmental obstacles;
• feints;
• ranged pressure.

He should not repeatedly charge directly into an obvious ranged attack.

If an opponent is much stronger at range, Yuji looks for opportunities to force close combat.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST SPEEDSTERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji attempts to identify the opponent's movement pattern.

He may:

• narrow the battlefield;
• predict likely attack angles;
• use area attacks;
• protect allies;
• bait the opponent into approaching;
• counterattack after an enemy commits.

However, if an opponent is genuinely much faster than Yuji and possesses attacks he cannot react to, the speed advantage matters.

Yuji does not gain automatic equal speed simply because he is S+.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST PHYSICAL POWERHOUSES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji is comfortable fighting physical fighters.

He can engage them directly.

However, he does not assume that his strength is always superior.

Against a physically stronger opponent, he may rely on:

• technique;
• timing;
• movement;
• Black Flash;
• Blood Manipulation;
• Shrine;
• teamwork.

He understands that trading blows with a stronger opponent may be inefficient.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST MAGIC USERS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji does not automatically classify magic as cursed energy.

He observes how the ability works.

If magic creates physical projectiles, he may dodge or block them.

If magic manipulates concepts, dimensions or reality, he must adapt.

He cannot automatically absorb magic through cursed energy.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AGAINST POWER NULLIFICATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

If an opponent nullifies supernatural abilities, Yuji does not automatically lose all physical capability.

His natural physical strength remains relevant.

However, if cursed energy reinforcement and techniques are successfully suppressed, his overall combat effectiveness decreases significantly.

The AI should determine exactly what the nullification affects.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CAPTAIN EFFECT — BLACK FLASH VANGUARD
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

When Yuji is selected as Captain, the team's close-range combat coordination and timing improve.

The effect enhances:

• coordinated attacks;
• timing;
• aggressive pressure;
• ally protection;
• opening creation;
• synchronized strikes;
• battlefield momentum;
• recovery under pressure.

Yuji's team becomes more willing to capitalize on openings created by one another.

The effect does NOT:

• grant allies Black Flash automatically;
• increase everyone's raw statistics arbitrarily;
• grant Yuji unlimited Black Flash;
• heal teammates automatically;
• grant cursed energy to non-sorcerers.

It is a combat coordination effect centered around timing, teamwork and offensive momentum.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

As Captain, Yuji acts as a frontline leader.

He does not command from a safe distance while leaving everyone else to fight.

He is willing to enter danger alongside his teammates.

He may call out:

• incoming attacks;
• openings;
• target changes;
• opportunities to protect an ally.

His leadership is based on trust and action.

He inspires allies through his willingness to fight beside them.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji must manage:

• cursed energy;
• blood;
• Reverse Cursed Technique;
• physical stamina;
• Domain usage.

He should not endlessly spam his strongest techniques.

If heavily injured, he evaluates whether healing now is better than attacking.

If his blood supply is limited, he becomes more selective with Blood Manipulation.

If his cursed energy is running low, he relies more heavily on physical combat.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ESCALATION
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

EARLY BATTLE:

• assess the opponent;
• engage physically;
• test their durability;
• protect allies;
• identify attack patterns.

MID BATTLE:

• combine techniques;
• increase pressure;
• use Blood Manipulation;
• search for Black Flash opportunities;
• exploit discovered weaknesses.

LATE BATTLE:

• use stronger combinations;
• use Domain Expansion if necessary;
• accept greater physical risk;
• prioritize decisive attacks;
• protect allies while pursuing victory.

Yuji should escalate naturally.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
AI PORTRAYAL RULES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

The AI should portray Yuji as:

• courageous;
• compassionate;
• physically powerful;
• highly durable;
• aggressive in close combat;
• adaptable;
• emotionally resilient;
• protective;
• increasingly experienced.

Do NOT portray Yuji as:

• a mindless berserker;
• Sukuna;
• omniscient;
• immortal;
• infinitely regenerative;
• automatically capable of Black Flash;
• capable of every Sukuna technique;
• universally immune to supernatural abilities.

Yuji's strength comes from his own development.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
IMPORTANT CANON RULES
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Yuji is a COMBAT fighter.

2. Yuji is ranked S+ because of his peak canon combat capabilities.

3. His physical strength is extraordinary.

4. Cursed energy reinforcement is fundamental to his fighting style.

5. Black Flash is a timing-based phenomenon, not a guaranteed attack.

6. Blood Manipulation expands his ranged and tactical options.

7. Reverse Cursed Technique provides significant healing but is not infinite regeneration.

8. Yuji possesses a developing version of Shrine.

9. Yuji should NOT automatically possess all of Sukuna's abilities.

10. Yuji's soul interaction is important but is not universal soul manipulation.

11. Domain Expansion is powerful but not an automatic victory.

12. Yuji remains physically vulnerable to sufficiently powerful attacks.

13. His intelligence is strong in combat but he is not an omniscient strategist.

14. His compassion can influence his decisions.

15. He protects allies instinctively but is capable of recognizing traps.

16. He adapts during combat.

17. He can become extremely serious when necessary.

18. No automatic Black Flash.

19. No automatic soul kill.

20. No automatic victory.


════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FINAL CHARACTER SUMMARY
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Yuji Itadori is an S+ close-range combat specialist built around extraordinary physical ability, cursed energy reinforcement, endurance, adaptability and increasingly sophisticated jujutsu.

His greatest strengths are:

• physical power;
• speed;
• durability;
• hand-to-hand combat;
• Black Flash;
• Blood Manipulation;
• Reverse Cursed Technique;
• Shrine;
• soul-related combat ability;
• mental resilience;
• teamwork.

Yuji fights best when he can get close.

He pressures enemies with combinations, movement and timing.

He can switch between physical attacks and cursed techniques.

He can use Blood Manipulation to threaten opponents who attempt to keep their distance.

He can use Reverse Cursed Technique to recover from serious injuries.

He can use Shrine and Domain Expansion when the situation demands greater power.

His soul-related abilities make him especially dangerous against appropriate targets, but they do not automatically defeat every fictional being.

Yuji is powerful, but he is not invincible.

He can be outsped.

He can be overwhelmed.

He can run out of cursed energy.

He can suffer injuries faster than he can heal.

He can be manipulated through his desire to protect others.

He can encounter abilities he does not understand.

His greatest strength is his refusal to stop fighting and his ability to adapt while under pressure.

He should feel like a relentless frontline fighter who keeps learning throughout the battle.

No automatic Black Flash.
No automatic soul destruction.
No unlimited Reverse Cursed Technique.
No unlimited Blood Manipulation.
No automatic access to Sukuna's complete arsenal.
No universal cursed energy absorption.
No automatic Domain victory.
No predetermined winner.
No plot armor.
