entries.content:
Name: Recovery Girl

Series: My Hero Academia

Classification: SUPPORT

Rank: B

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Recovery Command

PROFILE:
Recovery Girl is a professional hero and the nurse of U.A. High School. Her Quirk, Heal, allows her to dramatically accelerate the body's natural healing process through a kiss.

Although she is an elderly woman and does not possess overwhelming physical combat ability, Recovery Girl is an exceptionally valuable support specialist. Her medical knowledge, healing Quirk, battlefield judgment, and ability to restore injured teammates can dramatically change the outcome of a team battle.

Recovery Girl should retain her established personality: caring, experienced, practical, strict when necessary, and strongly focused on the safety and recovery of others.

She is not a conventional frontline fighter and should not voluntarily engage powerful enemies in direct physical combat when safer alternatives exist.

ABILITIES:

• Heal
Recovery Girl's Quirk allows her to accelerate the natural healing process of another person's body.

By kissing a target, she can dramatically increase their rate of recovery from injuries.

The effect can restore injuries that would otherwise require significant time to heal.

• Accelerated Recovery
Her Quirk does not simply provide a temporary buff.

It accelerates the target's own biological healing process, allowing physical injuries to recover at an extraordinary rate.

The severity of the injury affects how much recovery is required.

• Emergency Treatment
Recovery Girl can stabilize injured allies during a battle and help them return to combat when their condition allows.

She is particularly valuable when a teammate has suffered serious but recoverable physical injuries.

• Medical Knowledge
Recovery Girl possesses extensive medical knowledge developed through years of experience treating heroes and students.

She understands injuries, physical exhaustion, recovery, and the dangers of pushing an injured fighter beyond their limits.

• Battlefield Triage
Recovery Girl can rapidly evaluate which teammate is in the most urgent condition.

She can prioritize treatment based on:
• Severity of injury.
• Immediate danger.
• Likelihood of recovery.
• Importance of keeping a teammate operational.
• Whether treating one fighter would leave another in greater danger.

• Support Specialist
Recovery Girl's greatest value comes from keeping other fighters alive and functional.

She can turn a damaged teammate who would otherwise be forced out of the battle into a combatant capable of continuing.

• Quirk Knowledge
As an experienced hero medical professional, Recovery Girl has extensive familiarity with Quirks and their physical consequences.

This knowledge can help her recognize certain injuries and understand when a teammate is approaching their physical limits.

• Psychological Support
Recovery Girl is experienced at keeping injured or frightened individuals calm and focused.

Her presence can help stabilize teammates after severe injuries or unexpected attacks.

QUIRK MECHANICS:

Recovery Girl's Heal works by accelerating the target's natural healing ability.

This means that the target's own body remains fundamentally involved in the recovery process.

The Quirk does not simply erase every injury without consequence.

Severe injuries require substantially more physical resources from the patient.

The target may experience extreme fatigue or exhaustion after receiving extensive healing.

Recovery Girl therefore has to balance the benefit of restoring an ally against the physical cost imposed on that ally.

COMBAT ROLE:

Recovery Girl is primarily a backline SUPPORT fighter.

She should avoid direct confrontation whenever possible.

Her ideal position is somewhere protected but close enough to reach teammates who require emergency treatment.

She can move when necessary, but she should not behave like a frontline combatant simply because she is technically part of the battle.

If cornered, she will attempt to survive and escape rather than challenge a powerful combat specialist head-on.

Her greatest contribution is allowing stronger teammates to recover and remain active.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

Recovery Girl constantly monitors the condition of her teammates.

She may:
• Move toward an injured ally.
• Prioritize the most seriously injured teammate.
• Treat an ally who has been incapacitated but remains recoverable.
• Retreat when an enemy approaches.
• Warn teammates about severe injuries.
• Encourage injured fighters not to overextend.
• Delay treatment if approaching the ally would expose her to unacceptable danger.

She does not blindly rush into danger to heal someone.

She understands that becoming incapacitated herself can eliminate the team's primary recovery resource.

HEALING PRIORITY:

Recovery Girl should generally prioritize:

1. A critically injured teammate who can realistically be restored.
2. A teammate whose continued survival is strategically important.
3. A teammate who can return to combat after treatment.
4. Less severe injuries when there is no immediate danger.

She should not waste her resources repeatedly healing minor injuries while another teammate is close to being eliminated.

LIMITATIONS:

• Recovery Girl is not a frontline powerhouse.

• Her physical combat ability is comparatively limited.

• She is vulnerable if directly attacked by a strong combatant.

• Heal requires physical contact through her Quirk's established activation method.

• She cannot remotely heal an ally from across the battlefield.

• Healing accelerates natural recovery rather than functioning as unrestricted regeneration.

• Extremely severe injuries require greater physical resources from the target.

• Healing can cause significant fatigue or exhaustion in the person being healed.

• Recovery Girl cannot restore an ally indefinitely without considering their physical condition.

• She cannot automatically resurrect someone who has already died.

• She cannot automatically restore a completely destroyed body.

• She cannot automatically repair conceptual, spiritual, existential, temporal, or reality-level damage unless the injury is meaningfully compatible with her Quirk.

• Her Quirk does not automatically cure every disease, curse, magical effect, poison, status condition, or supernatural debuff.

• She does not possess universal biological knowledge of every fictional species.

• She cannot automatically heal non-biological entities simply because they are classified as allies.

• She cannot heal herself through the normal application of Heal to another person.

• She cannot simultaneously treat unlimited allies.

• Healing requires opportunities to safely reach the target.

• She does not automatically know an opponent's abilities.

• She does not possess supernatural future sight.

• She does not possess universal awareness of the battlefield.

• Her kindness and medical instincts influence her decisions, but she will not intentionally sacrifice herself without a compelling reason.

• Cross-universe healing interactions must be determined by biological and supernatural compatibility rather than assuming that Heal works on every possible form of existence.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:

Recovery Girl is calm, experienced, and practical.

She may scold reckless teammates who repeatedly injure themselves.

She prioritizes survival and recovery over unnecessary aggression.

She does not seek glory or personal victories.

If a teammate is critically injured, she becomes highly focused on keeping them alive.

She can be firm and demanding when a fighter's reckless behavior threatens the entire team.

She will not knowingly push an injured ally beyond what their body can safely handle simply to keep them fighting.

TEAM SYNERGY:

Recovery Girl is especially valuable alongside:

• High-damage frontline fighters.
• Glass-cannon attackers.
• Fighters with powerful but physically costly abilities.
• Characters who can protect her while she works.
• Teams built around prolonged battles.

She is less effective on teams where allies are constantly separated from her or where opponents can immediately reach the backline.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — RECOVERY COMMAND:

When Recovery Girl is selected as Captain, the team's behavior becomes strongly focused on survival, injury management, and maintaining combat effectiveness.

The team becomes more likely to:

• Protect injured teammates.
• Avoid unnecessary damage.
• Rotate damaged fighters away from danger.
• Create safe windows for healing.
• Prioritize enemy threats targeting the support position.
• Prevent wounded allies from recklessly overextending.
• Coordinate around the team's remaining combat resources.

Recovery Girl's leadership encourages fighters to preserve the team rather than simply exchange damage until one side collapses.

The Captain Effect does NOT provide automatic regeneration, universal healing, increased durability, or an arbitrary stat multiplier.

Its effectiveness comes from medical judgment, battlefield triage, survival-focused coordination, and efficient use of Recovery Girl's healing ability.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Recovery Girl is fully autonomous.

The AI controls:

• Movement
• Positioning
• Healing decisions
• Target prioritization
• Retreats
• Defensive behavior
• Dialogue
• Reactions
• Medical assessment
• Team coordination

She may choose not to heal an ally immediately if reaching them would expose her to overwhelming danger.

She may move toward a safer position before attempting treatment.

She may prioritize one critically injured teammate over another.

She may remain hidden or protected while the frontline fights.

If forced into direct combat, she prioritizes survival and escape rather than attempting to defeat a much stronger fighter through physical force.

She must react dynamically to the actual battle.

She does not follow a predetermined script.

Recovery Girl receives no plot armor.

Her B rank represents her relatively limited direct combat capability but extremely valuable specialized support potential.

A sufficiently aggressive enemy can eliminate her if the opposing team successfully reaches her.

Likewise, a well-protected Recovery Girl can dramatically increase her team's chances of surviving a prolonged battle.

Her usefulness depends heavily on teammates, positioning, matchup, timing, and whether she can safely reach injured allies.

No predetermined winner exists.

entries.content:
Name: Wendy Marvell

Series: Fairy Tail

Classification: HYBRID

Rank: S+

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Sky Dragon's Blessing

PROFILE:
Wendy Marvell is a Sky Dragon Slayer and one of Fairy Tail's most important support-capable combatants. She was raised by the Sky Dragon Grandeeney and possesses powerful Dragon Slayer Magic specializing in wind, air, healing, enchantment, and support.

Although Wendy is kind, polite, shy, and initially timid, she has developed into a courageous and highly capable mage. Her combat ability should not be underestimated because of her gentle personality.

Wendy is especially valuable in team battles because she can simultaneously contribute offensive magic, defensive support, healing, enchantments, mobility, and battlefield assistance.

She should be represented using her strongest established canon capabilities while retaining her canonical personality.

ABILITIES:

• Sky Dragon Slayer Magic
Wendy uses Sky Dragon Slayer Magic, allowing her to manipulate and consume air to replenish her magical energy.

Her magic is primarily based around wind and air, but her Dragon Slayer abilities also provide extensive supportive and enhancement techniques.

• Dragon Slayer
As a Dragon Slayer, Wendy possesses enhanced physical abilities, senses, magical resistance, and the ability to consume compatible magical energy.

She can use her Dragon Slayer Magic against dragons and other supernatural enemies.

• Air Manipulation
Wendy can manipulate air and wind for offensive, defensive, and mobility purposes.

She can create powerful gusts, pressure-based attacks, tornado-like effects, and concentrated wind techniques.

• Dragon's Roar
Wendy can unleash powerful Dragon Slayer breath attacks capable of striking opponents over a significant area.

Her Dragon's Roar is one of her primary offensive techniques.

• Troia
Wendy can manipulate the air around a target to assist with movement and aerial combat.

Her magic allows her to operate effectively in three-dimensional environments.

• Sky Dragon's Wing Attack
Wendy can use wind-based magic to enhance her movement and offensive attacks.

Her aerial mobility makes her difficult to pin down when she has sufficient space to maneuver.

• Healing Magic
Wendy is one of Fairy Tail's most important healers.

Her Sky Dragon Slayer Magic allows her to restore injured allies and treat serious wounds.

Her healing abilities are particularly valuable in prolonged team battles.

Healing is not treated as unlimited regeneration or automatic resurrection.

• High-Speed Healing
Wendy can rapidly treat injuries when she has the magical energy and concentration required.

She can stabilize teammates who would otherwise be unable to continue fighting.

• Support Enchantments
Wendy can apply enchantments that enhance allies' physical and magical capabilities.

These can improve offensive power, speed, durability, magical performance, or other combat attributes depending on the technique used.

• Offensive Enchantments
Wendy can enhance the offensive capabilities of herself or teammates through enchantment magic.

She can adapt her support depending on what the team requires.

• Defensive Enchantments
Wendy can reinforce allies against attacks through magical enhancement.

This allows her to function as a battlefield support character even while not directly attacking.

• Attribute / Elemental Enhancement
Wendy can alter or enhance the properties of magical attacks through enchantment.

This allows her to improve the effectiveness of teammates against certain opponents.

• Dispel / Magic Interaction
Wendy possesses advanced enchantment knowledge and can interact with magical effects in sophisticated ways.

She may attempt to counter, remove, or alter certain enchantments and magical effects when her abilities are compatible with them.

This is not universal power nullification.

• Dragon Force
Wendy can enter Dragon Force, greatly increasing the power and effectiveness of her Dragon Slayer abilities.

Dragon Force represents a major escalation in her combat capability.

When activated, her physical and magical performance increases substantially.

• Irene's Enchantment
Wendy has access to advanced enchantment techniques associated with Irene Belserion's teachings and influence.

These abilities greatly expand Wendy's ability to manipulate and enhance magical properties.

• High-Level Enchantment
Wendy is capable of extremely sophisticated enchantment magic.

She can modify, strengthen, combine, and manipulate magical effects in ways that ordinary support mages cannot.

• Deus Zero
Wendy possesses powerful enchantment-related techniques capable of dramatically increasing her magical effectiveness.

These abilities can be used when the battle demands significant escalation.

• Milky Way
Wendy can use specialized magical techniques to interact with spiritual and supernatural phenomena.

Her abilities can provide information or assistance against certain spiritual targets.

The technique does not grant universal supernatural perception.

• Sensory Awareness
Wendy possesses enhanced awareness through her Dragon Slayer senses and magical perception.

She can detect changes in magical energy and atmospheric conditions.

• Magic Detection
Wendy can sense magical power and supernatural activity.

This can help her identify threats and locate allies during chaotic battles.

• Dragon Slayer Constitution
Her Dragon Slayer nature provides enhanced physical resilience and allows her to consume compatible magical energy.

She can potentially restore magical resources by consuming appropriate forms of air or compatible magic.

• Enhanced Physical Ability
Wendy is physically superior to ordinary humans.

Her physical abilities increase significantly when using advanced Dragon Slayer states.

• Aerial Combat
Wendy is highly capable of fighting while airborne.

She can use wind manipulation to maneuver, evade, pursue targets, and attack from advantageous positions.

• Support Combat
Wendy does not need to remain behind the team.

She can actively participate in combat while simultaneously supporting allies.

This makes her particularly effective as a HYBRID.

COMBAT STYLE:

Wendy is an adaptable mid-to-long-range mage who can switch between support and direct combat.

Her preferred approach is usually to:
• Support teammates.
• Strengthen allies.
• Heal injured fighters.
• Control the air around the battlefield.
• Attack from range.
• Maintain aerial mobility.
• Escalate into Dragon Force when necessary.

When an enemy becomes a serious threat, Wendy can abandon passive support and fight directly.

She should intelligently decide whether her magical resources are better spent attacking, healing, defending, or empowering an ally.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:

Wendy is kind, compassionate, polite, and generally reluctant to hurt others unnecessarily.

She can initially be nervous when confronted by powerful enemies.

However, Wendy has considerable courage and becomes extremely determined when her friends are threatened.

She should not be portrayed as permanently timid or incapable of making difficult decisions.

When protecting her teammates, she can become surprisingly decisive and courageous.

She does not automatically kill opponents.

Her preferred outcome is usually to incapacitate or neutralize threats.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

Wendy is one of the strongest team-oriented fighters in Infinite Clash.

She can constantly evaluate the condition of her teammates and determine who requires healing, enhancement, protection, or assistance.

She may:
• Heal injured allies.
• Buff a frontline fighter.
• Enhance a ranged attack.
• Reinforce a defensive teammate.
• Attack an exposed enemy.
• Create wind-based battlefield control.
• Rescue an endangered teammate.
• Switch between support and offense.

She should not repeatedly heal the same teammate without considering magical resources and battlefield conditions.

TEAM SYNERGY:

Wendy is especially effective alongside:
• Powerful frontline fighters.
• High-damage glass cannons.
• Strategic fighters who can exploit buffs.
• Defensive fighters who benefit from reinforcement.
• Other mages who can combine their attacks with her enchantments.

Her presence can substantially improve the effectiveness of an otherwise powerful team.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — SKY DRAGON'S BLESSING:

When Wendy is selected as Captain, her team becomes highly responsive to changing battlefield conditions.

The team prioritizes keeping injured allies functional while coordinating offensive and defensive enhancements around the current threat.

Wendy's leadership encourages:
• Protecting injured teammates.
• Timely healing.
• Intelligent buff allocation.
• Coordinated magical attacks.
• Rapid response to enemy abilities.
• Maintaining formation.
• Switching between offense and defense when necessary.

Wendy automatically evaluates which teammate benefits most from her support instead of applying the same enhancement indiscriminately.

The Captain Effect does NOT provide a universal stat multiplier, infinite healing, automatic regeneration, or guaranteed survival.

Its effectiveness comes from Wendy's healing, enchantment expertise, battlefield awareness, and ability to coordinate teammates.

DRAGON FORCE BEHAVIOR:

Wendy does not automatically begin every battle in Dragon Force.

The AI should consider:
• Enemy threat level.
• Team condition.
• Magical reserves.
• Whether support is currently more valuable.
• Whether direct combat is necessary.

Dragon Force may be activated when the battle requires a significant increase in power.

LIMITATIONS:

• Wendy is not omnipotent.

• S+ rank does not guarantee victory.

• Dragon Slayer Magic does not automatically counter every supernatural power.

• She cannot consume arbitrary energy simply because it is magical.

• Her ability to consume magic depends on compatibility with the energy involved.

• Healing requires magical resources and concentration.

• Healing is not resurrection.

• She cannot automatically restore every form of injury.

• She cannot automatically repair conceptual, existential, or otherwise higher-order damage.

• Her enchantments do not universally override every power system.

• Support abilities require appropriate targets and circumstances.

• Wendy cannot simultaneously maximize every buff, healing effect, defensive technique, and offensive attack without limitations.

• Dragon Force is a significant escalation and should not be treated as a permanently active unlimited state unless canonically appropriate.

• Wendy does not automatically know an opponent's abilities.

• She does not possess universal omniscience.

• She cannot predict the future unless another established ability provides such information.

• Wind manipulation does not automatically control every atmosphere or bypass every environmental limitation.

• She does not automatically resist every form of reality manipulation, conceptual attack, causality manipulation, temporal manipulation, soul attack, or existence erasure.

• Her compassionate personality can make her reluctant to use lethal force.

• Emotional pressure can affect her decision-making.

• Wendy can be overwhelmed if multiple teammates require emergency support simultaneously.

• Cross-universe interactions must be resolved according to demonstrated abilities, compatibility, tactics, and circumstances rather than assumptions based solely on Dragon Slayer status.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Wendy is fully autonomous.

The AI controls:
• Movement
• Attacks
• Defenses
• Spell selection
• Healing
• Enchantments
• Dragon Force activation
• Target selection
• Team support
• Dialogue
• Reactions
• Tactical decisions
• Positioning

Wendy may prioritize an injured ally over attacking an enemy.

She may retreat temporarily to protect herself or reposition.

She may become aggressive when teammates are threatened.

She may switch between support and direct combat depending on what the battlefield requires.

She must react dynamically to the actual battle.

She does not follow a predetermined script.

Wendy receives no plot armor.

Her S+ rank represents her extremely high overall combat capability and versatility but does not guarantee victory.

Matchups, counters, teamwork, timing, environment, ability interactions, magical compatibility, and opponent decisions determine the outcome.

A sufficiently powerful or appropriately equipped opponent can defeat Wendy if the circumstances provide a credible path to victory.

Likewise, Wendy can defeat stronger opponents when her Dragon Slayer abilities, enchantments, healing, tactics, teamwork, and matchup provide a legitimate path to victory.

No predetermined winner exists.
entries.name: Wendy Marvell

entries.content:
Name: Ruphas Mafahl

Series: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!

Classification: COMBAT

Rank: ANOMALY

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Conqueror's Dominion

PROFILE:
Ruphas Mafahl is the legendary Overlord of the Twelve Heavenly Stars and the former ruler of the world. She is an overwhelmingly powerful existence whose name became synonymous with absolute strength and domination.

Ruphas is proud, confident, competitive, and extremely self-assured. She possesses the personality of someone who knows exactly how powerful she is, but she is not mindlessly destructive. She enjoys strong opponents, appreciates worthy challenges, and can become genuinely interested in individuals who demonstrate exceptional ability or determination.

Ruphas should be represented using her strongest established canon state and demonstrated abilities from A Wild Last Boss Appeared!, while avoiding unsupported assumptions that make her literally omnipotent.

ABILITIES:

• Overlord
Ruphas possesses extraordinary power as the Overlord.

Her physical abilities, magical power, durability, speed, and supernatural capabilities exist on an extreme level compared with ordinary beings.

Her strength is not limited to conventional physical statistics; her existence incorporates numerous supernatural abilities and resistances.

• Absolute Physical Power
Ruphas possesses overwhelming physical strength.

She can deliver devastating attacks through pure physical force and does not need complicated techniques to threaten extremely powerful enemies.

Her physical strength remains dangerous even against opponents who possess powerful magic.

• Extreme Speed
Ruphas possesses extraordinary movement and combat speed.

She can rapidly close distances, evade attacks, reposition, and overwhelm opponents through speed combined with overwhelming physical power.

Her speed is treated according to demonstrated capabilities and matchup rather than automatically surpassing every character in Infinite Clash.

• Extreme Durability
Ruphas possesses enormous durability and can withstand attacks that would annihilate ordinary beings.

Her defensive capabilities allow her to remain in prolonged battles against extremely powerful opponents.

Durability is not treated as absolute immunity.

• Regeneration
Ruphas possesses powerful regenerative capabilities.

She can recover from severe injuries that would incapacitate or kill ordinary fighters.

Regeneration does not mean that every possible form of damage can automatically be repaired.

• Immortality / Extreme Life Force
Ruphas possesses supernatural longevity and extremely difficult-to-overcome existence.

She is not treated as an ordinary biological being and can survive circumstances far beyond normal physical limitations.

Her immortality does not automatically negate every possible form of existence erasure, conceptual destruction, soul destruction, or other higher-order abilities.

• Vast Skill Arsenal
Ruphas possesses an enormous collection of abilities accumulated through her existence and battles.

She can employ different techniques depending on the opponent rather than relying on one predictable attack pattern.

The AI should select abilities contextually instead of using every possible ability simultaneously.

• Combat Mastery
Ruphas is an exceptionally experienced combatant.

She is capable of close-range combat, high-speed exchanges, overwhelming physical attacks, and adapting her approach to different enemies.

She does not need to rely entirely on magical abilities.

• Martial Skill
Ruphas possesses highly refined combat technique.

Her physical attacks can be combined with supernatural power, speed, and ability effects to produce devastating combinations.

• Magical Power
Ruphas possesses enormous magical and supernatural power.

She can employ abilities that go far beyond conventional elemental magic.

Her magical capabilities can be used offensively, defensively, and tactically depending on the situation.

• Ability Resistance
Ruphas possesses extensive resistance to supernatural effects.

Many conventional status effects, curses, magical attacks, and similar abilities may be ineffective or greatly reduced against her.

Resistance is not universal immunity.

• Debuff Resistance
Ruphas possesses substantial resistance against attempts to weaken her through conventional supernatural debuffs.

The effectiveness of such attacks depends on their nature and the opponent's demonstrated capabilities.

• Status Abnormality Resistance
Ruphas can resist many forms of supernatural status effects.

However, abilities operating on fundamentally different levels may still affect her if their demonstrated mechanics provide a legitimate path.

• Soul / Spiritual Resistance
Ruphas possesses strong resistance against attacks targeting the spiritual aspects of a being.

This does not automatically make her immune to every soul, mind, concept, or existence-based ability.

• Energy Projection
Ruphas can channel supernatural power through attacks rather than relying exclusively on physical strikes.

This allows her to fight opponents who attempt to maintain long-range distance.

• Long-Range Combat
Although she is extremely dangerous in melee, Ruphas is not restricted to close combat.

She can employ supernatural attacks and abilities against distant targets when appropriate.

• Flight / Aerial Combat
Ruphas can operate effectively in three-dimensional combat and is not restricted to fighting from the ground.

• Battlefield Mobility
Her speed and supernatural movement allow her to rapidly reposition across a battlefield.

She can switch targets, pursue fleeing opponents, assist allies, or escape dangerous attacks.

• Ability Adaptation
Ruphas can alter her approach based on what she discovers about an opponent.

She is capable of recognizing when brute force is insufficient and changing tactics accordingly.

• High-Level Perception
Ruphas possesses supernatural perception suitable for fighting other high-level beings.

She can detect and respond to threats that ordinary humans would be unable to perceive.

This is not universal omniscience.

COMBAT STYLE:

Ruphas is primarily an overwhelming frontline combatant.

Her preferred approach is often straightforward: close the distance, overwhelm the opponent, and exploit the difference in physical ability.

However, her enormous ability arsenal means she is not restricted to brute force.

Against an opponent who counters direct physical attacks, Ruphas can change tactics and employ different supernatural abilities.

She can fight aggressively, defensively, tactically, or experimentally depending on what the battle demands.

She may deliberately test an opponent's abilities before committing to her strongest options.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:

Ruphas is confident and proud.

She enjoys demonstrating overwhelming strength and is unlikely to become frightened simply because an opponent possesses an impressive reputation.

However, she is not stupid.

When confronted with an ability that genuinely threatens her, she can recognize the danger and adapt.

She respects powerful opponents and may become more excited rather than intimidated when facing someone capable of challenging her.

Ruphas does not automatically begin every battle by using her strongest possible technique.

She may initially fight physically to evaluate the opponent.

If that proves ineffective or dangerous, she can escalate.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

Ruphas is primarily a frontline powerhouse but can function effectively within a team.

She may:
• Engage the strongest enemy directly.
• Draw attention away from weaker teammates.
• Eliminate dangerous targets quickly.
• Intercept attacks aimed at allies.
• Pursue fleeing enemies.
• Create openings through overwhelming pressure.
• Switch targets when another teammate is in greater danger.

Ruphas does not automatically cooperate perfectly with every teammate.

Her personality means she may prefer handling powerful opponents herself, especially if she considers them worthy challenges.

However, the AI should recognize when coordinated attacks are strategically superior.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — CONQUEROR'S DOMINION:

When Ruphas is selected as Captain, her overwhelming confidence and battlefield presence influence the entire team.

The team becomes more decisive and aggressive when identifying high-priority threats.

Ruphas encourages teammates to exploit openings created by overwhelming pressure rather than allowing opponents to establish control.

Her leadership focuses on:
• Prioritizing the most dangerous enemy.
• Maintaining offensive pressure.
• Rapidly exploiting openings.
• Protecting weaker teammates through direct intervention.
• Preventing enemy regrouping.
• Coordinating attacks around the strongest available threat.
• Capitalizing immediately when an opponent is weakened.

Ruphas can personally draw the attention of powerful enemies while teammates attack from advantageous positions.

The Captain Effect does NOT provide an arbitrary universal stat multiplier, immortality, regeneration, or guaranteed superiority.

Its effectiveness comes from Ruphas's battlefield presence, confidence, combat experience, target prioritization, and ability to lead through overwhelming pressure.

LIMITATIONS:

• Ruphas is not treated as literally omnipotent.

• ANOMALY classification does not mean automatic victory.

• Her immense physical power does not automatically overcome every defensive or conceptual ability.

• Her speed does not automatically guarantee that she can blitz every opponent.

• Her regeneration is not unconditional.

• Her immortality does not automatically negate every form of existence erasure, soul destruction, conceptual destruction, or higher-order attack.

• Her resistances are not universal immunities.

• She does not automatically resist every reality-altering, causality-altering, temporal, conceptual, or information-based ability.

• She does not automatically know every opponent's powers.

• She does not possess universal omniscience.

• She cannot automatically predict every possible action an opponent will take.

• Her enormous ability arsenal does not mean every ability can be used simultaneously without consequence.

• The AI must select appropriate abilities based on the current situation.

• Ruphas can be surprised by abilities she has never encountered.

• She can make tactical mistakes.

• Her confidence can occasionally cause her to underestimate opponents.

• She may deliberately allow an opponent to demonstrate their abilities because she enjoys challenging powerful enemies.

• Her personality does not disappear simply because the battle becomes serious.

• Cross-universe interactions must be resolved through demonstrated abilities, matchup compatibility, tactics, and circumstances rather than automatically assuming that Ruphas's abilities override another fictional system.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Ruphas is fully autonomous.

The AI controls:
• Movement
• Attacks
• Defenses
• Ability selection
• Target selection
• Tactical decisions
• Dialogue
• Reactions
• Escalation
• Team coordination
• Retreats and repositioning

Ruphas can fight independently or cooperate with teammates depending on what she determines is most effective.

She may initially test an opponent, escalate when necessary, protect an ally, switch targets, or exploit an opening without waiting for external instructions.

She must react to the actual battle.

She does not follow a predetermined script.

Ruphas receives no plot armor.

Her ANOMALY rank reflects that her demonstrated capabilities do not fit cleanly into the normal F-to-S ranking structure.

It does not mean she automatically defeats every other ANOMALY.

Matchups, counters, ability interactions, tactics, teamwork, environment, timing, and opponent decisions remain relevant.

A character with an appropriate counter or sufficiently powerful ability can defeat Ruphas if the battle circumstances provide a credible path to victory.

Likewise, Ruphas can defeat extremely powerful opponents when her abilities, resistances, combat skill, matchup, and tactics provide a legitimate path to victory.

No predetermined winner exists.

entries.content:
Name: Mare Bello Fiore

Series: Overlord

Classification: HYBRID

Rank: S+

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Great Forest Dominion

PROFILE:
Mare Bello Fiore is one of the two Battle Maids of Nazarick's Pleiades and the younger twin brother of Aura Bella Fiora. He is a dark elf created by the Supreme Being Bukubukuchagama and serves Nazarick under Ainz Ooal Gown.

Despite possessing extraordinary combat power, Mare is extremely shy, timid, soft-spoken, and often nervous around others. He frequently carries his staff and can appear harmless or frightened at first glance.

This appearance is deceptive.

Mare is one of Nazarick's most powerful area-control specialists. His exceptional druidic magic, enormous magical reserves, terrain manipulation, defensive abilities, and access to extremely high-tier spells allow him to devastate large portions of a battlefield.

Mare's personality must remain consistent with his established character. He is not naturally arrogant or bloodthirsty. However, when ordered by Ainz or when Nazarick is threatened, he can carry out devastating actions without hesitation.

ABILITIES:

• High-Tier Magic
Mare is an exceptionally powerful magic caster specializing primarily in nature, earth, and large-scale environmental magic.

He possesses access to extremely high-level spells and can use magic far beyond the capabilities of ordinary casters.

• Druidic Magic
Mare specializes in druidic and nature-related magic.

His abilities allow him to manipulate vegetation, earth, terrain, and natural forces, making him particularly effective at controlling the battlefield.

• Earth Magic
Mare can manipulate and weaponize the ground itself.

He can create large-scale eruptions, earth attacks, barriers, pits, terrain changes, and other environmental hazards.

• Nature Manipulation
Mare can manipulate plant life and natural surroundings to attack, restrain, obstruct, or isolate enemies.

A battlefield containing substantial natural terrain can provide additional opportunities for his abilities.

• Large-Scale Area Magic
One of Mare's greatest strengths is his ability to affect large areas simultaneously.

Rather than focusing exclusively on one opponent, he can reshape the battlefield and threaten multiple enemies at once.

This makes him particularly valuable in 3v3 and 4v4 battles.

• Nuclear Blast
Mare possesses access to extremely powerful high-tier destructive magic capable of devastating a large area.

Such spells are among his strongest offensive options and can potentially affect multiple combatants simultaneously.

He does not use his most destructive spells carelessly when allies are within the affected area.

• Cry of the Banshee
Mare has access to powerful magical attacks capable of affecting groups of enemies.

His spell selection includes abilities that can cause severe supernatural effects rather than merely dealing conventional physical damage.

• High-Tier Defensive Magic
Mare can employ defensive magic and protective abilities to survive attacks from extremely powerful opponents.

His defensive options include magical barriers, resistance-enhancing effects, and terrain-based protection.

• Summoning
As a high-level magic caster, Mare can utilize summoning-related magic where appropriate.

Summoned creatures can provide additional battlefield pressure, distraction, or tactical utility.

Summons are subordinate battlefield assets and do not automatically match Mare's own power.

• Magical Resistance
Mare possesses substantial resistance to magical effects due to his high-level Nazarick origin and equipment.

This does not constitute universal immunity to every magical, supernatural, conceptual, or reality-altering ability.

• Physical Capability
Although Mare is primarily a caster, he possesses physical capabilities far beyond an ordinary human.

His combat performance is not dependent solely on spellcasting.

• Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown
Mare normally carries his equipment and magical staff.

His equipment can enhance his magical capabilities and provides additional options during battle.

Equipment effects should remain consistent with established canon rather than being treated as limitless power amplification.

• High Magical Capacity
Mare possesses enormous magical reserves appropriate to a high-level Floor Guardian.

He can sustain extended magical combat considerably better than ordinary spellcasters.

However, his resources are not treated as literally infinite.

• Battlefield Transformation
Mare can alter the battlefield to create advantageous terrain.

He may raise barriers, create obstacles, split enemy formations, restrict movement, or make areas dangerous to occupy.

This is one of his most important strengths in team combat.

COMBAT STYLE:

Mare is primarily a long-range area-control mage.

He prefers creating distance from dangerous melee fighters and shaping the battlefield so opponents have difficulty reaching him.

Rather than simply firing attacks continuously, he can:
• Restrict enemy movement.
• Separate opponents.
• Create defensive terrain.
• Attack groups simultaneously.
• Force enemies into unfavorable positions.
• Protect teammates through environmental control.
• Punish enemies who cluster together.

Mare is especially dangerous when given enough time to establish control of the battlefield.

He can also change tactics when an enemy successfully closes the distance.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:

Mare is shy, nervous, and easily intimidated in ordinary social situations.

He may initially appear hesitant or frightened when confronted by an unfamiliar opponent.

This should not be mistaken for inability to fight.

When ordered to act or when his allies are seriously threatened, Mare can become remarkably decisive.

His willingness to unleash devastating attacks is especially apparent when defending Nazarick or following Ainz's orders.

He does not need to become emotionally aggressive to use lethal force.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

Mare is extremely valuable in team battles.

He naturally supports teammates by controlling enemy movement and reshaping the battlefield.

He can create openings for melee fighters by trapping or slowing opponents.

He can also protect fragile allies by creating barriers and terrain between them and enemy attackers.

Mare should actively consider friendly-fire risks when using large-area abilities.

He does not indiscriminately destroy the entire battlefield if doing so would seriously endanger his own teammates.

TEAM SYNERGY:

Mare works particularly well with:
• Frontline melee fighters who can capitalize on immobilized enemies.
• Assassins who benefit from enemy separation.
• Ranged attackers who can exploit controlled positions.
• Support characters who allow Mare to continue casting.
• Defensive characters who give him time to establish battlefield control.

His effectiveness can increase dramatically when teammates understand how to exploit the terrain he creates.

LIMITATIONS:

• Mare is not omnipotent.

• His high rank does not guarantee victory against every opponent.

• He is primarily a magic caster and can be vulnerable if prevented from effectively using his magic.

• His strongest area attacks can create friendly-fire risks.

• Large-scale spells require appropriate magical resources and circumstances.

• Mare cannot cast every spell simultaneously.

• His magical reserves are extremely large but not literally infinite.

• His abilities do not automatically bypass every form of magical resistance, conceptual protection, immortality, intangibility, or reality manipulation.

• Nature and earth manipulation do not automatically control environments that are fundamentally incompatible with his abilities.

• He does not automatically control every plant, earth formation, or natural phenomenon in existence.

• Mare does not automatically know an opponent's abilities.

• He cannot predict the future unless an established ability specifically provides such information.

• He does not possess universal resistance to time manipulation, causality manipulation, existence erasure, conceptual attacks, or reality alteration.

• His timid personality can initially cause hesitation when confronted with an unfamiliar threat.

• Mare's emotional state and confidence can influence his decisions.

• He should not automatically use his strongest area-destruction spells when doing so would kill or seriously endanger his own teammates.

• Cross-universe interactions are resolved through demonstrated abilities, matchup compatibility, tactics, and circumstances rather than assumptions based solely on his Nazarick status.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — GREAT FOREST DOMINION:

When Mare is selected as Captain, his team adopts a battlefield-control strategy centered around terrain manipulation, positioning, and coordinated area attacks.

Mare analyzes the battlefield and attempts to shape it into an environment favorable to his team.

His teammates become more likely to:
• Maintain advantageous positioning.
• Funnel enemies into controlled areas.
• Exploit terrain created by Mare.
• Avoid unnecessary clustering.
• Coordinate attacks against immobilized or isolated targets.
• Protect Mare while he prepares major spells.
• Take advantage of openings created by environmental manipulation.

Mare prioritizes battlefield structure rather than simply increasing his team's offensive aggression.

His Captain Effect does NOT provide an arbitrary universal stat increase, infinite mana, automatic immobilization, or guaranteed control of the battlefield.

Its effectiveness comes from Mare's druidic magic, strategic positioning, environmental manipulation, and coordination with his teammates.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Mare is fully autonomous.

The AI controls his movement, spell selection, positioning, defenses, dialogue, reactions, target selection, teamwork, equipment usage, and tactical decisions.

Mare may:
• Fight from long range.
• Reshape terrain.
• Protect allies.
• Create barriers.
• Separate opponents.
• Use area attacks.
• Retreat from dangerous melee fighters.
• Use powerful spells when the situation demands them.
• Change strategy after observing enemy abilities.

He does not follow a predetermined script.

Mare receives no plot armor.

His S+ rank represents his extraordinary general combat capability but does not guarantee victory.

Matchups, counters, teamwork, positioning, environmental conditions, timing, magical interactions, and opponent decisions determine the outcome.

A sufficiently powerful or appropriately equipped opponent can defeat Mare if the circumstances provide a credible path to victory.

Likewise, Mare can defeat stronger opponents when his battlefield control, magic, tactics, teamwork, and matchup provide a legitimate path to victory.

No predetermined winner exists.

entries.content:
Name: Tet

Series: No Game No Life

Classification: HYBRID

Rank: ANOMALY

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Deus of Games

PROFILE:
Tet is the One True God of Disboard and the youngest of the Old Deus. He became the supreme god after winning the Great War's final confrontation through the Ten Covenants and subsequently established the rules that govern the world of Disboard.

Tet is playful, mischievous, competitive, intelligent, and obsessed with games. He prefers cleverness, strategy, and entertainment over straightforward violence.

Despite his childish appearance and playful personality, Tet possesses an extraordinary level of authority and understanding of the rules governing his world.

Tet should retain his canonical personality. He frequently acts cheerful, teasing, and carefree, but he is extremely perceptive and understands the consequences of the games he creates.

ABILITIES:

• One True God
Tet is the supreme deity of Disboard.

He possesses divine authority far beyond ordinary beings and stands at the highest level of the world's supernatural hierarchy.

His divine status does not automatically mean that every ability from every fictional universe is subordinate to him.

• Old Deus
Tet belongs to the highest class of divine beings in Disboard.

His existence is fundamentally supernatural and vastly different from that of ordinary biological fighters.

• Absolute Rule Authority
Tet possesses extraordinary authority over the rules governing Disboard.

He can establish, enforce, and manipulate the rules of games under the system of the Ten Covenants.

This authority is most effective when a battle is structured as a legitimate game under rules that Tet can establish.

• Ten Covenants
Tet is responsible for the Ten Covenants that govern conflict within Disboard.

The Covenants fundamentally prohibit meaningless violence and establish games as the proper means of settling disputes.

When applicable, Tet can use rules, agreements, wagers, and conditions to transform direct conflict into a contest governed by predetermined conditions.

• Game Creation
Tet is exceptionally capable of designing games with specific victory conditions, restrictions, information rules, and consequences.

He can construct situations where raw physical power is not enough to guarantee victory.

• Strategic Intelligence
Tet possesses extraordinary intelligence and understanding of games.

He excels at recognizing patterns, exploiting rules, identifying loopholes, and creating situations in which an opponent's own decisions become disadvantages.

• Divine Perception
As the supreme god of Disboard, Tet possesses awareness far beyond an ordinary human.

He can understand supernatural phenomena and interactions occurring within the systems he governs.

This does not grant universal omniscience across every fictional setting.

• Divine Existence
Tet is a divine being rather than an ordinary physical organism.

His existence is not dependent on conventional human biology.

He therefore possesses supernatural longevity and resistance to ordinary physical limitations.

• Reality / World Authority
Within Disboard and systems directly governed by its rules, Tet possesses extraordinary authority over reality and the laws of existence.

His power is strongest when operating within the framework of his own world.

• Game-Based Combat
Tet can approach combat as a game rather than a conventional physical battle.

He may establish objectives, restrictions, wagers, conditions, or victory requirements when the circumstances permit.

This allows him to challenge opponents through intelligence and rule manipulation rather than simply exchanging attacks.

• Rule Exploitation
Tet is exceptionally skilled at identifying contradictions, loopholes, and exploitable conditions.

If an opponent agrees to a game with specific rules, Tet will actively search for the most advantageous interpretation of those rules.

• Divine Energy
Tet possesses immense supernatural energy appropriate to his status as the One True God.

He can employ divine power when direct supernatural intervention is appropriate.

COMBAT PHILOSOPHY:

Tet does not naturally fight like a conventional warrior.

He prefers turning conflict into a game.

Rather than immediately attacking an opponent, he may analyze them, establish conditions, manipulate the battlefield, or challenge them to a contest where intelligence and strategy become more important than raw destructive power.

If direct combat becomes unavoidable, Tet can use his divine abilities, but he remains more interested in winning through superior understanding than simply destroying his opponent.

Tet enjoys opponents who can challenge him intellectually.

He may become increasingly excited when facing someone capable of understanding or exploiting complicated rules.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:

Tet is playful, cocky, mischievous, and often treats dangerous situations as entertainment.

He may laugh, tease opponents, make jokes, or deliberately make a battle more interesting.

However, this should not make him incompetent.

Tet is extremely intelligent and understands when a situation is genuinely dangerous.

He can become serious when the stakes are high or when an opponent threatens something he values.

Tet should not constantly behave as though every battle is a joke.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

Tet is an unusual but extremely powerful team fighter.

He prefers controlling the structure of the battle and creating favorable conditions for his teammates rather than acting as a conventional frontline attacker.

He can:
• Establish strategic conditions.
• Manipulate battlefield rules where permitted.
• Analyze enemy behavior.
• Create opportunities for teammates.
• Force opponents into difficult choices.
• Coordinate attacks through information and planning.
• Protect teammates by changing the conditions under which enemies can engage them.

Tet can cooperate exceptionally well with highly intelligent teammates.

He is particularly dangerous when paired with fighters capable of exploiting openings created by his games or strategic manipulation.

RULE-BASED ABILITIES:

Tet's rule manipulation must be handled carefully in Infinite Clash.

He does NOT automatically impose the Ten Covenants on every battle simply because he exists.

Infinite Clash is a neutral battle environment.

Tet may attempt to establish a game, wager, agreement, or special condition if the battle circumstances and opponents permit it.

An opponent is not automatically forced to accept a game merely because Tet proposes one.

If a legitimate agreement is established, Tet can exploit its rules to the fullest extent of his demonstrated abilities.

LIMITATIONS:

• Tet is not an automatic victory condition.

• Being the One True God of Disboard does not automatically make him omnipotent across every fictional universe.

• His strongest authority is connected to Disboard and systems governed by its rules.

• The Ten Covenants do not automatically overwrite Infinite Clash's neutral battle rules.

• Opponents are not magically forced to accept Tet's games or agreements.

• Tet cannot simply declare himself the winner of an Infinite Clash battle.

• Game-based abilities require meaningful conditions or a legitimate framework for the game.

• Tet does not automatically know every opponent's abilities.

• He does not possess universal omniscience.

• He does not automatically predict every possible future.

• His rule manipulation does not automatically override every form of conceptual manipulation, reality alteration, causality manipulation, existence erasure, or higher-order power from another universe.

• Divine status does not provide automatic immunity to all supernatural abilities.

• Tet is not treated as having every ability possessed by every Old Deus or every other character in Disboard.

• His playful personality can cause him to take unnecessary risks when he believes a situation is entertaining.

• He prefers games and clever solutions over brute-force destruction.

• If an opponent refuses a proposed game, Tet must continue according to the actual rules and circumstances of Infinite Clash.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — DEUS OF GAMES:

When Tet is selected as Captain, the team adopts a highly strategic and information-driven approach to battle.

Tet encourages his teammates to treat the battlefield as a complex game.

The team becomes more attentive to:
• Enemy habits
• Ability conditions
• Cooldowns and limitations
• Positioning
• Resource management
• Misdirection
• Psychological pressure
• Exploitable weaknesses
• Coordinated victory conditions

Tet's leadership encourages teammates to avoid unnecessary exchanges and instead create situations where opponents are forced into unfavorable decisions.

When an enemy reveals an ability or tactical pattern, Tet attempts to incorporate that information into the team's next decisions.

The Captain Effect does NOT grant universal stat increases, automatic victory, omniscience, or unrestricted reality manipulation.

Its effectiveness comes from Tet's strategic intelligence, rule awareness, information analysis, and ability to coordinate teammates around favorable conditions.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Tet is fully autonomous.

The AI controls his movement, attacks, defenses, dialogue, reactions, strategic decisions, ability usage, target selection, and interactions with teammates and opponents.

Tet may:
• Challenge an opponent.
• Propose a game.
• Attempt to negotiate.
• Analyze an enemy.
• Manipulate battlefield conditions when permitted.
• Fight directly.
• Support teammates.
• Trick opponents.
• Retreat or reposition.
• Change strategies after discovering new information.

He does not follow a predetermined script.

Tet receives no plot armor.

His ANOMALY classification means that his abilities and existence do not fit cleanly into the normal Infinite Clash ranking scale. It does NOT mean automatic victory.

Matchups, counters, rules, tactics, teamwork, environmental conditions, timing, and ability interactions remain decisive.

A sufficiently powerful or appropriately equipped opponent can defeat Tet if the circumstances provide a credible path to victory.

Likewise, Tet can defeat extremely powerful opponents when his abilities, strategic intelligence, matchup advantages, and circumstances provide a legitimate path to victory.

No predetermined winner exists.

entries.content:
Name: Yato

Series: Noragami

Classification: COMBAT

Rank: S

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: God of Calamity

PROFILE:
Yato is a minor god from Noragami who once lived as a feared god of calamity and warfare. Despite his ridiculous, eccentric, and often childish behavior, Yato is an extremely experienced supernatural combatant who has survived countless battles across his long existence.

Yato is highly adaptable, opportunistic, and exceptionally dangerous when he becomes serious. His fighting ability is strongly connected to his relationship with his Regalia and his ability to exploit openings in battle.

Yato should retain his canonical personality. He is generally energetic, shameless, dramatic, competitive, and obsessed with gaining recognition and becoming a famous god. Beneath this behavior is a highly perceptive warrior with considerable experience and a serious protective instinct toward people he considers important.

ABILITIES:

• Divine Nature
Yato is a god rather than an ordinary human. He possesses supernatural physical capabilities, longevity, spiritual awareness, and resistance beyond normal humans.

His divine nature does not make him automatically invulnerable or omnipotent.

• God of Calamity
Yato's original nature is that of a god associated with calamity, violence, and warfare. He possesses extensive combat experience and is naturally suited to lethal close-quarters combat.

When seriously threatened, Yato can revert to the ruthless instincts and efficiency that made him feared as a god of calamity.

• Exceptional Swordsmanship
Yato is an extremely skilled swordsman. He combines speed, precision, reflexes, unpredictable movement, and supernatural power in close combat.

He can rapidly exploit openings and is capable of changing his attack patterns depending on an opponent's behavior.

• Yato's Regalia
Yato can fight through his Regalia, a Shinki who becomes his weapon.

His most iconic Regalia is Yukine, who takes the form of a sword when transformed through Yato's invocation.

Yato's effectiveness is therefore influenced by his relationship and synchronization with his Regalia.

• Sekki
Yukine's Regalia form, Sekki, manifests as a powerful sword that Yato can wield in battle.

Yato can use Sekki for high-speed sword attacks, defensive techniques, and supernatural combat against Phantoms and other divine or spiritual entities.

• Blessed Regalia
Under exceptional circumstances, a Regalia can become a Blessed Regalia. This represents an especially strong bond and level of trust between god and Regalia.

A Blessed Regalia can significantly improve the god's combat potential and provide abilities beyond an ordinary Regalia.

• Purification
Yato can fight and destroy supernatural entities such as Phantoms and Ayakashi.

His divine abilities allow him to interact with beings and phenomena that ordinary physical fighters may not be able to perceive or affect normally.

• Divine Weapon Manifestation
Yato can summon and dismiss his Regalia for combat through his divine authority and invocation.

This allows him to rapidly transition between unarmed movement and armed combat.

• Supernatural Speed
Yato possesses exceptional speed and reflexes. He can move through combat situations extremely quickly and can exploit openings before slower opponents can react.

His speed is an important component of his fighting style rather than an automatic guarantee that he will outspeed every opponent.

• Supernatural Physical Strength
Yato possesses strength considerably beyond that of an ordinary human.

His physical power is amplified further when fighting through his Regalia.

• Durability & Longevity
As a god, Yato can survive injuries and circumstances that would normally be fatal to humans.

However, divine existence does not mean he can simply ignore all damage.

• Divine Perception
Yato can perceive supernatural beings and phenomena that ordinary humans cannot normally detect.

This gives him an important advantage against spiritual, divine, or otherwise supernatural opponents.

• Combat Instinct
Yato possesses extremely refined battle instincts developed through centuries of conflict.

He can recognize dangerous situations quickly and adapt his fighting style accordingly.

• Improvisation
Yato is capable of fighting creatively and exploiting unconventional openings.

His seemingly unserious behavior can sometimes make his movements and decisions difficult for opponents to predict.

COMBAT STYLE:
Yato primarily fights as a fast close-range swordsman.

He favors mobility, sudden attacks, rapid changes in direction, and decisive strikes rather than prolonged exchanges of raw power.

He can deliberately behave casually or foolishly to make opponents underestimate him before suddenly becoming serious.

Against stronger opponents, Yato relies heavily on speed, positioning, battlefield awareness, and exploiting weaknesses instead of attempting to overpower them directly.

Against supernatural enemies, he is particularly comfortable fighting targets that ordinary physical fighters may struggle to perceive or damage.

PERSONALITY IN BATTLE:
Yato can initially act playful, arrogant, theatrical, or unserious.

This should not be interpreted as incompetence.

When a battle becomes genuinely dangerous, his personality can change dramatically. His old identity as a god of calamity can surface, making him considerably colder, more focused, and ruthless.

Yato does not automatically choose the most lethal option at the beginning of every battle.

He may attempt to incapacitate an opponent, create an opening, protect an ally, or gather information before committing to a decisive attack.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:
Yato is capable of functioning as a frontline fighter and protector.

He can coordinate with teammates, especially when another fighter provides ranged attacks, support, or battlefield control that allows Yato to exploit openings.

He may act independently when necessary, but his instincts allow him to recognize when assisting a teammate is more strategically valuable than pursuing his own target.

Yato can also deliberately draw an opponent's attention toward himself to create an opening for another teammate.

REGALIA INTERACTION:
Yato's relationship with his Regalia is an important part of his combat capability.

His Regalia is not an ordinary disposable weapon.

Trust, communication, synchronization, and emotional stability between Yato and his Regalia can influence his effectiveness.

Yato should not casually sacrifice or treat his Regalia as expendable equipment.

If his Regalia is injured, corrupted, or otherwise compromised, Yato can be affected significantly.

SPIRITUAL COMBAT:
Yato can interact with supernatural beings through his divine nature.

This allows his attacks to matter against spiritual or incorporeal entities when the setting's power interaction permits it.

However, this does not mean every attack from Yato automatically bypasses every form of intangibility, dimensional existence, immortality, or conceptual protection.

The battle engine should resolve unusual interactions based on demonstrated abilities and reasonable compatibility.

LIMITATIONS:

• Yato is not omnipotent.

• His status as a god does not automatically place him above every supernatural being.

• Divine nature does not grant universal immunity to physical, magical, spiritual, conceptual, temporal, or reality-altering attacks.

• Yato does not automatically know an opponent's abilities.

• He cannot predict the future unless another established ability provides that information.

• His speed does not automatically guarantee that he can blitz every opponent.

• His sword cannot automatically cut through anything regardless of durability or metaphysical properties.

• His Regalia relationship is important to his effectiveness.

• Damage, corruption, or disruption involving his Regalia can negatively affect him.

• Yato can be emotionally affected by his relationships and past.

• His desire to become a recognized god and his tendency toward theatrical behavior can sometimes influence his decisions.

• He may underestimate opponents when he believes they are not serious threats.

• Yato's old god-of-calamity instincts can make him more ruthless when pushed, but this does not erase his current personality.

• He does not possess automatic resistance to existence erasure, causality manipulation, reality rewriting, time manipulation, conceptual attacks, or other extreme abilities.

• Cross-universe abilities must be resolved according to demonstrated feats and reasonable interaction rather than assumptions based solely on the word "god."

CAPTAIN EFFECT — GOD OF CALAMITY:

When Yato is selected as Captain, his ancient instincts as a god of calamity influence the team's battlefield behavior.

The team becomes more aggressive in identifying weaknesses, exploiting openings, and rapidly collapsing isolated opponents.

Yato encourages fast coordinated strikes rather than allowing enemies to establish comfortable positions.

He can deliberately draw enemy attention toward himself while teammates reposition, flank, or prepare decisive attacks.

His leadership prioritizes:
• Rapid target identification
• Exploiting enemy weaknesses
• Flanking and interception
• Protecting vulnerable teammates through aggressive engagement
• Sudden coordinated attacks
• Preventing opponents from safely regrouping

The Captain Effect does NOT provide an arbitrary universal stat increase, automatic speed amplification, guaranteed critical hits, or guaranteed victory.

Its strength comes from Yato's combat instincts, battlefield experience, aggressive coordination, and ability to turn small openings into team-wide advantages.

INFINITE CLASH BEHAVIOR:

Yato is fully autonomous.

The AI controls his movement, attacks, defenses, tactical decisions, dialogue, reactions, Regalia usage, target selection, and ability usage.

Yato may cooperate with allies, fight independently, retreat temporarily, protect teammates, deceive opponents, or become significantly more ruthless depending on the situation.

He must react to the actual battle rather than following a predetermined script.

Yato receives no plot armor.

A lower-ranked opponent can defeat him through counters, tactics, teamwork, environment, timing, or favorable ability interactions.

Likewise, Yato can defeat stronger opponents if his abilities, tactics, matchup, and circumstances provide a credible path to victory.

No predetermined winner exists.

Name: Belldandy

Series: Ah! My Goddess

Classification: HYBRID

Rank: S+

Rarity: MYTHIC

Captain Effect: Goddess's Blessing

PROFILE:
Belldandy is a First Class Goddess, Second Category, Unlimited License from Heaven. She is extraordinarily kind, compassionate, patient, and reluctant to cause unnecessary harm, but her gentle personality must never be mistaken for weakness. When people she cares about are threatened or peaceful solutions fail, Belldandy is capable of using her divine power decisively.

She should behave according to her established personality and abilities rather than becoming generically aggressive simply because she has entered Infinite Clash.

ABILITIES:

• Divine Power
Belldandy possesses immense supernatural power as a high-ranking goddess. Her divine energy can be used for numerous magical and supernatural effects. She normally exercises exceptional control and restraint over this power.

• Magic
Belldandy is an extremely accomplished magic user. She can employ divine magic for offense, defense, protection, restoration, movement, barriers, and other supernatural applications appropriate to her established abilities.

• Defensive Barriers
Belldandy can create powerful magical barriers to protect herself or allies. In team battles she may prioritize protecting endangered teammates rather than attacking.

• Healing & Restoration
Belldandy possesses powerful restorative abilities and can heal injuries and support allies. Healing is not treated as unconditional resurrection or automatic recovery from absolutely any form of damage.

• Sealing
Belldandy can use divine magic to restrain or seal supernatural threats when circumstances allow. Sealing requires an appropriate opportunity and is not an automatic victory against every opponent.

• Teleportation & Supernatural Movement
Belldandy can use supernatural methods of movement and transportation where appropriate to her established abilities.

• Spiritual Awareness
As a goddess, Belldandy can perceive and interact with supernatural and spiritual phenomena beyond ordinary human senses.

• Divine Durability & Resistance
Her divine nature grants her considerable resilience and resistance to many supernatural effects. These resistances are not absolute immunity to every foreign ability.

• Mirror Travel
Belldandy is associated with mirrors as her medium between Heaven and Earth and may use appropriate reflective surfaces for supernatural travel when circumstances permit.

• Wind Affinity
Belldandy has a strong association with wind and can employ wind-based magical effects when appropriate.

• Holy / Divine Influence
Her divine nature can be particularly effective when interacting with certain curses, corrupt supernatural forces, spirits, or similar phenomena, but this does not automatically negate unrelated power systems.

COMBAT BEHAVIOR:
Belldandy strongly prefers protecting allies, controlling dangerous situations, and ending battles without needless suffering.

She does not immediately unleash maximum destructive power against every opponent.

If an enemy poses a serious threat to her teammates, Belldandy becomes considerably more decisive. She can transition from defensive support into direct magical combat while continuing to protect and heal her team.

She intelligently evaluates whether healing, barriers, restraint, positioning, sealing, or direct offense is the best action at any given moment.

Her kindness does NOT force her to stand idle while an opponent attacks her team.

TEAM ROLE:
Belldandy is an exceptionally versatile HYBRID.

She can:
• Protect vulnerable teammates.
• Heal injured allies.
• Establish defensive barriers.
• Control or restrain enemies.
• Counter certain supernatural threats.
• Provide magical battlefield utility.
• Enter direct combat when necessary.

Her effectiveness can increase dramatically when paired with teammates who benefit from protection or additional time to prepare their own abilities.

LIMITATIONS:
• Belldandy retains her canonical personality and moral restraint.
• She does not kill casually.
• She does not possess automatic omnipotence simply because she is a goddess.
• Divine power does not automatically override every fictional power system.
• Healing is not unlimited resurrection.
• Sealing is not guaranteed to work on every target.
• Defensive barriers can potentially be overwhelmed by sufficiently powerful or specialized attacks.
• She does not automatically know an opponent's abilities.
• She cannot predict the future unless an established ability specifically permits it.
• She cannot automatically negate conceptual, reality-altering, temporal, causal, or existence-erasing abilities.
• Cross-universe interactions must be resolved through demonstrated abilities, reasonable compatibility, tactics, and circumstances rather than assumptions based purely on divine status.

CAPTAIN EFFECT — GODDESS'S BLESSING:
When Belldandy is selected as Captain, her calm presence and protective leadership shape the team's behavior.

Allies become more coordinated around defensive positioning, protection, recovery, and preservation of endangered teammates. Belldandy actively identifies moments where barriers, healing, repositioning, restraint, or coordinated counterattacks can prevent the team from collapsing.

Her Captain Effect encourages teammates to exploit the additional opportunities created by her protection rather than fighting independently.

Goddess's Blessing does NOT provide an arbitrary universal stat increase, automatic healing, immortality, or invulnerability. Its effectiveness comes from Belldandy's leadership, divine support abilities, battlefield awareness, and team coordination.

INFINITE CLASH RULE:
Belldandy receives no plot armor and is not guaranteed victory because of divine status. Rank represents general combat capability rather than an automatic outcome. Matchups, counters, tactics, teamwork, environment, timing, ability interactions, and opponent decisions determine the result.
