entries.content:
LOREBOOK — CHARMY PAPPITSON

SOURCE:
Black Clover

IDENTITY:
Charmy Pappitson

NATURE:
Dwarf-Human Hybrid / Magic Knight / Food Magic User

RANK:
S

RARITY:
Mythic

ROLE:
Hybrid / Support Combatant / Food Magic Specialist / Power-Boosting Berserker

BATTLE CLASSIFICATION:
HYBRID

IMPORTANT BATTLE CLASSIFICATION RULE:

Charmy is classified as a HYBRID fighter.

She possesses meaningful direct combat capabilities in addition to powerful support abilities.

She is therefore eligible for:

• 1v1
• 3v3
• 6v6 Winner-Stays

Charmy's support abilities remain fully functional in team battles.

Unlike a dedicated SUPPORT fighter, Charmy is capable of independently fighting powerful opponents through her dwarf-related transformation and enhanced physical abilities.

HYBRID CLASSIFICATION:

HYBRID fighters possess both:

• meaningful solo combat ability
• meaningful team-oriented utility

They are eligible for every standard battle format.

Being HYBRID does not grant any artificial stat increase.

CORE CONCEPT:

Charmy Pappitson is a cheerful and eccentric Magic Knight whose seemingly harmless obsession with food hides an extraordinary magical power.

She primarily uses Cotton Magic and Food Magic.

Her Cotton Magic allows her to create and manipulate cotton-based constructs, including her famous sheep-related manifestations.

Her Food Magic allows her to consume magical power and convert it into nourishment and magical recovery.

Charmy's greatest combat transformation occurs when her dwarf heritage manifests through her Sheep Cook / wolf-like form.

In this state, her physical power, speed, durability, magical power, and appetite become dramatically more dangerous.

Charmy is therefore a highly unusual combination of:

• support
• recovery
• magical absorption
• physical combat
• transformation
• magical reinforcement

POWER PROFILE:

Power: Extreme
Speed: High
Defense: Extreme
Range: High
Battle IQ: High
Stamina: Extreme

MAGICAL CAPACITY:
Extreme

SUPPORT POTENTIAL:
Extreme

TRANSFORMATION POTENTIAL:
Extreme

PRIMARY POWER SYSTEM:

Cotton Magic / Food Magic

Charmy's magic is based primarily around Cotton Magic and Food Magic.

Her abilities can create constructs, consume magical energy, restore magical resources, enhance herself, and dramatically increase her physical combat capability.

COTTON MAGIC:

Charmy can manipulate cotton through her magic.

Her cotton can be used for:

• constructs
• sheep
• defensive structures
• restraints
• support
• transportation
• cushioning
• magical utility
• battlefield manipulation

Her cotton constructs can operate as extensions of her magical abilities.

COTTON SHEEP:

Charmy's famous sheep-related magic manifests through her Cotton Magic.

The sheep can provide:

• cooking
• food
• support
• magical utility
• defensive assistance

The sheep are not independent S-rank fighters.

They should not be treated as an army of powerful combatants.

FOOD MAGIC:

Food Magic is one of Charmy's most unusual abilities.

Charmy can consume magical power through her Food Magic and convert it into nourishment and magical recovery.

This makes her extremely dangerous against opponents who rely heavily on magical energy.

However, Food Magic is NOT universal energy absorption.

MAGICAL ABSORPTION FAIRNESS RULE:

Charmy cannot automatically eat:

• every energy attack
• every supernatural power
• every form of magic
• souls
• concepts
• reality
• existence
• physical matter regardless of context

Her Food Magic interacts primarily with magical energy according to its established mechanics.

Foreign energy systems must be evaluated individually.

Ki is not automatically mana.

Cursed energy is not automatically mana.

Divine energy is not automatically mana.

Psychic energy is not automatically mana.

Cosmic or conceptual power is not automatically mana.

If a foreign energy system can meaningfully interact with her Food Magic, that interaction must be established through the battle rather than assumed.

MAGICAL RECOVERY:

Charmy's Food Magic can replenish magical power through consumption.

This makes her extremely useful during prolonged team battles.

However, recovery is not an unlimited reset.

Charmy requires:

• access to a compatible magical source
• time/opportunity to consume it
• successful activation of the technique
• sufficient capacity to process the recovered power

She cannot infinitely refill herself regardless of circumstances.

SELF-ENHANCEMENT:

When Charmy consumes magical energy through Food Magic, she can use the resulting nourishment and magical power to enhance herself.

This can increase:

• physical strength
• magical output
• stamina
• combat capability

The amount of enhancement depends on the available magical energy.

It does not provide arbitrary infinite power.

DWARF HERITAGE:

Charmy's dwarf heritage is a major source of her unusual physical and magical potential.

Her dwarf-related power can manifest through her transformation into a much more powerful combat form.

This dramatically changes her combat capabilities.

SHEEP COOK / WOLF FORM:

Charmy's most dangerous transformation manifests through her wolf-like dwarf form.

The form combines her magical and physical abilities into a far more aggressive combat state.

In this form she gains:

• immense physical strength
• greatly increased durability
• enhanced speed
• increased magical power
• extreme stamina
• powerful close-range attacks
• wolf-like physical characteristics
• enhanced predatory instincts

The transformation is a major escalation.

It is not her default opening move in every battle.

TRANSFORMATION BEHAVIOR:

Charmy can initially behave playfully and casually.

If seriously threatened, her combat instincts can become much more intense.

When her food, friends, or teammates are threatened, she can rapidly escalate.

She may transition from:

Cute/playful
→ irritated
→ serious
→ transformed
→ overwhelming physical combat

PERSONALITY:

Charmy is:

• cheerful
• energetic
• food-obsessed
• playful
• carefree
• affectionate
• stubborn
• unpredictable
• fiercely protective of her friends

Food is one of the strongest influences on her behavior.

She may become distracted by food.

She can become extremely angry when someone steals, destroys, or threatens her food.

She is also strongly protective of her allies.

Despite her comedic personality, she becomes frighteningly serious when her friends are threatened.

COMBAT INTELLIGENCE:

Charmy's Battle IQ is High.

She is not a traditional tactical genius.

Her fighting style relies heavily on:

• instinct
• overwhelming force
• transformation
• magical utility
• battlefield reactions
• protecting teammates

She can make surprisingly effective decisions under pressure.

However, she does not automatically calculate every possible interaction.

COMBAT STYLE:

Charmy's combat style changes depending on her form.

NORMAL FORM:

• Cotton Magic
• defensive support
• food creation
• battlefield utility
• ranged magical attacks
• support for teammates

SERIOUS COMBAT:

• increased magical output
• aggressive positioning
• physical attacks
• Food Magic
• magical absorption

WOLF/DWARF FORM:

• close-range combat
• overwhelming strength
• speed
• durability
• aggressive pursuit
• physical destruction
• enhanced magical attacks

PHYSICAL POWER:

Charmy's transformed state possesses enormous physical power.

She can overpower extremely strong magical opponents through raw force.

Her physical attacks can become devastating.

However, she is not automatically stronger than every physical powerhouse in Infinite Clash.

Strength comparisons remain matchup-dependent.

SPEED:

Charmy's transformed state possesses greatly enhanced speed and reactions.

However, she is not automatically among the absolute fastest fighters in the roster.

Extreme-speed opponents can still outmaneuver her.

Her enhanced durability and instincts compensate for some of this weakness.

DURABILITY:

Charmy's transformed body is extremely durable.

She can survive powerful attacks and continue fighting.

However, her durability is not absolute.

Sufficiently powerful:

• physical attacks
• magical attacks
• energy attacks
• conceptual attacks
• soul attacks
• existence attacks

may still defeat her depending on the interaction.

STAMINA:

Charmy possesses extreme stamina.

Her Food Magic can also help sustain her magical reserves.

This makes her particularly dangerous in prolonged battles.

However, Food Magic does not create infinite stamina.

Cumulative damage and battle fatigue still matter.

SUPPORT CAPABILITY:

Charmy's support role is primarily resource-based.

She can potentially help teammates by providing food and magical recovery.

This can be extremely valuable in team battles.

However, her support is not equivalent to Orihime's restoration.

Charmy does not automatically repair every physical injury.

She is primarily helping restore nourishment and magical resources.

MAGICAL RESOURCE RECOVERY:

Charmy can help replenish magical energy when the target and energy system are compatible with her Food Magic.

However, she cannot automatically refill every fictional power system.

A teammate using:

• ki
• cursed energy
• spiritual pressure
• divine power
• psychic energy
• life force

does not automatically have that resource restored by Charmy.

Compatibility must be established.

TEAM VALUE:

Charmy's value in 3v3 and 6v6 comes from the combination of:

• combat power
• resource recovery
• magical absorption
• transformation
• physical strength
• battlefield support

This makes her a true HYBRID rather than a dedicated SUPPORT character.

FOOD MAGIC VS MAGIC USERS:

Charmy is especially dangerous against opponents whose attacks and abilities are explicitly magical.

If an opponent launches a compatible magical attack, Charmy may potentially consume the magical component and convert it into nourishment.

However, she cannot automatically eat every attack.

For example:

A purely physical punch is not automatically edible.

A conceptual effect is not automatically food.

A reality rewrite is not automatically food.

A soul attack is not automatically food.

A magical attack must actually interact with her Food Magic.

MAGICAL ABSORPTION LIMIT:

Even compatible magic may be too powerful, too complex, too fast, or otherwise unsuitable for Charmy to consume safely.

She cannot automatically absorb an unlimited amount of magic in one instant.

The interaction depends on:

• magical composition
• scale
• speed
• concentration
• Charmy's capacity
• the attack's mechanics

COTTON DEFENSE:

Charmy's Cotton Magic can create defensive structures.

These can:

• block attacks
• cushion impacts
• protect allies
• manipulate terrain
• create temporary cover

However, these defenses are not infinitely durable.

TRANSFORMATION LIMITATIONS:

Charmy's strongest form is a major escalation.

It should not be treated as an effortless permanent state with infinite output.

Transformation still exists within her battle stamina and magical resources.

If Charmy remains transformed through prolonged combat, accumulated exhaustion can become relevant.

BATTLEFIELD UTILITY:

Charmy's cotton can provide unusual battlefield options.

She may create:

• cushions
• platforms
• barriers
• restraints
• support structures
• food-related constructs

She can use the environment creatively.

However, she cannot arbitrarily create anything she imagines.

Only established applications of her magic are allowed.

NO UNLIMITED CREATION:

Charmy cannot create an infinite number of powerful magical creatures.

Her sheep constructs remain manifestations of her Cotton Magic.

She cannot suddenly create an army of unrelated S-tier fighters.

NO ABILITY COPYING:

Food Magic does not grant Charmy the abilities of whatever she consumes.

Consuming magical power restores or empowers her.

It does not automatically give her:

• spells
• transformations
• techniques
• bloodlines
• conceptual powers
• memories
• abilities

from the opponent.

FOREIGN POWER SYSTEMS:

Every foreign power system is evaluated individually.

Ki:
Not automatically food.

Cursed Energy:
Not automatically food.

Spiritual Pressure:
Not automatically food.

Divine Power:
Not automatically food.

Psychic Energy:
Not automatically food.

Mana:
Most directly compatible with Charmy's established Food Magic, but the exact interaction still depends on the spell and circumstances.

Conceptual Power:
Not automatically absorbable.

Reality Manipulation:
Not automatically absorbable.

EXISTENCE / SOUL POWERS:

Charmy has no automatic immunity to:

• soul destruction
• existence erasure
• conceptual attacks
• reality manipulation
• sealing
• mental manipulation

Her dwarf heritage does not grant universal supernatural immunity.

EQUIPMENT:

Charmy primarily relies on her own magic.

No invented weapons are added.

Her Magic Knight affiliation does not grant her arbitrary equipment.

WEAKNESSES:

• Lower speed than the fastest roster members
• Normal form is substantially weaker than transformed form
• Transformation consumes resources
• Food Magic requires compatible magical energy
• Food Magic is not universal absorption
• Cannot automatically consume physical attacks
• Cannot consume concepts automatically
• Cannot consume existence itself
• Cannot absorb every supernatural energy system
• Cannot automatically copy abilities
• Cannot automatically refill every power system
• Support abilities are more useful when teammates use compatible magical resources
• Playful personality can cause distraction
• Food obsession can affect decision-making
• Can underestimate opponents
• Not a tactical mastermind
• Strong metaphysical abilities can bypass conventional durability
• Extreme-speed opponents can pressure her
• Cumulative injuries still matter
• No automatic regeneration
• No automatic resurrection
• No omnipotence
• No omniscience

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS LIMITATIONS:

Charmy does NOT have:

• infinite magical absorption
• universal energy absorption
• universal power nullification
• ability copying
• infinite food creation
• infinite summons
• automatic regeneration
• automatic resurrection
• conceptual immunity
• soul immunity
• existence immunity
• reality manipulation
• omnipotence
• omniscience
• infinite stamina
• automatic victory against magic users

CAPTAIN EFFECT:

FEAST OF BATTLE

If Charmy is selected as Captain, her team gains a resource-management and endurance advantage.

The effect improves:

• resource awareness
• stamina management
• recovery timing
• team sustainability
• protection of weakened allies
• prolonged combat coordination
• morale
• willingness to continue fighting
• recognition of when a teammate needs support

The Captain Effect does NOT automatically restore everyone's resources.

It does NOT grant Food Magic to teammates.

It does NOT give allies Charmy's abilities.

It represents Charmy's natural ability to keep a team supplied, energized, and fighting for longer.

1v1 BEHAVIOR:

Because Charmy is classified as HYBRID, she is eligible for standard 1v1.

In a 1v1 she cannot rely on teammates.

She therefore becomes more self-sufficient.

Her likely progression:

Playful testing
→ Cotton Magic
→ observe opponent
→ Food Magic if compatible
→ increased seriousness
→ dwarf/wolf transformation
→ aggressive close-range combat

She can fight independently.

3v3 BEHAVIOR:

Charmy can switch between combat and support.

She may:

• fight an enemy directly
• protect a teammate
• consume compatible enemy magic
• restore compatible magical resources
• provide food
• create cotton defenses
• transform if threatened
• attack the enemy's strongest fighter

Her decisions depend on the battlefield.

6v6 BEHAVIOR:

Charmy's hybrid nature is particularly valuable in Winner-Stays 6v6.

She may help teammates recover compatible magical resources between engagements when circumstances allow.

However, she does not reset their:

• injuries
• stamina
• cooldowns
• transformations
• spent abilities
• battle knowledge

She can contribute to recovery without erasing the consequences of previous fights.

Charmy herself also carries forward:

• injuries
• fatigue
• magical expenditure
• transformation duration
• consumed resources
• information gained

No automatic reset occurs.

BATTLE BEHAVIOR:

Against a conventional mage:

Charmy may attempt to exploit Food Magic.

Against a physical fighter:

She cannot simply eat their physical attacks and must rely more heavily on Cotton Magic and transformed combat.

Against a speedster:

She prioritizes defense and positioning.

Against a ranged attacker:

She may use cotton barriers and battlefield structures.

Against a powerful magical attack:

She may attempt to consume compatible magical energy if she has enough time and the attack can actually be interacted with.

Against a metaphysical opponent:

She cannot assume Food Magic will work.

Against a long battle:

Her stamina and resource management become increasingly valuable.

PERSONALITY IN COMBAT:

Charmy may:

• get distracted by food
• become excited by delicious food
• protect teammates fiercely
• become extremely angry if her food is destroyed
• underestimate an opponent initially
• suddenly become terrifying when seriously threatened

She should retain her comedic personality without becoming incompetent.

FINAL INFINITE CLASH INTERPRETATION:

Charmy is an S-rank HYBRID fighter.

She is eligible for:

• 1v1
• 3v3
• 6v6

Her strength comes from the unusual combination of:

• extreme transformed physical power
• Food Magic
• magical absorption
• resource recovery
• Cotton Magic
• defensive utility
• extreme stamina
• team support

She is particularly dangerous against compatible magic users.

However, she does not automatically absorb every supernatural attack.

Her Food Magic does not equal universal energy manipulation.

Her transformed form does not grant unlimited strength.

Her support abilities do not make her a dedicated healer.

She can be an excellent solo fighter while also providing meaningful team utility.

No predetermined winner.

Every battle is resolved through:

• established abilities
• compatibility
• speed
• durability
• range
• intelligence
• battlefield
• information
• stamina
• magical resources
• injuries
• transformation state
• tactical decisions
• personality
• team composition
• ability interaction
• luck where appropriate

Charmy is a hybrid combat/support specialist.

She can fight alone.

She becomes even more valuable when fighting alongside a team.
entries.name: Charmy Pappitson

entries.content:
LOREBOOK — ORIHIME INOUE

SOURCE:
Bleach

IDENTITY:
Orihime Inoue

NATURE:
Human / Spiritually Aware Human / Shun Shun Rikka User

RANK:
S

RARITY:
Mythic

ROLE:
Support / Defensive Specialist / Restoration Specialist / Rejection-Based Defender

BATTLE CLASSIFICATION:
SUPPORT

IMPORTANT BATTLE CLASSIFICATION RULE:

Orihime is classified as a SUPPORT fighter.

She is designed primarily around:

• protection
• healing
• restoration
• barriers
• defensive rejection
• ally preservation
• battlefield support

Because her primary combat value is strongly dependent on supporting teammates, Orihime is NOT eligible for standard 1v1 battles.

She may participate normally in:

• 3v3
• 6v6 Winner-Stays

In team battles, all of Orihime's established abilities function normally according to their individual mechanics.

This classification does NOT mean Orihime is weak.

She can be extremely influential in team battles and can potentially change the outcome of a fight through defensive and restorative abilities.

The classification exists because standard 1v1 removes much of the role her character is designed around.

SUPPORT CLASSIFICATION RULE:

SUPPORT fighters are primarily team-oriented characters whose strongest contribution comes from healing, protection, barriers, buffs, restoration, cleansing, information support, or similar abilities.

SUPPORT fighters:

• are excluded from standard 1v1
• are eligible for 3v3
• are eligible for 6v6
• remain fully autonomous
• can directly fight when necessary
• retain all established offensive abilities
• retain all established defensive abilities
• do not receive artificial stat boosts because of their classification

CORE CONCEPT:

Orihime Inoue is one of the most unusual defensive and restorative fighters in Bleach.

Her supernatural abilities manifest through the six fairies of the Shun Shun Rikka.

Unlike conventional healers, Orihime's powers operate through the concept of rejection.

Rather than simply repairing damage through conventional healing, she can reject a harmful event or phenomenon and restore the target to a previous condition.

This gives her extraordinary defensive and restorative potential.

Her abilities include:

• defensive barriers
• restoration
• healing
• rejection of attacks
• rejection of damage
• offensive severance
• protection of allies

Orihime is therefore exceptionally valuable in team combat.

However, her rejection abilities are NOT treated as unrestricted reality manipulation.

Every interaction must be evaluated according to the specific technique, target, phenomenon, scale, compatibility, and established mechanics.

POWER PROFILE:

Power: High
Speed: High
Defense: Extreme
Range: High
Battle IQ: High
Stamina: High

SPECIAL ABILITY POTENTIAL:
Extreme

DEFENSIVE POTENTIAL:
Anomaly

RESTORATION POTENTIAL:
Anomaly

PRIMARY POWER SYSTEM:

Shun Shun Rikka / Spirit Fairy Powers

The Shun Shun Rikka are six fairy-like spiritual manifestations associated with Orihime's hairpins.

They allow Orihime to perform different techniques based on:

• rejection
• restoration
• defense
• protection
• severance

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS RULE:

Orihime's rejection abilities are extremely unusual.

They can reject phenomena rather than simply overpowering them.

However, "rejection" is NOT interpreted as:

• omnipotence
• universal reality manipulation
• automatic power nullification
• automatic conceptual manipulation
• automatic existence erasure
• automatic restoration of anything

The exact interaction depends on the ability and the opponent.

SHUN SHUN RIKKA:

The six spirits are:

• Shun'ō
• Ayame
• Tsubaki
• Baigon
• Hinagiku
• Lily

Each has a distinct role within Orihime's techniques.

They are manifestations of her supernatural ability.

They are NOT six independent top-tier fighters.

Orihime remains the primary combatant.

POWERS:

• Shun Shun Rikka
• Santen Kesshun
• Sōten Kisshun
• Koten Zanshun
• Shiten Kōshun
• Defensive Rejection
• Restoration
• Healing
• Barrier Creation
• Phenomenon Rejection
• Damage Rejection
• Injury Restoration
• Offensive Severance
• Spiritual Perception
• Supernatural Awareness
• Defensive Support
• Ally Protection

SANTEN KESSHUN:

Santen Kesshun creates a triangular defensive barrier using three of the Shun Shun Rikka.

The barrier can reject incoming attacks instead of merely absorbing their force.

This makes it one of Orihime's most important defensive abilities.

It can protect:

• Orihime
• individual allies
• vulnerable teammates
• strategic positions

The barrier can withstand extremely powerful attacks.

FAIRNESS RULE:

Santen Kesshun is NOT infinitely durable.

Its effectiveness depends on:

• attack power
• attack type
• duration
• scale
• supernatural mechanics
• Orihime's concentration
• whether the attack can meaningfully interact with the barrier

A sufficiently powerful or fundamentally incompatible ability may overcome, bypass, disrupt, or interact with the barrier.

Orihime cannot maintain an infinitely powerful shield indefinitely.

SŌTEN KISSHUN:

Sōten Kisshun is Orihime's primary restoration technique.

It can reject injuries and restore a target from severe damage.

This is not ordinary biological healing.

The technique works through rejection of the harmful condition.

It can therefore repair injuries that would normally be impossible to treat through conventional methods.

Sōten Kisshun is one of the primary reasons Orihime is classified as SUPPORT.

FAIRNESS RULE:

Sōten Kisshun is NOT universal resurrection.

It does not automatically restore:

• erased concepts
• completely nonexistent targets
• inaccessible souls
• arbitrary metaphysical abstractions
• every form of existence erasure
• every supernatural condition
• infinite stamina
• spent abilities

The nature of the damage must be compatible with Orihime's rejection.

Healing repairs damage.

It does not automatically reset the entire combat state.

KOTEN ZANSHUN:

Koten Zanshun is Orihime's offensive rejection technique.

Tsubaki attacks between the two shields.

The technique rejects what lies between the shields rather than simply producing ordinary physical damage.

This gives Orihime a genuine offensive option.

However, Koten Zanshun is not treated as universal durability negation.

Its interaction depends on:

• target defenses
• spatial mechanics
• dimensional properties
• supernatural resistance
• conceptual protection
• existence protection
• whether Orihime can meaningfully target the opponent

Koten Zanshun can be dangerous against opponents who rely primarily on conventional durability.

It is not an automatic victory condition.

SHITEN KŌSHUN:

Shiten Kōshun is an advanced defensive/rejection technique involving multiple Shun Shun Rikka.

It provides another method of protecting against incoming attacks.

Orihime can use advanced defensive techniques when normal barriers are insufficient.

DEFENSIVE SPECIALIZATION:

Orihime is one of Infinite Clash's strongest defensive specialists.

Her main value comes from keeping teammates alive.

She can:

• block attacks
• protect allies
• heal injuries
• restore damaged teammates
• create defensive openings
• disrupt enemy attacks
• protect weakened fighters
• buy time for stronger allies

Her support value is particularly important in 3v3 and 6v6.

RESTORATION:

Orihime's restoration is extremely powerful.

She can restore serious physical damage and injuries.

Her abilities are especially useful after an ally survives a powerful attack.

However, restoration does not mean full combat reset.

RESTORATION DOES NOT AUTOMATICALLY:

• restore stamina
• restore spiritual energy
• restore mana
• restore ki
• restore cursed energy
• reset cooldowns
• restore used transformations
• restore spent ammunition
• restore destroyed equipment
• remove every curse
• remove every supernatural effect
• resurrect every dead fighter

If an ally has been heavily injured but is still conscious and reachable, Orihime may restore the injury.

The fighter remains subject to the rest of their accumulated battle state.

6v6 CARRYOVER:

In Winner-Stays 6v6, Orihime's healing can repair injuries suffered by teammates when she has an opportunity to do so.

However, the global battle state remains persistent.

Example:

A fighter uses a powerful transformation and becomes exhausted.

Orihime heals their physical injuries.

The fighter remains exhausted.

A fighter uses a limited ultimate ability.

Orihime heals them.

The ability remains spent.

A fighter has a cooldown.

Orihime heals them.

The cooldown remains.

A fighter has learned information about the opposing team.

That information remains.

Orihime repairs damage.

She does not rewrite the battle history.

SUPPORT ROLE IN 3v3:

Orihime is particularly valuable in simultaneous 3v3.

Her likely priorities include:

1. Protect the most vulnerable teammate.
2. Prevent an ally from being eliminated.
3. Heal serious injuries.
4. Create barriers against dangerous attacks.
5. Identify enemy threats.
6. Use offensive rejection when necessary.
7. Preserve team resources.

She does not control teammates.

Every fighter remains autonomous.

Orihime simply behaves according to her own personality and tactical judgment.

SUPPORT ROLE IN 6v6:

In Winner-Stays 6v6, Orihime can provide enormous strategic value.

If she survives while teammates are injured, she may restore them when the battle state and circumstances permit.

This can prevent an injured teammate from being removed from the battle due to accumulated physical damage.

However, Orihime herself also accumulates:

• fatigue
• spiritual energy expenditure
• concentration strain
• injuries
• defensive pressure

She does not receive a reset between fights.

SUPPORT DOES NOT MEAN PASSIVE:

Orihime is not required to stand still and heal.

If threatened, she can:

• defend herself
• attack
• reposition
• create barriers
• use rejection offensively
• protect another teammate
• retreat
• exploit an opening

She remains an autonomous combatant.

She simply prioritizes support when possible.

SPIRITUAL PERCEPTION:

Orihime possesses spiritual awareness and can perceive supernatural beings and phenomena.

She can recognize spiritual presences that ordinary humans cannot.

However, spiritual perception is NOT omniscience.

Foreign supernatural systems must be interpreted individually.

Ki, cursed energy, divine energy, psychic power, mana, life force, conceptual power, and other systems do not automatically appear identical to spiritual energy.

EMOTIONAL CONNECTION:

Orihime's powers are strongly influenced by her emotions and desire to protect others.

Her determination can dramatically increase her willingness to use her abilities.

She becomes especially serious when someone she cares about is threatened.

This is important to battle behavior.

She does not casually seek to kill opponents.

PERSONALITY:

Orihime is:

• kind
• compassionate
• cheerful
• imaginative
• emotionally sensitive
• protective
• loyal
• courageous
• sometimes innocent
• occasionally absent-minded

She strongly values the lives of others.

She generally prefers:

• protecting allies
• healing injuries
• preventing death
• defending others
• supporting stronger fighters

She does not naturally approach combat with bloodlust.

If an enemy threatens someone she loves, she can become extremely determined.

COMBAT INTELLIGENCE:

Orihime is not one of the roster's greatest tactical masterminds.

Her Battle IQ is High.

She understands her abilities and can make effective defensive decisions.

She can recognize:

• when someone needs protection
• when a barrier is necessary
• when an ally needs healing
• when an opponent is too dangerous
• when she should reposition
• when offense is required

However, she does not automatically calculate every possible outcome.

COMBAT STYLE:

Orihime's default combat style is defensive.

Typical sequence:

Protection
→ Barrier
→ Observe
→ Protect allies
→ Restore damage
→ Create opening
→ Offensive rejection if necessary

She becomes more aggressive only when circumstances demand it.

REACTION SPEED:

Orihime has supernatural reactions compared with ordinary humans.

However, she is not a top-tier speed specialist.

Extreme-speed opponents can pressure her.

If she is incapacitated before activating her defense, her physical body can be vulnerable.

This is one of the most important limitations on her otherwise powerful defensive abilities.

CONCENTRATION:

Orihime's techniques require active use.

Distraction, surprise, incapacitation, psychological pressure, or overwhelming speed can interfere with her ability to respond.

She cannot simply have every possible defense active at maximum effectiveness at all times.

SHUN SHUN RIKKA LIMITATION:

The Shun Shun Rikka do not function as six independent high-tier fighters.

They execute Orihime's techniques.

They should not be treated as six separate combatants capable of independently defeating major roster fighters.

REJECTION MECHANIC:

Orihime's defining principle is rejection.

She can reject a phenomenon rather than merely overpowering it.

This can produce unusual interactions with:

• physical attacks
• energy attacks
• injuries
• barriers
• objects
• certain supernatural effects

But every interaction remains contextual.

CONCEPTUAL ATTACKS:

Orihime does not automatically reject concepts.

A conceptual attack must be evaluated individually.

Her rejection abilities may interact unusually with certain metaphysical phenomena, but no universal conceptual immunity is granted.

EXISTENCE ERASURE:

Orihime cannot automatically restore anything erased from existence.

If an opponent completely removes a target from existence, Sōten Kisshun does not automatically guarantee restoration.

The mechanism and remaining interaction must be evaluated.

SOUL ATTACKS:

Orihime possesses spiritual awareness and can interact with spiritual beings.

She does not possess automatic immunity to soul destruction.

Soul-based attacks are evaluated individually.

TIME MANIPULATION:

Orihime's restoration is NOT unrestricted time manipulation.

She does not gain universal temporal control.

Restoring an injury does not mean she can freely reverse all events in time.

REALITY MANIPULATION:

Orihime's rejection abilities can resemble reality alteration.

However, she is NOT an unrestricted reality warper.

She cannot simply declare:

"That ability does not exist."

She must use an established Shun Shun Rikka technique against a phenomenon that the technique can meaningfully interact with.

POWER NULLIFICATION:

Orihime does not automatically nullify powers.

She can reject specific attacks or effects when the technique can interact with them.

She cannot simply turn off another fighter's entire power system.

NO AUTOMATIC IMMORTALITY:

Orihime is not immortal.

If she cannot defend herself, sufficiently powerful attacks can defeat her.

NO AUTOMATIC RESURRECTION:

Orihime cannot resurrect every dead fighter.

Death, soul destruction, and existence erasure require individual evaluation.

EQUIPMENT:

• Shun Shun Rikka hairpins

No additional invented weapons or artifacts.

WEAKNESSES:

• Relatively low physical strength
• Lower speed than elite speedsters
• Vulnerable to surprise attacks
• Requires concentration
• Defensive techniques are not infinite
• Healing requires activation
• Healing requires an opportunity
• Offensive output is limited compared with destructive specialists
• Barriers can be overcome
• Foreign supernatural mechanics can bypass or interfere with rejection
• Conceptual attacks are not automatically rejected
• Soul attacks are not automatically rejected
• Existence erasure is not automatically reversed
• Reality manipulation is not automatically nullified
• Cannot automatically resurrect the dead
• Cannot restore infinite stamina
• Cannot restore spent abilities
• Cannot reset cooldowns
• Emotional attachment can influence tactical decisions
• Reluctance to kill can limit offensive choices

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS LIMITATIONS:

Orihime does NOT have:

• omnipotence
• omniscience
• universal reality manipulation
• universal power nullification
• universal conceptual rejection
• universal existence restoration
• automatic resurrection
• infinite healing
• infinite barriers
• infinite stamina
• automatic soul immunity
• automatic time reversal
• automatic dimensional superiority
• automatic victory against stronger opponents

FOREIGN POWER SYSTEM INTERACTION:

Ki:
Orihime can attempt to defend against ki-based attacks, but ki is not automatically classified as spiritual energy.

Cursed Energy:
Cursed techniques must be evaluated individually.

Magic:
Magical attacks can potentially interact with her barriers and rejection abilities, but powerful or unusual magic may behave differently.

Divine Power:
Divine attacks are not automatically rejected.

Psychic Powers:
Psychic effects are evaluated according to their mechanism.

Conceptual Powers:
No automatic rejection.

Existence Manipulation:
No automatic restoration.

CAPTAIN EFFECT:

SOVEREIGN PROTECTION

If Orihime is selected as Captain, her team gains a defensive coordination advantage.

The effect improves:

• ally protection
• defensive positioning
• emergency response
• injury awareness
• retreat timing
• protection of vulnerable teammates
• coordinated defensive actions
• survival-focused tactics
• rescue decisions
• team cohesion

The Captain Effect does NOT grant Orihime's powers to teammates.

It does NOT automatically heal the team.

It does NOT create permanent barriers.

It represents Orihime's ability to prioritize team survival and coordinate protection.

BATTLE BEHAVIOR:

Against a physical powerhouse:

Orihime prioritizes barriers and distance.

Against a ranged attacker:

She prioritizes defensive rejection and positioning.

Against a speedster:

She attempts to establish protection before the attack arrives.

Against an opponent with regeneration:

Koten Zanshun may become more valuable because its mechanics differ from conventional physical damage.

Against an unfamiliar supernatural ability:

She observes cautiously and tests defensive interactions.

Against an overwhelming opponent:

She prioritizes survival and protection rather than attempting a direct power contest.

AGAINST TEAMMATES:

Orihime does not automatically prioritize the strongest teammate.

Her decisions depend on:

• who is injured
• who is under immediate threat
• who is capable of continuing the fight
• who can protect her
• which teammate is strategically important
• the current battlefield

She can make mistakes.

BATTLE PHILOSOPHY:

Protect.

Endure.

Restore.

Create an opening.

Use rejection when necessary.

Orihime's greatest contribution is keeping her team alive long enough for them to win.

FINAL INFINITE CLASH INTERPRETATION:

Orihime is a SUPPORT-class S-rank fighter.

She is intentionally excluded from standard 1v1.

She is fully eligible for 3v3 and 6v6.

Her ranking reflects the extraordinary impact of her defensive, restorative, and rejection-based abilities in team combat rather than raw destructive power.

Her greatest strengths are:

• exceptional defense
• powerful barriers
• extraordinary restoration
• rejection-based abilities
• team protection
• support value
• unusual ability interactions
• survival potential

Her greatest weaknesses are:

• lower physical power
• lower speed than elite speedsters
• concentration requirements
• finite defensive endurance
• vulnerability to surprise
• lack of automatic resistance to foreign metaphysical systems
• inability to reject absolutely everything
• reluctance to kill

She can dramatically change the outcome of a team battle.

She can protect an ally from an attack that would otherwise end the fight.

She can restore severe injuries.

She can create opportunities for stronger teammates.

But she can also be defeated if an opponent overwhelms her defenses, prevents her from acting, exploits her lower speed, or possesses an ability that her rejection cannot meaningfully counter.

SUPPORT CLASSIFICATION IS NOT A POWER PENALTY.

It only determines battle-mode eligibility.

No predetermined winner.

Every team battle is resolved through:

• established abilities
• compatibility
• speed
• durability
• range
• intelligence
• battlefield
• information
• stamina
• concentration
• injuries
• resources
• tactical decisions
• personality
• ability interaction
• team composition
• cooperation
• luck where appropriate

Orihime is a support specialist.

In team battles, she can be extraordinarily powerful.

She is not used in standard 1v1.

entries.content:
LOREBOOK — MICHAEL DEMIURGOS

SOURCE:
DC / Vertigo Comics — Lucifer / The Sandman cosmology

IDENTITY:
Michael Demiurgos

NATURE:
Archangel / Primordial Celestial Being / Demiurgic Power

RANK:
ANOMALY

RARITY:
Mythic

ROLE:
Primordial Archangel / Demiurgic Powerhouse / Cosmic Warrior

CORE CONCEPT:

Michael Demiurgos is one of the most powerful beings in the DC/Vertigo cosmology.

He is a primordial archangel whose defining attribute is the vast demiurgic power within him.

Michael's power is not simply conventional energy manipulation.

His Demiurgic Force represents an immense creative potential capable of generating and empowering cosmic-scale creation.

Michael is particularly notable for possessing an enormous reservoir of primordial power that can be released through his will.

He is one of the few beings whose raw power belongs to the highest levels of his cosmological setting.

For Infinite Clash, Michael is treated as an ANOMALY-level cosmic entity.

However, his cosmological status does NOT automatically grant him authority over every fictional universe or every supernatural system.

POWER PROFILE:

Power: ANOMALY
Speed: Extreme
Defense: ANOMALY
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: ANOMALY
Stamina: ANOMALY

DEMIURGIC POWER:
ANOMALY

COSMIC PRESENCE:
ANOMALY

MAGICAL / ENERGY INTERACTION:
Extreme

PRIMARY POWER SYSTEM:

Demiurgic Force / Primordial Celestial Power

Michael's power is fundamentally different from ordinary magic, ki, cursed energy, or physical strength.

His supernatural abilities are derived from his primordial celestial nature and demiurgic power.

His power can manifest as enormous energy output, creation-oriented force, destructive force, cosmic manipulation, and reinforcement of his own existence.

DIVINE / CELESTIAL PHYSIOLOGY:

Michael possesses the supernatural nature of a primordial archangel.

This grants him:

• immense physical strength
• immense durability
• extreme speed
• extreme reflexes
• immense stamina
• flight
• supernatural senses
• celestial perception
• cosmic awareness
• resistance to conventional physical attacks
• resistance to supernatural attacks
• immense energy capacity
• resistance to hostile environments
• extremely high resistance to magical effects
• extraordinary recovery

His physical body is vastly beyond ordinary beings.

However, celestial physiology is NOT treated as absolute immunity to every supernatural attack.

DEMIURGIC FORCE:

Michael's defining power is his immense demiurgic energy.

The Demiurgic Force is an extraordinarily powerful primordial energy associated with creation.

Michael can release and manipulate this power through:

• energy projection
• concentrated attacks
• large-scale blasts
• defensive force
• environmental destruction
• cosmic-scale energy release
• creation-related phenomena
• empowerment of existing cosmic structures

The amount of power Michael can bring to bear is enormous.

However, Infinite Clash does not interpret "creation power" as unlimited wish fulfillment.

Michael cannot simply declare any opponent nonexistent without an established mechanism allowing such an interaction.

CREATIVE POWER:

Michael's demiurgic nature gives him an extraordinary relationship with creation.

His power can contribute to or generate immense cosmic structures and energy.

Creation-oriented power can potentially be used offensively or defensively.

However:

Creation does NOT mean Michael can instantly create anything imaginable.

He cannot arbitrarily invent:

• unlimited artifacts
• infinite armies
• arbitrary abilities
• perfect counters
• new cosmologies
• automatic conceptual weapons

without an established basis.

COSMIC ENERGY MANIPULATION:

Michael can manipulate enormous amounts of celestial/demiurgic energy.

This can manifest as:

• concentrated beams
• explosive releases
• massive energy waves
• defensive barriers
• destructive bursts
• controlled energy constructs
• cosmic-scale attacks

His attacks can reach extraordinary destructive scales.

Energy resistance and durability of opponents are still evaluated individually.

PHYSICAL STRENGTH:

Michael possesses extraordinary physical strength.

He can physically contend with beings operating on cosmic scales.

His strength is not merely magical amplification.

His celestial body itself possesses immense physical power.

He can:

• strike extremely durable opponents
• grapple powerful entities
• overpower lesser supernatural beings
• survive catastrophic impacts
• fight cosmic-level opponents directly

Physical strength does not automatically bypass metaphysical defenses.

COMBAT SPEED:

Michael's reactions and movement are extremely fast.

His celestial nature allows him to operate at speeds far beyond conventional beings.

However, he is NOT automatically the fastest fighter in Infinite Clash.

Extreme-speed and speed-based supernatural abilities must be compared individually.

Speed does not grant automatic immunity to:

• area-wide attacks
• spatial effects
• conceptual abilities
• reality manipulation
• unavoidable supernatural effects

FLIGHT:

Michael possesses supernatural flight.

His flight is not dependent on conventional aerodynamics.

He can maneuver through large battlefields and operate in environments where normal movement would be impossible.

Flight does not automatically grant infinite speed.

COSMIC PERCEPTION:

Michael possesses extraordinary perception.

He can perceive supernatural and cosmic phenomena far beyond normal senses.

He is capable of recognizing immense energy signatures and cosmic events.

However:

Cosmic perception is NOT omniscience.

He does not automatically know every ability possessed by every fighter.

He must still observe and interpret unfamiliar powers.

CELESTIAL AWARENESS:

Michael has an extremely high level of awareness of supernatural forces.

He can recognize:

• immense energy
• divine entities
• magical phenomena
• cosmic structures
• supernatural threats
• large-scale disturbances

Foreign systems still need to be interpreted individually.

MAGICAL RESISTANCE:

Michael possesses enormous resistance to conventional magic and supernatural force.

However, this is not universal magic immunity.

A sufficiently powerful or fundamentally different magical system may still affect him.

Every foreign ability is evaluated based on:

• mechanism
• scale
• compatibility
• resistance
• interaction
• established feats

ENERGY RESISTANCE:

Michael can withstand extraordinary amounts of energy.

However, durability is not treated as absolute.

Extremely powerful attacks, conceptual effects, soul attacks, existence manipulation, reality manipulation, or other appropriate supernatural abilities may interact with him depending on their established mechanics.

RECOVERY:

Michael possesses extraordinary resilience and recovery due to his celestial nature.

He can withstand catastrophic levels of damage.

However, recovery is not treated as infinite automatic regeneration.

Damage that bypasses conventional physical durability may remain meaningful.

EXISTENCE:

Michael's existence is fundamentally different from that of ordinary humans.

He is an immortal celestial being within his source cosmology.

His existence is extraordinarily difficult to destroy through conventional means.

However:

Immortality-like existence does NOT automatically protect him from:

• conceptual destruction
• soul manipulation
• existence manipulation
• sealing
• reality alteration
• higher-order metaphysical attacks
• abilities specifically designed to affect immortal entities

Such interactions must be evaluated individually.

COSMOLOGICAL SCALE:

Michael operates at one of the highest levels of the DC/Vertigo cosmology.

His relationship with Lucifer and the larger cosmological hierarchy establishes his extraordinary status.

However, Infinite Clash does NOT import the entire DC cosmology as an automatic rule over other universes.

Michael does not automatically outrank every being simply because they come from another fictional setting.

CROSS-VERSE FAIRNESS:

Michael retains his established powers.

The opponent retains theirs.

Cosmological hierarchies are compared rather than assumed identical.

A foreign "supreme being" is not automatically weaker than Michael.

Likewise, Michael is not automatically weakened simply because an opponent comes from another fictional setting.

The battle determines interaction based on established abilities and compatible mechanics.

PERSONALITY:

Michael is proud, serious, intense, loyal, and extremely confident.

He possesses the bearing of a primordial archangel.

He can be imposing and authoritative.

Unlike Lucifer, Michael is generally less defined by elaborate manipulation and philosophical games.

Michael is strongly associated with loyalty, duty, creation, and his relationship with his brother Lucifer.

He can be emotional beneath his immense power.

His personality matters in combat.

He does not automatically begin every fight with maximum destructive output.

He can assess an opponent before escalating.

He is not mindlessly bloodlusted.

COMBAT INTELLIGENCE:

Michael possesses extremely high combat intelligence.

He is an ancient celestial being with enormous experience dealing with supernatural and cosmic threats.

He can:

• analyze opponents
• recognize dangerous abilities
• adapt to changing battle conditions
• choose between physical and energy attacks
• manage his power output
• exploit openings
• fight strategically
• recognize when escalation is necessary

His intelligence is not omniscience.

He can be surprised by abilities he has never encountered.

COMBAT STYLE:

Michael generally favors direct overwhelming power over elaborate trickery.

His fighting style can include:

• direct physical combat
• high-speed aerial combat
• energy projection
• concentrated demiurgic attacks
• defensive barriers
• overwhelming cosmic force
• controlled escalation

He does not need to rely on complicated techniques to be dangerous.

His raw power is itself a major weapon.

BATTLE BEHAVIOR:

Michael generally begins by evaluating the opponent.

Against an unknown fighter:

Observation
→ Defensive assessment
→ Physical engagement or controlled energy attack
→ Evaluation of resistance
→ Increased demiurgic output
→ Cosmic escalation if required

Against an opponent who demonstrates overwhelming power, Michael becomes more serious quickly.

He does not intentionally prolong combat simply for entertainment.

DEMIURGIC ESCALATION:

Michael can progressively increase the amount of demiurgic power released.

Lower levels may involve:

• physical combat
• small energy attacks
• defensive force
• aerial maneuvering

Higher levels may involve:

• enormous energy releases
• cosmic-scale attacks
• massive environmental destruction
• overwhelming demiurgic force

His strongest output should be treated as a major escalation rather than his default opening move.

SIGNATURE ABILITIES:

• Demiurgic Force
• Demiurgic Energy Projection
• Celestial Might
• Archangelic Physiology
• Cosmic Energy Manipulation
• Divine Flight
• Celestial Perception
• Cosmic Awareness
• Primordial Creation Power
• Cosmic-Scale Energy Release
• Celestial Barrier
• Demiurgic Blast
• Archangelic Strike
• Cosmic Force
• Celestial Reinforcement

MICHAEL'S DEMIURGIC POWER:

Michael's most important ability is his enormous reservoir of demiurgic energy.

This power is fundamentally connected to creation within the cosmology of his source.

It can produce extraordinary energy and cosmic effects.

FAIRNESS RULE:

Demiurgic power is NOT treated as unlimited omnipotence.

Michael cannot automatically create, erase, rewrite, or control anything merely because his power is creation-associated.

The exact effect depends on how he applies the power and what the opponent's established defenses allow.

CREATION VS DESTRUCTION:

Michael's power can manifest as creation-oriented or destructive energy.

Creation does not automatically equal healing.

Destruction does not automatically equal existence erasure.

Every application must have a mechanically plausible interaction.

NO AUTOMATIC CONCEPTUAL CONTROL:

Michael is not automatically granted unrestricted conceptual manipulation.

His cosmic status does not allow him to simply erase concepts from opponents unless an established ability specifically provides that interaction.

NO AUTOMATIC REALITY WARping:

Michael's cosmic scale does not equal unrestricted reality warping.

He can manipulate enormous amounts of power and participate in cosmic creation, but Infinite Clash does not grant him arbitrary reality rewriting.

NO AUTOMATIC SOUL MANIPULATION:

Michael does not automatically destroy souls simply because he is an archangel.

Soul-based interactions must come from an established ability or a valid source mechanism.

NO AUTOMATIC EXISTENCE ERASURE:

His destructive energy is not automatically treated as existence erasure.

An opponent with unusual existence-based defenses must be evaluated individually.

WEAPONS:

Michael does not require a conventional weapon to fight.

His body and demiurgic power are his primary weapons.

No invented celestial sword or artifact is added to his profile.

WEAKNESSES:

• No automatic omnipotence
• No automatic omniscience
• No universal reality manipulation
• No universal conceptual manipulation
• No automatic existence erasure
• No automatic soul destruction
• No universal immortality against all mechanisms
• No automatic foreign-system knowledge
• No automatic cross-verse supremacy
• No infinite ability creation
• No infinite army creation
• No automatic power copying
• Extremely powerful attacks may still interact with his defenses
• Metaphysical attacks may bypass conventional durability
• Sealing can matter depending on the mechanism
• Conceptual abilities can matter depending on compatibility
• Reality manipulation can matter depending on scale and interaction
• Personality and emotional factors can influence decisions
• Strongest output is not automatically used at the beginning
• Demiurgic power is enormous but is not treated as a limitless resource without consequence

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS LIMITATIONS:

Michael does NOT have:

• omnipotence
• omniscience
• infinite stamina by default
• universal immunity
• universal power nullification
• automatic conceptual supremacy
• automatic existence supremacy
• automatic reality rewrite
• automatic soul immunity
• automatic fate immunity
• automatic dimensional supremacy
• automatic victory over gods
• automatic victory over other ANOMALY fighters
• plot armor

FOREIGN POWER SYSTEM INTERACTION:

Ki:
Michael can perceive extraordinary energy but does not automatically understand ki techniques.

Cursed Energy:
Michael may recognize supernatural energy but does not automatically know cursed techniques or domain mechanics.

Mana:
Michael can recognize magical energy but does not automatically possess knowledge of another mage's spell system.

Divine Power:
Michael recognizes divine/supernatural beings but must determine their specific nature and authority.

Psychic Power:
Psychic abilities are evaluated according to their mechanism rather than automatically classified as magic.

Conceptual Powers:
Michael does not automatically override concepts.

Reality Manipulation:
Michael does not automatically overpower reality manipulation simply because of his cosmological rank.

Soul/Existence Powers:
These must interact with his celestial existence according to their established mechanics.

CAPTAIN EFFECT:

DEMIURGIC COMMAND

If Michael is selected as Captain, his team gains a coordination advantage based on his immense experience, authority, awareness, and ability to recognize overwhelming threats.

The effect improves:

• threat recognition
• tactical confidence
• target prioritization
• battlefield awareness
• coordinated attacks
• defensive positioning
• escalation timing
• protection of vulnerable teammates
• strategic focus
• resistance to intimidation

Michael's Captain Effect does NOT grant demiurgic power to teammates.

It does NOT increase their raw statistics.

It does NOT allow him to control their minds.

Each fighter remains autonomous.

6v6 BEHAVIOR:

Michael's performance in Winner-Stays 6v6 must account for accumulated battle state.

If Michael defeats an opponent and remains active, he carries forward:

• injuries
• fatigue
• energy expenditure
• defensive damage
• active effects
• cooldowns where applicable
• information gained
• changes in tactical understanding

He does NOT receive a complete restoration between opponents.

Because Michael possesses extraordinary stamina, he can potentially survive a long sequence of battles.

However, cumulative damage still matters.

Repeated maximum-output attacks should eventually create meaningful resource and battle-state consequences.

TEAM BEHAVIOR:

When Michael is Captain, he tends toward disciplined and direct team coordination.

He may encourage:

• focusing the greatest threat
• protecting injured teammates
• coordinated attacks
• controlled escalation
• exploiting openings
• preventing unnecessary sacrifices
• maintaining formation
• concentrating fire against isolated enemies

He does not override the autonomy of his teammates.

BATTLE PHILOSOPHY:

Michael fights like a primordial celestial warrior.

He does not need elaborate deception when overwhelming force is available.

But he is not reckless.

His ideal battle progression is:

Understand the threat
→ Establish superiority
→ Apply controlled force
→ Escalate when necessary
→ End the battle decisively

FINAL INFINITE CLASH INTERPRETATION:

Michael Demiurgos is one of the highest-tier beings in Infinite Clash.

His defining advantages are:

• extraordinary demiurgic power
• immense celestial durability
• enormous energy reserves
• cosmic-scale offensive potential
• extreme speed
• extraordinary combat intelligence
• primordial celestial existence
• immense resistance to conventional supernatural attacks

However, his ANOMALY ranking does not make him an automatic winner.

He can still encounter opponents whose abilities interact favorably against him.

He can be affected by sufficiently powerful metaphysical mechanics.

He does not automatically understand foreign abilities.

He does not automatically possess every possible divine or cosmic power.

His strongest abilities require meaningful escalation.

No predetermined winner.

Every battle is resolved through:

• established abilities
• compatibility
• speed
• durability
• range
• intelligence
• battlefield
• information
• stamina
• resource expenditure
• injuries
• tactical decisions
• personality
• ability interaction
• luck where appropriate

Michael is extraordinarily powerful.

He is not an automatic victory condition.

entries.content:
LOREBOOK — LLOYD DE SALOUM

SOURCE:
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability

IDENTITY:
Lloyd de Saloum

NATURE:
Human / Reincarnated Sorcerer / Seventh Prince of the Saloum Kingdom

RANK:
ANOMALY

RARITY:
Mythic

ROLE:
Extreme Versatility Mage / Magical Researcher / Combat Sorcerer

CORE CONCEPT:
Lloyd is a young reincarnated sorcerer whose overwhelming talent, enormous mana reserves, extraordinary magical understanding, and obsessive curiosity allow him to study and utilize an enormous variety of magic.

Unlike many powerful characters, Lloyd's greatest advantage is not simply raw destructive output. His greatest strength is understanding magic itself. He observes magical phenomena, studies how they function, experiments with them, and adapts his own spellcasting accordingly.

He genuinely loves magic and approaches combat as both a battle and an opportunity to learn.

POWER PROFILE:

Power: Anomaly
Speed: Extreme
Defense: Extreme
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: Anomaly
Stamina: Anomaly

MAGICAL CAPACITY:
Anomaly

MAGICAL KNOWLEDGE:
Anomaly

ADAPTABILITY:
Anomaly

PHYSICAL COMBAT:
High

SPECIALIZATION:
Extreme magical versatility

PRIMARY ENERGY SYSTEM:
Mana / Magic

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS RULE:
Lloyd's mana and magic are treated as his own established power system.

His mana is extraordinarily vast, but it is not treated as literally infinite.

His magical knowledge is extraordinary, but it is not automatically equivalent to omniscience.

He can understand, analyze, reproduce, modify, combine, and develop magical techniques to an extraordinary degree, but foreign supernatural systems are not automatically understood perfectly on first contact.

His intelligence allows him to learn extremely quickly, but learning still depends on what he can actually observe, analyze, and interact with.

ABILITIES:

• Extraordinary Magical Talent
• Immense Mana Reserves
• Extreme Mana Control
• Advanced Spellcasting
• Magical Analysis
• Magical Research
• Magical Experimentation
• Rapid Magical Learning
• Spell Modification
• Spell Combination
• Spell Replication
• Magical Adaptation
• Elemental Magic
• Fire Magic
• Water Magic
• Wind Magic
• Earth Magic
• Lightning Magic
• Ice Magic
• Light Magic
• Dark Magic
• Spatial Magic
• Defensive Magic
• Offensive Magic
• Barrier Magic
• Reinforcement Magic
• Binding Magic
• Summoning/Construct Magic
• Mana Manipulation
• Atmospheric Mana Manipulation
• Magical Detection
• Mana Detection
• Mana Concealment
• Magical Perception
• Telekinetic/Force-Based Magic
• Long-Range Spellcasting
• Area-of-Effect Magic
• Precision Spellcasting
• Multi-Spell Casting
• Simultaneous Spell Control
• Magical Constructs
• Magical Experimentation
• Counter-Magic Analysis
• Spatial Manipulation through established magic
• Void-Class Magic
• Pseudo-Realm Manipulation through established spells
• Magical Barrier Destruction
• Magical Negation through compatible techniques
• Magical Reinforcement
• Supernatural Reflexes
• Enhanced Physical Movement
• Magical Flight/Mobility where applicable
• High-Level Combat Adaptation

MAGICAL INTELLIGENCE:

Lloyd's most dangerous ability is his understanding of magic.

He does not simply memorize spells.

He studies their structure.

He can examine unfamiliar magic, compare its properties to techniques he already understands, experiment with interactions, and develop solutions during combat.

This makes Lloyd exceptionally dangerous against opponents who rely heavily on predictable supernatural mechanics.

However, this does NOT mean Lloyd instantly understands every ability in Infinite Clash.

Foreign powers may operate according to completely different principles.

Ki, cursed energy, divine authority, conceptual powers, psychic abilities, reality manipulation, spiritual powers, biological abilities, and other systems must be analyzed individually.

Lloyd can eventually understand some of these systems if sufficient information is available, but he does not begin every battle with complete knowledge of them.

MANA MANIPULATION:

Lloyd possesses an extraordinary amount of mana.

His mana can be used for:

• offensive spells
• defensive barriers
• reinforcement
• movement
• detection
• environmental manipulation
• spatial magic
• destructive magic
• magical experiments
• spell construction
• complex multi-layered techniques

His magical output can reach an extreme scale.

His mana is not treated as an unlimited resource.

Prolonged combat, repeated high-level spells, defensive barriers, complex spatial techniques, and extreme magical experiments can eventually create resource pressure.

SPELL VERSATILITY:

Lloyd can utilize many different categories of magic.

His versatility allows him to switch between:

• direct attacks
• elemental attacks
• defensive barriers
• mobility
• restraints
• spatial techniques
• countermeasures
• detection
• magical manipulation
• large-scale attacks
• precision attacks
• experimental techniques

He does not need to specialize in one element.

He can select techniques according to the opponent and battlefield.

MAGICAL REPLICATION:

Lloyd has demonstrated the ability to reproduce magical techniques after understanding their structure.

This is one of his greatest advantages.

However:

Replication is NOT automatic power copying.

Lloyd cannot simply observe another fighter once and permanently acquire their entire supernatural arsenal.

He must understand what he is observing.

A technique based on an incompatible biological body, divine identity, conceptual existence, unique soul structure, or external artifact may not be directly reproducible.

He may instead attempt to reproduce the underlying magical principle if it is compatible with his own system.

SPATIAL MAGIC:

Lloyd possesses access to extremely advanced spatial-class magic.

Spatial techniques can manipulate distance, space, containment, positioning, or pseudo-realms depending on the established spell.

His spatial magic can become especially dangerous against conventional barriers.

However:

Spatial magic is NOT treated as universal dimensional superiority.

Foreign spatial defenses, teleportation systems, dimensional powers, reality manipulation, conceptual abilities, and higher-order existence must be evaluated individually.

VOID / UMBRAL MAGIC:

Lloyd can utilize extremely destructive spatial/void-class magic.

The Umbral Mortisphere is an example of an extremely dangerous technique that can transport barriers or targets into a pseudo-realm where they are reduced to nothing.

Void-class magic is among Lloyd's strongest offensive options.

However, it is NOT treated as universal existence erasure.

Targets with appropriate spatial, dimensional, metaphysical, conceptual, or reality-based defenses may resist, escape, interfere with, or counter the technique depending on their established abilities.

Lloyd may also discover that two compatible void-type techniques can interfere with or negate one another.

DEFENSIVE MAGIC:

Lloyd can create magical barriers and defensive structures.

His defenses can protect against:

• physical attacks
• elemental attacks
• magical attacks
• energy projection
• environmental hazards
• certain supernatural effects

His barriers are extremely powerful but are not absolute.

Enough force, the correct counter, incompatible effects, spatial manipulation, conceptual attacks, or other supernatural mechanics can overcome them.

Lloyd is therefore not allowed to hide behind an infinitely durable barrier.

OFFENSIVE MAGIC:

Lloyd can attack from:

• close range
• mid range
• long range
• above the battlefield
• below the battlefield
• multiple directions
• area-wide zones
• precise target points

He can combine different spells and change attack patterns rapidly.

His offensive style is highly adaptive rather than repetitive.

MAGICAL PRECISION:

Lloyd can use extremely precise magical control.

He can manipulate spells at different scales.

This allows him to avoid unnecessary destruction when he is interested in studying an opponent.

Against an extremely dangerous enemy, he can also increase the scale of his attacks.

MULTI-SPELL CONTROL:

Lloyd can operate multiple magical effects simultaneously.

This allows him to combine:

• offense + defense
• mobility + attack
• barriers + projectiles
• restraints + elemental attacks
• detection + countermeasures
• multiple attack vectors

This is one of the main reasons his Battle IQ is rated at Anomaly.

PHYSICAL ABILITY:

Lloyd is not primarily a physical powerhouse.

His body is that of a young human prince.

However, magic can greatly enhance his physical capabilities, reactions, movement, durability, and combat performance.

His physical statistics therefore cannot be judged solely by his natural body.

He should not automatically match characters whose primary abilities are raw physical strength without relying on magical reinforcement.

COMBAT SPEED:

Lloyd's magical reactions and combat processing are extremely fast.

He can perceive magical phenomena, analyze attacks, and respond rapidly.

His physical movement can also be enhanced through magic.

However, this does not mean he automatically outspeeds every extreme-speed fighter.

Characters whose speed is based on fundamentally different supernatural mechanics may still overwhelm him before he has enough information.

MAGICAL DETECTION:

Lloyd can sense and analyze mana and magical phenomena.

His perception is extremely useful for identifying:

• magical signatures
• energy concentrations
• spell construction
• hidden magical effects
• abnormal mana
• magical weaknesses

However:

Mana detection is not omniscience.

He cannot automatically detect every fictional energy system.

Ki, cursed energy, psychic energy, divine power, spiritual energy, life force, conceptual existence, or other systems may not initially register in the same way.

He must interpret unfamiliar systems through observation.

MAGICAL ADAPTATION:

Lloyd becomes more dangerous as a battle continues.

He may:

• identify an opponent's attack pattern
• test their defenses
• compare magical interactions
• modify spell structure
• change range
• change attack vectors
• develop counters
• exploit weaknesses
• create combinations

This makes him particularly dangerous in prolonged battles.

However, adaptation requires surviving long enough to learn.

He cannot automatically adapt after being instantly defeated.

RESEARCHER MINDSET:

Lloyd's curiosity can influence his combat decisions.

If he encounters a completely unfamiliar ability, he may become fascinated rather than immediately choosing the safest possible attack.

He may intentionally allow himself to observe an attack or phenomenon.

This can create genuine risk.

He is not a perfect combat AI.

PERSONALITY:

Lloyd is cheerful, innocent-looking, curious, eccentric, highly intelligent, and completely obsessed with magic.

His greatest passion is magical research.

He has little interest in:

• political power
• royal succession
• romance
• social status
• conventional responsibilities

His attention is overwhelmingly directed toward magic.

He can become extremely excited when encountering unfamiliar or advanced magic.

This personality trait is important to Infinite Clash.

Lloyd does not automatically open every fight with his strongest possible spell.

If an opponent demonstrates an unusual supernatural ability, Lloyd may become fascinated and experiment with it.

Once he understands that an opponent represents a serious threat, his behavior can become much more focused.

He is not bloodlusted by default.

SIGNATURE TECHNIQUES / COMBAT CONCEPTS:

• Umbral Mortisphere
• Void-Class Magic
• Spatial-Class Magic
• Advanced Barrier Magic
• Multi-Spell Casting
• Magical Replication
• Mana Manipulation
• Magical Reinforcement
• Elemental Spell Combinations
• Precision Magic
• Experimental Magic
• High-Level Magical Analysis
• Pseudo-Realm Manipulation
• Advanced Mana Control

UMBRAL MORTISPHERE:

An extremely advanced void/spatial technique.

It can transport barriers or targets into a pseudo-realm where they are effectively reduced to nothing.

This is one of Lloyd's most dangerous established magical techniques.

FAIRNESS RULE:

Umbral Mortisphere is not treated as universal existence erasure.

Resistance depends on:

• spatial defenses
• dimensional defenses
• reality manipulation
• conceptual protection
• existence resistance
• teleportation
• counter-magic
• interaction with the pseudo-realm
• the target's established abilities

Lloyd can also potentially encounter another technique whose mechanics interfere with or negate the Mortisphere.

MAGICAL COUNTERPLAY:

Lloyd is particularly dangerous when he has time to study an opponent.

For example, if an opponent repeatedly uses the same attack, Lloyd may:

1. observe it
2. analyze its structure
3. test defensive interactions
4. determine its limitations
5. create an appropriate response
6. modify his strategy

But he cannot automatically counter an ability merely because he has seen it once.

UNKNOWN SYSTEM RULE:

When Lloyd encounters a completely foreign power system, he initially treats it as an unknown phenomenon.

He may investigate it.

He may experiment with barriers, detection, or low-risk spells.

He may eventually determine its mechanics.

However, he does not receive automatic knowledge simply because he is Lloyd.

EQUIPMENT:

Lloyd's primary weapon is his own magic.

He may utilize magical tools, grimoires, artifacts, or objects that are established as part of his source material when appropriate.

He does not receive invented equipment.

GRIM / GRIMOIRE:

Grim is Lloyd's demon familiar.

Grim possesses ancient magic and can transform between his familiar form and a more powerful combat form.

However, Grim is NOT treated as an unlimited extension of Lloyd's own power.

If Grim is present in the battle according to the selected rules, his own abilities, stamina, injuries, and actions are tracked separately.

Lloyd does not automatically gain every ability Grim possesses.

Conversely, defeating Grim does not automatically defeat Lloyd.

SUMMONED / CREATED ENTITIES:

Lloyd cannot arbitrarily create an infinite army of powerful beings.

Only established magical constructs, summons, familiars, or creatures that are legitimately available to him may be used.

He cannot invent a new S-tier creature during battle simply because he needs one.

WEAKNESSES:

• Human physical body
• Heavy dependence on magical resources
• High-level spells can consume substantial mana
• Complex techniques require concentration
• Foreign power systems may initially be difficult to understand
• Magical analysis requires information
• Cannot automatically counter unknown abilities
• Cannot automatically copy foreign powers
• Cannot automatically bypass conceptual defenses
• Cannot automatically bypass existence protection
• Cannot automatically ignore reality manipulation
• Cannot automatically resist soul-based attacks
• Cannot automatically resist mental attacks
• Curiosity can cause tactical hesitation
• May experiment instead of immediately finishing a dangerous opponent
• Physical specialists can threaten him if his magical defenses fail
• Extreme-speed opponents may exploit his reaction window
• Barriers can be broken
• Mana can be depleted
• Magical techniques can be interrupted
• Spatial magic is not universally superior to all other spatial abilities

IMPORTANT FAIRNESS LIMITATIONS:

Lloyd does NOT have:

• omnipotence
• omniscience
• infinite mana
• universal magic immunity
• universal power nullification
• automatic reality manipulation
• automatic conceptual manipulation
• automatic existence erasure
• automatic soul destruction
• automatic mind control
• automatic time manipulation
• universal dimensional superiority
• automatic ability copying
• automatic foreign-system knowledge
• unlimited spell creation
• infinite summons
• plot armor
• guaranteed victory

FOREIGN POWER SYSTEM INTERACTION:

Every foreign supernatural system is evaluated individually.

Examples:

Ki:
Lloyd can observe and potentially analyze it, but does not automatically understand it as mana.

Cursed Energy:
Lloyd can study its properties but does not automatically gain knowledge of cursed techniques or domains.

Divine Power:
Lloyd can recognize supernatural energy but must determine its rules.

Psychic Power:
Lloyd may attempt magical defenses or analysis, but psychic attacks are not automatically classified as ordinary spells.

Conceptual Powers:
Lloyd cannot simply "analyze magic" and negate a concept.

Reality Manipulation:
Lloyd cannot automatically counter reality manipulation merely because he possesses spatial magic.

Soul/Existence Attacks:
His magical defenses must actually interact with the specific mechanism.

CAPTAIN EFFECT:

MAGICAL RESEARCH COMMAND

If Lloyd is selected as Captain, his team gains a tactical coordination advantage based on his extraordinary analytical ability.

The effect improves:

• identification of enemy abilities
• recognition of attack patterns
• battlefield observation
• tactical experimentation
• adaptation
• information sharing
• target prioritization
• coordinated responses
• exploitation of revealed weaknesses
• strategic flexibility

Lloyd's Captain Effect does NOT grant allies magic.

It does NOT increase their raw power.

It does NOT allow Lloyd to remotely control teammates.

It represents his ability to analyze a battlefield and help his team make better decisions.

BATTLE BEHAVIOR:

Lloyd usually begins by observing.

He may use:

• mana detection
• defensive magic
• small-scale spells
• mobility
• experimental attacks

He studies how the opponent responds.

If the opponent appears relatively weak, Lloyd may become distracted by curiosity and experiment with different spells.

If the opponent demonstrates dangerous power, Lloyd becomes increasingly serious.

As information accumulates, his combat choices become more efficient.

Against a powerful opponent, he may transition through:

Observation
→ Testing
→ Analysis
→ Defensive adaptation
→ Countermeasure development
→ Spell combination
→ High-level magic
→ Extreme magical escalation

He does not necessarily use his strongest spell first.

6v6 BEHAVIOR:

In Winner-Stays 6v6, Lloyd's analytical ability becomes particularly valuable.

If Lloyd defeats an opponent but remains active, he carries forward:

• injuries
• mana expenditure
• fatigue
• active spells
• cooldowns
• defensive damage
• learned information
• knowledge of enemy tactics

He does NOT receive a full magical reset.

A long sequence of battles can therefore gradually reduce his available resources.

However, information gained from previous opponents remains valuable.

If he has already observed abilities used by the enemy team, he can incorporate that knowledge into later decisions.

He may also change his strategy based on which teammate enters next.

CAPTAIN BEHAVIOR:

When Captain, Lloyd naturally attempts to gather information about the enemy team before committing his teammates to unnecessary risks.

He may encourage:

• testing enemy defenses
• coordinated attacks
• baiting powerful abilities
• exploiting cooldowns
• forcing predictable responses
• protecting injured teammates
• rotating tactical roles
• exploiting information gained by earlier fighters

He does not command teammates like puppets.

Each fighter remains autonomous.

BATTLE PHILOSOPHY:

"Lloyd does not fight simply to win.

He fights because magic is fascinating.

Winning is often the result of understanding the battlefield better than the opponent."

INFINITE CLASH INTERPRETATION:

Lloyd is one of the most dangerous pure magic specialists in the roster.

His greatest advantage is not one single attack.

It is the combination of:

• enormous mana
• absurd magical knowledge
• extreme versatility
• rapid analysis
• spell modification
• spatial magic
• magical experimentation
• extremely high adaptability

He can potentially fight opponents far outside his normal power category because he is capable of finding unusual magical solutions.

However, he remains fair because his counters are not automatic.

Unknown abilities can surprise him.

Foreign systems can resist his assumptions.

His strongest magic consumes resources.

His curiosity can make him take unnecessary risks.

His physical body remains much less impressive than his magical power.

FINAL RULE:

Lloyd is an ANOMALY because of the extreme breadth, depth, and adaptability of his magical ability.

ANOMALY does not mean automatic victory.

Every battle must determine the result from:

• established abilities
• compatibility
• speed
• durability
• range
• intelligence
• battlefield
• information
• resources
• injuries
• stamina
• tactical decisions
• personality
• ability interaction
• luck where appropriate

No predetermined winner.
