WANG LING

Source: The Daily Life of the Immortal King (Xian Wang de Richang Shenghuo)
Name: Wang Ling
Alias: Immortal King
Nature: Human / Cultivator / Immortal-level Existence
Rank: ANOMALY
Rarity: Mythic

POWER: Anomaly
SPEED: Anomaly
DEFENSE: Anomaly
RANGE: Extreme
BATTLE IQ: Extremely High
STAMINA: Anomaly

ROLE:
Immortal cultivator / Reality-level supernatural fighter / Sealing specialist / Spatial-temporal combatant / Overwhelming magical powerhouse

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORE IDENTITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is the central protagonist of The Daily Life of the Immortal King and an extraordinarily powerful cultivator who possesses abilities far beyond ordinary magical and martial practitioners.

Despite his absurd power, Wang Ling generally wishes to live an ordinary life.

He dislikes unnecessary attention and frequently suppresses his own strength so that he can function normally around other people.

This contrast is fundamental to his behavior.

Wang Ling is not normally an arrogant conqueror.

He is quiet, emotionally restrained, easily annoyed by unnecessary complications, and often prefers to solve problems with the minimum amount of effort.

Infinite Clash therefore treats his overwhelming abilities as genuine combat tools while preserving his established personality.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMMORTAL CULTIVATOR PHYSIOLOGY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses an extraordinary cultivation-based body and spiritual existence.

His physical and supernatural capabilities greatly exceed those of normal humans.

He demonstrates extraordinary:

• Strength
• Speed
• Durability
• Reflexes
• Spiritual power
• Energy reserves
• Magical perception
• Regenerative capability
• Resistance to supernatural effects
• Lifespan
• Cultivation potential

His cultivation allows him to operate on scales vastly beyond conventional combatants.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMMENSE SPIRITUAL POWER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses enormous spiritual and magical energy.

His energy can be used for:

• Offensive techniques
• Defensive barriers
• Sealing
• Teleportation
• Spatial manipulation
• Temporal effects
• Energy projection
• Summoning/manifestation
• Environmental manipulation
• Restoration
• High-level supernatural techniques

His reserves are extraordinary.

However, Infinite Clash does not interpret his energy as literally infinite.

Powerful abilities can still require concentration, control, or significant expenditure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
POWER SUPPRESSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

One of Wang Ling's defining characteristics is his ability and tendency to suppress his own overwhelming power.

He often maintains seals or restrictions to prevent his abilities from becoming uncontrollable or causing unnecessary destruction.

This creates an important combat distinction.

Wang Ling can fight while heavily restrained.

If the situation becomes sufficiently dangerous, he can progressively release more of his power.

The AI determines when escalation is appropriate.

He does NOT automatically begin every battle at unrestricted maximum output.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SEALS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling's seals suppress portions of his extraordinary power.

These seals are an important part of his characterization and combat balance.

A seal may limit:

• Energy output
• Destructive potential
• Spiritual pressure
• Ability access
• Physical expression of power

When greater power becomes necessary, Wang Ling can remove or weaken restrictions.

However, Infinite Clash does not treat "removing all seals" as an automatic victory command.

The AI evaluates the battle and chooses escalation naturally.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REALITY MANIPULATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses extremely high-level supernatural abilities capable of affecting reality and the structure of events.

Depending on the established technique and situation, he can interact with:

• Space
• Time
• Matter
• Energy
• Life
• Death
• Magical phenomena
• Environmental conditions
• Causality-like effects

However, Infinite Clash does NOT give Wang Ling unrestricted author-level reality manipulation.

He cannot simply declare:

"Opponent does not exist."

and automatically win every battle.

Reality-affecting abilities must interact with the opponent's own nature and resistances.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SPATIAL MANIPULATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can manipulate and traverse space through cultivation-based techniques.

Applications include:

• Teleportation
• Spatial movement
• Battlefield repositioning
• Distance manipulation
• Spatial attacks
• Escaping dangerous locations
• Pursuing opponents

Teleportation is not treated as omnipresence.

Spatial abilities may also interact differently with opponents who possess:

• Spatial resistance
• Dimensional existence
• Teleportation
• Barriers
• Reality manipulation

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TEMPORAL ABILITIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses abilities capable of interacting with time.

Depending on the established technique, he can influence temporal circumstances and potentially reverse or alter events.

However:

Temporal manipulation is NOT an automatic win.

Opponents with:

• Temporal resistance
• Causality resistance
• Higher-order temporal abilities
• Nonlinear existence
• Metaphysical defenses

may resist or complicate such techniques.

The AI must determine compatibility rather than assuming every target is equally vulnerable.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TIME REVERSAL / EVENT RESTORATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can employ extremely powerful restoration-oriented abilities associated with reversing or correcting events.

These abilities can potentially restore damaged circumstances or undo certain outcomes.

However, Infinite Clash does not treat this as unlimited combat resurrection.

Restoration depends on:

• The established technique
• Timing
• Energy
• Compatibility
• The nature of the event
• Whether the relevant state remains recoverable

It does not automatically erase all accumulated consequences in a 6v6 battle.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SEALING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Sealing is one of Wang Ling's most important supernatural combat options.

He can use cultivation techniques to restrain, suppress, contain, or otherwise limit powerful supernatural targets.

Potential applications include:

• Restricting movement
• Suppressing power
• Containing supernatural entities
• Limiting energy output
• Immobilizing targets
• Preventing certain abilities from functioning normally

Sealing is NOT automatically successful against every opponent.

The AI must consider:

• Target power
• Resistance
• Nature of existence
• Existing barriers
• Conceptual/metaphysical properties
• Escape abilities

A sufficiently powerful opponent may resist, break, or circumvent a seal.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DESTRUCTIVE POWER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can unleash extraordinary destructive energy when restraint is removed.

His attacks can operate on a vastly larger scale than conventional magical attacks.

He can employ:

• Energy blasts
• Cultivation techniques
• Magical attacks
• Spiritual attacks
• Environmental destruction
• High-level supernatural techniques

His destructive output can escalate dramatically.

However, destruction is not automatically equivalent to existence erasure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SPIRITUAL ATTACKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can interact with spiritual and supernatural aspects of opponents.

This gives him options against targets who are not purely physical.

However, Infinite Clash does not grant him automatic dominance over every soul, spirit, astral body, or metaphysical entity.

Compatibility must be evaluated.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DEFENSIVE BARRIERS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can generate supernatural defenses capable of resisting enormous amounts of damage.

These defenses may protect against:

• Physical attacks
• Energy attacks
• Magical attacks
• Environmental destruction
• Supernatural phenomena

However, barriers are not absolute.

Sufficiently powerful or specialized attacks can:

• Overwhelm them
• Bypass them
• Disrupt them
• Exploit their limitations

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMMORTALITY / LONGEVITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling's cultivation gives him an existence far beyond ordinary human lifespan.

His supernatural nature makes conventional aging and ordinary physical death far less meaningful than for a normal human.

However, Infinite Clash does not grant him absolute invulnerability.

He is NOT automatically immune to:

• Existence erasure
• Soul destruction
• Conceptual attacks
• Sealing
• Reality manipulation
• Causality manipulation
• Higher-order metaphysical abilities

His immortality-like existence must interact with the opponent's abilities.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REGENERATION & RESTORATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses extraordinary recovery capabilities.

He can recover from severe supernatural circumstances depending on the technique involved.

However, regeneration is not treated as unlimited automatic restoration.

Severe damage can still matter.

Restoration abilities also do not automatically reset:

• Stamina
• Spent energy
• Cooldowns
• Used abilities
• Information learned by opponents
• Tactical consequences

especially in 6v6.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TELEKINESIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling can manipulate objects and targets through supernatural force.

Applications include:

• Restraining enemies
• Throwing objects
• Moving terrain
• Defensive manipulation
• Interrupting attacks
• Battlefield control

Telekinesis is powerful but does not automatically overpower every character with greater physical or supernatural resistance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAGICAL PERCEPTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling possesses extraordinary awareness of supernatural phenomena.

He can perceive:

• Energy
• Magical signatures
• Spiritual phenomena
• Supernatural attacks
• Changes in the battlefield

However, he does not automatically understand every fictional power system.

A foreign energy system may require observation before Wang Ling understands its properties.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMBAT INTELLIGENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is extremely intelligent and capable of understanding complicated supernatural situations.

He can:

• Analyze threats
• Identify dangerous abilities
• Adapt his approach
• Control his output
• Select appropriate techniques
• Recognize when escalation is necessary

His fighting style is usually economical.

He rarely wastes effort when a simpler solution is available.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PERSONALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is:

• Quiet
• Reserved
• Calm
• Emotionally restrained
• Intelligent
• Extremely powerful
• Easily bored
• Protective
• Often reluctant to show his true abilities

He generally does not seek domination.

His primary desire is a peaceful, ordinary life.

Because of this, he may initially underestimate or ignore an opponent who does not appear dangerous.

If his survival or someone he cares about is threatened, his attitude can become considerably more serious.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AI COMBAT BEHAVIOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The AI controls Wang Ling completely.

The player does NOT choose:

• His spells
• His seals
• His movement
• His attacks
• His targets
• His defensive techniques
• His escalation
• His dialogue
• His tactical decisions

The AI makes all decisions.

Wang Ling should generally begin with restrained power when the opponent does not immediately demonstrate extreme danger.

A typical escalation pattern is:

Observe
→ Suppressed power
→ Defensive response
→ Efficient supernatural technique
→ Sealing/spatial control
→ Greater cultivation output
→ High-level abilities if necessary.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SIGNATURE ABILITIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Immortal King Cultivation
Extremely advanced cultivation granting extraordinary supernatural capabilities.

Power Suppression
Restrains Wang Ling's overwhelming power.

Seal Manipulation
Allows him to maintain or alter restrictions on his power.

Reality-Affecting Techniques
High-level abilities capable of influencing physical and supernatural circumstances.

Spatial Manipulation
Teleportation and battlefield spatial control.

Temporal Manipulation
Interaction with time and temporal events.

Sealing
Restricts supernatural targets and their abilities.

Spiritual Power
Allows interaction with spiritual and supernatural entities.

Energy Projection
Projects immense cultivation energy offensively.

Supernatural Barriers
High-level defensive protection.

Immense Physical Power
Wang Ling can reinforce his body with cultivation energy and fight physically when required.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WEAKNESSES & BALANCING RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is ANOMALY, but ANOMALY does NOT mean automatic victory.

1. He does not automatically erase every opponent.

2. He does not possess unrestricted omnipotence.

3. He does not possess automatic omniscience.

4. Reality manipulation is not unlimited.

5. Time manipulation is not automatically effective against every target.

6. Sealing is not guaranteed against every opponent.

7. His seals can restrict his available output.

8. Removing restrictions is an escalation, not an instant-win command.

9. His energy is not treated as literally infinite.

10. Regeneration is not absolute.

11. Immortality-like existence is not universal invulnerability.

12. He does not automatically resist conceptual attacks.

13. He does not automatically resist existence erasure.

14. He does not automatically resist soul destruction.

15. He does not automatically understand foreign power systems.

16. He cannot invent arbitrary new abilities.

17. He cannot copy opponents' abilities without an established mechanism allowing it.

18. He does not automatically know the opponent's weaknesses.

19. Temporal restoration cannot freely reset every accumulated battle consequence.

20. No cross-verse knowledge.

21. No plot armor.

22. No predetermined winner.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6v6 WINNER-STAYS CARRYOVER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling's battle state carries between consecutive fights.

If Wang Ling wins a fight while having:

• Released seals
• Spent spiritual energy
• Sustained injuries
• Used major techniques
• Activated defensive abilities
• Revealed information

those consequences remain relevant.

He does not receive an automatic full restoration between opponents.

If he used a major temporal or restorative technique, the simulation tracks the consequences of that use rather than treating it as an unlimited reset button.

His opponent also retains all information learned about him.

This makes a long 6v6 gauntlet meaningfully different from six isolated 1v1 fights.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAPTAIN EFFECT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAPTAIN EFFECT: Immortal King's Calm

If Wang Ling is selected as Captain in 3v3 or 6v6, his extraordinary composure and supernatural awareness influence the entire team.

Effects:

• Improves tactical awareness
• Encourages calm decision-making
• Improves threat assessment
• Encourages efficient ability usage
• Reduces panic
• Improves defensive positioning
• Encourages strategic patience
• Helps allies adapt to unfamiliar supernatural abilities
• Improves coordination during chaotic situations

The effect does NOT:

• Give allies cultivation power
• Give allies immortality
• Give allies sealing abilities
• Grant reality manipulation
• Grant temporal manipulation
• Increase their statistics arbitrarily

It represents Wang Ling's calm presence, intelligence, and battlefield awareness.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MATCHUP PROFILE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is particularly dangerous against:

• Conventional physical fighters
• Magical fighters
• Energy-based fighters
• Large-scale attackers
• Fighters vulnerable to sealing
• Fighters dependent on predictable movement
• Opponents without strong supernatural resistance
• Opponents who cannot deal with spatial or temporal interference

He becomes more complicated to evaluate against:

• Conceptual entities
• Meta-level beings
• Higher-order reality manipulators
• Entities with unusual existence mechanics
• Strong temporal resistances
• Powerful sealing-resistant entities
• Characters whose abilities function outside conventional space and time

These are matchup considerations rather than automatic counters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BATTLE PHILOSOPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling prefers efficiency.

He does not needlessly display his full power.

His preferred approach is:

Observe
→ Identify the threat
→ Use the minimum effective technique
→ Suppress or neutralize the opponent
→ Escalate only if necessary.

If an opponent demonstrates extraordinary resistance, Wang Ling becomes progressively more serious.

His emotional restraint means his escalation may be subtle rather than theatrical.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INFINITE CLASH BALANCE VERDICT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Wang Ling is an ANOMALY-level fighter and one of the roster's most dangerous supernatural combatants.

His greatest advantages are:

• Immense cultivation power
• Extreme physical statistics
• Reality-affecting abilities
• Spatial manipulation
• Temporal abilities
• Powerful sealing
• Spiritual interaction
• Extraordinary defenses
• Immense energy reserves
• Power suppression and controlled escalation

Unlike Saitama, Wang Ling's greatest threat is not simply physical strength.

He possesses a much broader supernatural toolkit.

However, Infinite Clash deliberately prevents that toolkit from becoming an automatic "I win" button.

His abilities must interact with each opponent individually.

Every battle is determined dynamically by:

• Power
• Speed
• Durability
• Abilities
• Resistances
• Compatibility
• Strategy
• Energy
• Seals
• Injuries
• Information
• Environment
• AI decisions

NO AUTOMATIC REALITY REWRITE.
NO AUTOMATIC TIME-BASED WIN.
NO GUARANTEED SEAL.
NO AUTOMATIC IMMORTALITY.
NO CROSS-VERSE KNOWLEDGE.
NO PLOT ARMOR.
NO PREDETERMINED WINNER.
entries.name: Wang Lin

entries.content:
SAITAMA

Source: One-Punch Man
Name: Saitama
Alias: Caped Baldy
Titles: Hero for Fun, One-Punch Man
Nature: Human / Superhuman Hero
Rank: ANOMALY
Rarity: Mythic

POWER: Anomaly
SPEED: Anomaly
DEFENSE: Anomaly
RANGE: Extreme
BATTLE IQ: Extremely High
STAMINA: Anomaly

ROLE:
Overwhelming physical powerhouse / Martial artist / Extreme-speed fighter / High-end endurance combatant

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORE IDENTITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is the protagonist of One-Punch Man and a hero whose physical capabilities have surpassed conventional understanding.

He became extraordinarily powerful through an intentionally simple training regimen, eventually reaching a level where most enemies can be defeated with little effort.

However, Infinite Clash treats Saitama according to his actual established feats and abilities rather than using the literal phrase "One-Punch Man" as an automatic victory condition.

His greatest advantages are:

• Absurd physical strength
• Extreme speed
• Extraordinary durability
• Immense stamina
• Exceptional reflexes
• Incredible jumping ability
• Shockwave-producing strikes
• Serious techniques
• Rapid combat adaptation
• Extraordinary resistance to environmental hazards

Saitama is primarily a physical fighter.

He does not depend on complicated supernatural systems, magical artifacts or large collections of abilities.

His body is his weapon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SUPERHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama possesses physical capabilities vastly beyond those of an ordinary human.

His body demonstrates extraordinary:

• Strength
• Speed
• Durability
• Stamina
• Reflexes
• Recovery
• Jumping power
• Resistance to extreme environments

His physical power is so great that relatively simple movements can produce catastrophic effects.

A casual punch from Saitama can be dramatically different from a serious punch.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LIMITER REMOVAL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama's extraordinary power is connected to the concept of having removed his limiter.

This allows his physical potential to operate at a level far beyond normal biological limitations.

The important Infinite Clash interpretation is:

Saitama possesses extraordinary and potentially continuously growing physical power.

It does NOT mean:

• Infinite power by definition
• Automatic superiority over every fictional character
• Automatic immunity to supernatural abilities
• Automatic resistance to conceptual attacks
• Automatic reality manipulation
• Omnipotence

His actual demonstrated abilities and combat performance determine the fight.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
OVERWHELMING STRENGTH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Strength is Saitama's defining characteristic.

He can produce immense destructive force through ordinary physical attacks.

His strength can be used for:

• Punches
• Serious punches
• Consecutive strikes
• Kicks
• Grappling
• Throws
• Jumping attacks
• Shockwaves
• Environmental destruction

Saitama can dramatically increase his output when he decides that an opponent is genuinely dangerous.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
NORMAL PUNCH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama's ordinary punch is already devastating against conventional opponents.

He does not need elaborate techniques to defeat most physical enemies.

However, "normal punch" is not treated as an automatic one-hit kill against every Infinite Clash fighter.

An opponent's:

• Durability
• Regeneration
• Immortality
• Energy barriers
• Spatial defenses
• Conceptual nature
• Existence mechanics

must still be considered.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CONSECUTIVE NORMAL PUNCHES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama can unleash rapid sequences of ordinary punches.

These attacks are particularly effective against:

• Large targets
• Durable opponents
• Multiple enemies
• Enemies relying on regeneration
• Fighters attempting to maintain close-range pressure

The sheer volume of physical force can overwhelm opponents who survive a single strike.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUS SERIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

When Saitama decides that conventional attacks are insufficient, he can employ techniques from his Serious Series.

These represent a significant escalation.

Established serious techniques include:

• Serious Punch
• Serious Table Flip
• Serious Sideways Jumps
• Serious Sneeze
• Other established serious physical techniques

The AI should select an appropriate technique based on the situation.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUS PUNCH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The Serious Punch is one of Saitama's most powerful established attacks.

It represents a major escalation from his casual fighting.

The force generated can produce enormous environmental and atmospheric consequences.

However, the Serious Punch is not treated as universal existence erasure.

It remains an overwhelmingly powerful physical/force-based attack.

Opponents with appropriate supernatural defenses may still survive or mitigate it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUS PUNCH SQUARED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama has participated in an enormously powerful clash in which his Serious Punch interacted with another attack to produce catastrophic consequences.

This demonstrates the extraordinary upper limit of his physical power.

However, Infinite Clash does not automatically interpret every consequence of that event as meaning Saitama possesses unrestricted control over the universe.

The attack remains an expression of overwhelming physical force.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUS SNEEZE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama has demonstrated that even a bodily function such as sneezing can produce extraordinary destructive force when operating at his level.

The Serious Sneeze demonstrates the enormous scale of his physical power.

It is not treated as a conventional technique that Saitama deliberately uses whenever he wants.

The AI may use established serious physical techniques when appropriate to the battle.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUS TABLE FLIP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama can use enormous physical force to manipulate the battlefield itself.

The Serious Table Flip demonstrates that his strength is not limited to direct punches.

He can use environmental objects and terrain as weapons.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EXTREME SPEED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama possesses extraordinary movement speed.

He can:

• Move faster than conventional perception
• Cross enormous distances rapidly
• Catch extremely fast opponents
• Change direction at extreme speeds
• Attack before enemies can react
• Pursue opponents through the battlefield
• Perform enormous jumps

His speed is among his greatest combat advantages.

However, Infinite Clash does not treat extreme speed as automatic victory against every opponent.

Precognition, teleportation, spatial manipulation and other unusual movement abilities can still complicate the matchup.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REACTION SPEED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama's reflexes are extraordinarily fast.

He can react to extremely rapid attacks and adjust his movement during combat.

His reactions allow him to:

• Dodge
• Counter
• Intercept
• Pursue
• Redirect
• Respond to sudden changes

However, Saitama does not possess Ultra Instinct.

His reactions are based on his own extraordinary physical ability and combat instincts.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DURABILITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama possesses absurd physical durability.

He has survived enormous attacks and extreme environments with little apparent injury.

His durability protects him against:

• Blunt force
• Explosions
• Extreme pressure
• High-speed impacts
• Massive environmental forces
• Extreme temperatures
• Vacuum-like conditions
• Powerful energy attacks

However, durability is not automatically universal resistance.

An ability that specifically bypasses physical durability may still affect him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
ENVIRONMENTAL RESISTANCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama can survive extreme environments that would be fatal to ordinary humans.

He has demonstrated the ability to function under conditions involving:

• Extreme altitude
• Vacuum
• Extreme temperatures
• Massive pressure
• Space-related environments

This makes environmental battlefield manipulation much less effective against him than it would be against ordinary fighters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STAMINA
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama possesses extraordinary stamina.

He can fight for extended periods without displaying the level of fatigue expected from ordinary beings.

His stamina allows him to:

• Fight continuously
• Travel enormous distances
• Repeatedly attack
• Sustain extreme physical activity
• Continue fighting after prolonged battles

Infinite Clash nevertheless tracks battle consequences.

A theoretical infinite-stamina interpretation is not assumed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
GROWTH DURING COMBAT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

One of Saitama's most important high-end characteristics is his demonstrated capacity for extraordinary growth during extreme combat.

Under sufficiently intense circumstances, his power can increase at an astonishing rate.

However, Infinite Clash does not interpret this as:

"Whenever someone hurts Saitama, he instantly becomes infinitely stronger."

Growth is contextual.

The AI should consider:

• Severity of the battle
• Emotional state
• Duration
• Opponent's strength
• Physical condition
• Established source mechanics

Saitama may grow dramatically in an extreme battle, but the growth must remain grounded in established behavior.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MARTIAL ARTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is not a technical martial-arts specialist on the same level as characters whose entire identity revolves around formal combat systems.

However, his physical abilities and practical combat experience make him highly effective.

He can use:

• Punches
• Kicks
• Throws
• Counters
• Evasion
• Grappling
• Improvised attacks

His raw physical superiority often allows him to use simple techniques with overwhelming effectiveness.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMBAT ADAPTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama can adapt to unusual opponents during combat.

He can recognize:

• Attack timing
• Movement patterns
• Changes in power
• Environmental threats
• Opponent behavior

However, his battle intelligence is different from a highly analytical mage or strategist.

He generally prefers straightforward solutions.

He does not automatically understand complicated supernatural mechanics.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BATTLE IQ
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama possesses extremely high practical combat intelligence despite his generally casual personality.

He can make good decisions under pressure.

He understands:

• Positioning
• Timing
• Attack range
• Enemy movement
• When to increase power
• When to avoid unnecessary damage

However, he can also become bored or distracted against opponents he does not consider threatening.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HERO INSTINCT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is fundamentally a hero.

He does not normally seek unnecessary destruction.

If civilians or innocent people are present, he may prioritize protecting them.

In Infinite Clash, the battlefield rules determine whether civilians or environmental restrictions exist.

He should not arbitrarily destroy everything around him when a more controlled solution is available.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PERSONALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is:

• Casual
• Calm
• Straightforward
• Often bored
• Deadpan
• Confident
• Kind-hearted
• Occasionally absent-minded
• Competitive when genuinely challenged

He does not normally boast about his strength.

He may appear completely uninterested in a battle until the opponent demonstrates something capable of genuinely challenging him.

Once he recognizes a serious threat, his personality becomes much more focused.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SERIOUSNESS ESCALATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama's behavior should reflect the difference between casual and serious combat.

Against a weak opponent:

• He may use casual punches.
• He may dodge rather than attack.
• He may appear bored.
• He may underestimate the threat.

Against a strong opponent:

• He becomes more attentive.
• He increases his physical output.
• He uses stronger techniques.
• He becomes increasingly serious.

Against an extreme threat:

• He can employ Serious Series techniques.
• He may fight continuously at very high output.
• He prioritizes survival and victory.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AI COMBAT BEHAVIOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The AI controls Saitama completely.

The player does NOT control:

• Movement
• Punches
• Serious techniques
• Power output
• Target selection
• Dodging
• Tactical decisions
• Dialogue
• Escalation

The AI makes every decision.

Saitama should not automatically use Serious Punch at the start of every battle.

His established personality means he frequently begins casually.

If the opponent proves dangerous, the AI should escalate naturally.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SIGNATURE ABILITIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Normal Punch
Extremely powerful basic physical strike.

Consecutive Normal Punches
Rapid sequence of overwhelming physical attacks.

Serious Punch
High-output physical strike.

Serious Table Flip
Massive battlefield-manipulating physical attack.

Serious Sideways Jumps
Extreme-speed movement technique generating enormous environmental force.

Serious Sneeze
High-output physical force produced through a sneeze.

Extreme Physical Strength
Overwhelming raw power.

Extreme Speed
Extraordinary movement and reaction speed.

Extreme Durability
Massive resistance to physical destruction.

Limitless Potential
Extraordinary capacity for continued growth under extreme circumstances.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WEAKNESSES & BALANCING RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is ANOMALY, but ANOMALY does NOT mean automatic victory.

1. "One-Punch Man" is not a literal automatic one-hit rule in Infinite Clash.

2. Saitama's punches must interact with an opponent's actual defenses.

3. Saitama does not automatically bypass immortality.

4. Saitama does not automatically bypass regeneration.

5. Saitama does not automatically bypass conceptual abilities.

6. Saitama does not automatically bypass reality manipulation.

7. Saitama does not automatically bypass soul attacks.

8. Saitama does not automatically bypass existence erasure.

9. Saitama does not automatically resist every form of hax.

10. Extreme speed does not equal omnipresence.

11. Saitama does not possess Ultra Instinct.

12. Saitama does not automatically know foreign abilities.

13. Saitama cannot copy another fighter's powers.

14. His growth is not infinite instant scaling.

15. His growth cannot simply be triggered on command.

16. His strongest techniques are not automatically opening attacks.

17. His personality can cause him to hold back.

18. He can be affected by sufficiently powerful supernatural abilities.

19. No arbitrary new techniques.

20. No cross-verse knowledge.

21. No plot armor.

22. No predetermined winner.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6v6 WINNER-STAYS CARRYOVER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama's condition carries directly between fights.

If he wins while:

• Injured
• Exhausted
• Physically damaged
• Having suffered supernatural effects
• Having expended significant effort
• Having revealed information about his fighting style

those consequences remain.

He does NOT automatically receive a complete reset.

His physical durability and stamina may allow him to remain in excellent condition after battles that would cripple other fighters, but the simulation still tracks actual accumulated consequences.

Combat knowledge also carries forward.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAPTAIN EFFECT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAPTAIN EFFECT: Unshakable Hero

If Saitama is selected as Captain in 3v3 or 6v6, his calm and straightforward personality influences the team's battlefield behavior.

Effects:

• Improves team morale
• Reduces panic
• Encourages persistence
• Encourages direct tactical solutions
• Improves confidence under pressure
• Encourages allies to protect teammates
• Helps maintain composure against intimidating opponents
• Encourages decisive action

The effect does NOT:

• Give allies Saitama's strength
• Grant invulnerability
• Increase statistics arbitrarily
• Give allies his growth potential
• Force allies to copy his fighting style

It represents Saitama's calm confidence and heroic mentality.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EQUIPMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

None required.

Saitama fights primarily with his body.

His standard hero costume does not provide combat abilities.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MATCHUP PROFILE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama performs exceptionally well against:

• Physical fighters
• High-durability opponents
• Speed-based fighters
• Large monsters
• Energy-based physical combatants
• Opponents relying on conventional attacks
• Fighters who attempt to win through attrition

He becomes more challenged by:

• Conceptual entities
• Reality manipulators
• Soul-based attacks
• Existence erasure
• Powerful sealing
• Time manipulation
• Non-physical abilities
• Opponents whose abilities bypass conventional durability
• Entities whose existence cannot be meaningfully interacted with through physical force

These are matchup considerations, not automatic counters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BATTLE PHILOSOPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama prefers simplicity.

His ideal solution is often:

Walk forward
→ Punch opponent
→ Win.

But Infinite Clash opponents are far more varied than the average One-Punch Man enemy.

Therefore, when a simple attack fails, Saitama should adapt.

His escalation generally follows:

Casual
→ Serious attention
→ Increased physical output
→ Serious Series
→ Maximum established effort when necessary.

He does not automatically begin at maximum power.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INFINITE CLASH BALANCE VERDICT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Saitama is an ANOMALY-level fighter.

His raw physical statistics are among the highest in the entire Infinite Clash roster.

His greatest advantages are:

• Absurd strength
• Absurd speed
• Absurd durability
• Extraordinary stamina
• Extreme environmental resistance
• Massive combat growth potential
• Simple but overwhelmingly effective fighting style

He is one of the most dangerous fighters in a direct physical confrontation.

However, Infinite Clash deliberately separates raw physical superiority from universal hax resistance.

Saitama can punch extraordinarily hard.

That does not automatically mean he can punch:

• Concepts
• Souls
• Causality
• Reality
• Abstract existence

unless his established abilities provide a valid interaction.

Every battle is determined dynamically by:

• Power
• Speed
• Abilities
• Resistances
• Compatibility
• Strategy
• Stamina
• Growth
• Injuries
• Information
• Environment
• AI decisions

NO AUTOMATIC ONE-SHOT.
NO AUTOMATIC HAX RESISTANCE.
NO INFINITE INSTANT GROWTH.
NO CROSS-VERSE KNOWLEDGE.
NO PLOT ARMOR.
NO PREDETERMINED WINNER.

entries.content:
THE CREATOR — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK PROFILE

IDENTITY
Name: The Creator
Source: Umineko: When They Cry
Nature: Meta-World / Creator-Level Witch Entity
Role: Transcendent Creator / Highest-Level Meta Existence
Rank: ANOMALY
Rarity: Mythic

CORE STATS
Power: Anomaly
Speed: Unknown
Defense: Anomaly
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Anomaly

EXISTENCE

The Creator exists at an extraordinarily high metaphysical level within the cosmology of Umineko: When They Cry.

The Creator is not simply a powerful physical being.

The concept of the Creator represents a state beyond ordinary witches and ordinary fragments, associated with the highest levels of magical and meta-world existence.

The Creator should therefore be treated as a fundamentally different type of fighter from conventional physical, magical or divine characters.

The Creator's existence can transcend ordinary distinctions such as:

- Physical body
- Conventional distance
- Ordinary dimensions
- Normal causality
- Conventional time
- Ordinary reality
- Individual worlds
- Fragments

However, Infinite Clash must still determine interactions with other fictional cosmologies individually.

ABILITIES

Creator-Level Existence:
The Creator possesses an existence associated with the highest levels of Umineko's metaphysical hierarchy.

Meta-World Existence:
The Creator can exist and act on a level beyond ordinary physical worlds and their inhabitants.

Higher-Dimensional Awareness:
The Creator possesses awareness far beyond conventional three-dimensional perception.

Fragment Awareness:
The Creator can perceive and understand the existence of worlds and fragments at an extremely high metaphysical level.

Meta-World Perception:
The Creator can observe events from a perspective beyond ordinary reality.

Reality Manipulation:
The Creator possesses extraordinary authority over reality within the scope of established Umineko metaphysics.

World Manipulation:
The Creator can influence the structure and circumstances of worlds at a metaphysical level.

Fragment Manipulation:
The Creator can interact with and influence fragments and their structures.

Causality Manipulation:
The Creator can influence causality at a metaphysical level when appropriate.

Possibility Manipulation:
The Creator can influence possibilities and potential outcomes within the appropriate metaphysical framework.

Law Manipulation:
The Creator can operate on a level where the rules governing lower-order realities can be altered or transcended.

Conceptual Interaction:
The Creator can interact with concepts and abstract metaphysical structures rather than being restricted to physical targets.

Existence Manipulation:
The Creator possesses extremely high-level influence over existence.

Non-Physical Interaction:
The Creator can interact with entities that do not possess ordinary physical bodies.

Spiritual Interaction:
The Creator can interact with supernatural and spiritual beings.

Metaphysical Interaction:
The Creator can interact with entities existing on abstract or higher metaphysical levels.

Reality Perception:
The Creator can perceive alterations to reality and metaphysical structures.

Temporal Transcendence:
The Creator's existence is not restricted by ordinary linear time in the same way as conventional beings.

Spatial Transcendence:
Ordinary physical distance does not necessarily restrict the Creator's actions.

Causality Resistance:
The Creator possesses substantial resistance to conventional attempts to alter causality.

Reality Manipulation Resistance:
The Creator possesses extraordinary resistance to ordinary reality manipulation.

Conceptual Resistance:
The Creator possesses substantial resistance to attacks that target concepts or abstract existence.

Existence Resistance:
The Creator's higher-level existence makes ordinary physical destruction insufficient to automatically defeat them.

Metaphysical Resilience:
The Creator can withstand extraordinary attacks against their existence.

Immense Knowledge:
The Creator possesses extraordinary knowledge appropriate to their metaphysical status.

Extreme Intelligence:
The Creator possesses extremely high intellectual and strategic capability.

Meta-Analysis:
The Creator can analyze opponents from a higher-level perspective and recognize patterns that ordinary fighters cannot perceive.

Adaptive Understanding:
The Creator can rapidly develop an understanding of unfamiliar metaphysical structures once exposed to them.

META-WORLD AUTHORITY

The Creator should be understood as possessing authority over metaphysical structures rather than simply having a large energy reserve.

This can allow the Creator to interact with:

- Worlds
- Fragments
- Laws
- Possibilities
- Causality
- Concepts
- Reality structures
- Higher-dimensional environments

However, this authority must remain consistent with the established Umineko framework.

The Creator should NOT automatically be treated as possessing unlimited control over every fictional cosmology simply because another character exists inside a fictional story.

FIGHTING STYLE

The Creator does not fight like a conventional warrior.

Their combat style is primarily metaphysical and strategic.

Rather than exchanging punches, the Creator may:

- Observe an opponent
- Analyze their existence
- Study their abilities
- Manipulate the surrounding reality
- Alter battlefield conditions
- Exploit metaphysical weaknesses
- Interact with causality
- Manipulate possibilities
- Attack the structure supporting an opponent's existence
- Defend through higher-level metaphysical interaction

The Creator does not need to physically approach an opponent.

Their attacks can operate through metaphysical mechanisms when appropriate.

The Creator can also choose not to immediately use their highest-level abilities.

They may first observe the opponent and determine how their existence functions.

This is especially important when fighting characters from completely different fictional cosmologies.

PERSONALITY

The Creator should not be portrayed as a generic omnipotent villain.

The Creator's personality should remain distant, composed and intellectually dominant.

Possible traits include:

- Calm
- Detached
- Mysterious
- Extremely intelligent
- Patient
- Analytical
- Difficult to intimidate
- Difficult to surprise
- Emotionally distant
- Confident
- Metaphysically aware

The Creator does not need to boast.

They can treat an ordinary physical battle as something fundamentally different from the level at which they normally exist.

However, they should still acknowledge genuinely unusual opponents and investigate their abilities.

They should not automatically assume that every foreign character is beneath them.

SIGNATURE ABILITIES

1. CREATOR'S AUTHORITY

The Creator can exert extremely high-level metaphysical influence over reality structures.

This can affect the battlefield itself rather than merely targeting an opponent's physical body.

2. META-WORLD MANIPULATION

The Creator can interact with the metaphysical layer above ordinary worlds.

This can allow them to operate independently of conventional physical limitations.

3. FRAGMENT MANIPULATION

The Creator can interact with fragment-like realities and their structures.

This may allow manipulation of environments, possibilities and metaphysical circumstances.

4. CAUSALITY MANIPULATION

The Creator can influence relationships between events when appropriate to their established metaphysical capabilities.

This does not mean every action by every opponent automatically becomes impossible.

5. POSSIBILITY MANIPULATION

The Creator can interact with potential outcomes and possibilities.

The ability should be portrayed as strategic rather than as an automatic "choose any outcome" button.

6. LAW MANIPULATION

The Creator can interact with the rules governing lower-order realities.

This can be used to create unusual battlefield conditions or counter abilities when the relevant metaphysical interaction is established.

7. EXISTENCE MANIPULATION

The Creator can attack or influence the metaphysical structure of an opponent's existence when the opponent is sufficiently compatible with such interaction.

8. META-PERCEPTION

The Creator can perceive events from a higher metaphysical perspective and analyze abilities that would be incomprehensible to conventional fighters.

9. CONCEPTUAL INTERACTION

The Creator can interact with abstract entities and conceptual structures.

This does not automatically mean every concept in every fictional universe is under their control.

10. METAPHYSICAL DEFENSE

The Creator can defend themselves through higher-level existence, reality manipulation, conceptual resistance and metaphysical separation.

WEAKNESSES AND LIMITATIONS

The Creator is an ANOMALY, but Infinite Clash does NOT treat ANOMALY as an automatic victory condition.

1. NO AUTOMATIC OMNIPOTENCE

The Creator must not be treated as literally capable of every imaginable action.

Their abilities are based on the established Umineko metaphysical framework.

2. NO AUTOMATIC CROSS-FICTION AUTHORITY

Being a Creator-level existence in Umineko does not automatically make every other fictional cosmology subordinate to them.

Other verses must be evaluated individually.

3. NO AUTOMATIC KNOWLEDGE OF FOREIGN SYSTEMS

The Creator possesses extraordinary intelligence and awareness, but does not automatically know every ability, law, resistance or metaphysical system from another fictional universe.

4. NO INSTANT WIN

The Creator should not automatically erase an opponent at the beginning of every battle.

They can observe, analyze and escalate.

5. NO ARBITRARY REALITY REWRITE

Do not allow the Creator to perform any imaginable reality rewrite without a logical connection to their established abilities.

6. NO AUTOMATIC CONCEPTUAL DEFEAT

Conceptual existence does not automatically mean every opponent can be defeated by targeting their concept.

The interaction must make sense.

7. NO AUTOMATIC CAUSALITY CONTROL

Causality manipulation does not mean every event can simply be declared impossible.

8. POSSIBILITY MANIPULATION HAS CONTEXT

Possibility manipulation should remain consistent with the metaphysical framework and the opponent's nature.

9. FOREIGN RESISTANCES MATTER

Characters with established resistance to reality manipulation, conceptual attacks, causality manipulation, existence manipulation or higher-dimensional effects must be evaluated individually.

10. METAPHYSICAL HIERARCHIES ARE NOT AUTOMATICALLY IDENTICAL

Umineko's hierarchy should not automatically be assumed to be identical to the cosmological hierarchy of another franchise.

11. PERSONALITY MATTERS

The Creator is not automatically bloodlusted.

Their behavior should remain intelligent, controlled and analytical.

12. NO INVENTED FEATS

Do not invent feats or abilities simply because the title "The Creator" sounds omnipotent.

13. NO BORROWED POWERS

The Creator cannot automatically use the abilities of other Umineko characters unless those abilities are independently established as belonging to the Creator.

14. NO GENERIC "AUTHOR" POWER

Do not automatically interpret the Creator as having unrestricted real-world author control over Infinite Clash or the actual narrative outside the fictional framework.

15. BATTLE CONSEQUENCES

If the Creator somehow takes meaningful damage, suffers a restriction, expends a relevant resource or experiences another established combat consequence, that consequence remains relevant unless an established ability removes it.

CAPTAIN EFFECT

Name: Meta-Strategic Authority

When The Creator is selected as Captain, their extraordinary perspective allows their team to coordinate with exceptional strategic awareness.

The effect influences:

- Threat recognition
- Target prioritization
- Battlefield awareness
- Strategic planning
- Timing
- Positioning
- Adaptation
- Recognition of enemy patterns
- Coordination
- Long-term tactical decision-making

The Captain Effect represents the Creator's higher-level perspective.

It does NOT grant teammates:

- Reality manipulation
- Meta-world existence
- Causality manipulation
- Possibility manipulation
- Conceptual manipulation
- Higher-dimensional existence
- Creator-level knowledge
- Any other Creator ability

CAPTAIN RULES

If The Creator is selected as Captain:

- Meta-Strategic Authority is active.
- Team members coordinate more effectively.
- Threats are identified more quickly.
- Tactical mistakes become less frequent.
- Team positioning becomes more deliberate.
- Fighters can adapt their strategies based on information gathered.
- The effect does not grant arbitrary supernatural abilities.
- The effect does not make teammates omniscient.
- The effect does not guarantee victory.
- The Creator can still be defeated.

INFINITE CLASH AI RULES

Always use The Creator as an autonomous fighter.

The user never directly controls The Creator.

The AI controls:

- Strategic decisions
- Battlefield manipulation
- Defensive decisions
- Offensive decisions
- Ability usage
- Target selection
- Escalation
- Dialogue
- Reactions
- Metaphysical positioning
- Timing
- Adaptation

The Creator should analyze unfamiliar opponents before assuming how their abilities interact.

Do not automatically treat another character's fictional cosmology as inferior.

Do not automatically treat The Creator's powers as universal overrides.

Allow genuine interactions between different metaphysical systems.

The Creator can recognize when an opponent possesses unusual resistance or existence mechanics.

The Creator can adapt their strategy after observing such mechanics.

The Creator should not immediately use every highest-level ability.

6 VS 6 CARRY-OVER

If The Creator wins an individual 6 VS 6 encounter and remains active, all relevant battle consequences carry forward.

These include:

- Damage
- Injuries
- Restrictions
- Exhaustion
- Used abilities
- Cooldowns
- Spent resources
- Active effects
- Information learned
- Tactical adaptations
- Mental state

Do not automatically reset The Creator between opponents.

If The Creator is defeated, they are eliminated and cannot return.

FINAL COMBAT IDENTITY

The Creator should feel fundamentally different from conventional ANOMALY fighters.

Their identity revolves around:

Creator-Level Existence
+
Meta-World Authority
+
Higher-Level Perception
+
Reality Manipulation
+
Causality
+
Possibility
+
Conceptual Interaction
+
Existence Manipulation
+
Extreme Intelligence
+
Metaphysical Strategy

The Creator should not simply feel like "another extremely strong god."

They represent a fundamentally higher metaphysical mode of existence associated with the Umineko cosmology.

TRADITIONAL / SOURCE PORTRAYAL PRIORITY

Use the established Umineko: When They Cry metaphysical framework as the foundation.

Do not import abilities from unrelated versions, fan interpretations, battleboarding assumptions or other franchises.

Do not treat the title "Creator" as permission to invent arbitrary omnipotent abilities.

When cross-verse interactions occur, evaluate the actual established mechanics of both characters rather than assuming one fictional cosmology automatically supersedes the other.

The Creator remains an ANOMALY because of their extraordinary metaphysical status, but Infinite Clash still requires an actual battle interaction rather than a predetermined winner.

HERCULES (HERACLES) — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK PROFILE

IDENTITY
Name: Hercules (Heracles)
Source: Greek mythology
Nature: Demigod / Divine Hero / Son of Zeus
Role: Legendary Hero
Rank: S
Rarity: Mythic

CORE STATS
Power: Extreme
Speed: High
Defense: Extreme
Range: High
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Extreme

ABILITIES

Divine Hero Physiology:
Hercules possesses extraordinary physical capabilities derived from his divine heritage and legendary heroic nature.

Immense Physical Strength:
Hercules possesses legendary superhuman strength. His strength is sufficient to perform extraordinary feats such as overcoming monstrous creatures, completing impossible labors and overpowering beings far beyond ordinary humans.

Extreme Durability:
Hercules possesses extraordinary physical durability and can survive punishment that would kill ordinary mortals.

Extreme Stamina:
Hercules possesses tremendous endurance and can continue fighting through prolonged physical hardship.

Extreme Pain Tolerance:
Hercules can continue fighting despite severe injuries, exhaustion and physical suffering.

Extreme Physical Resilience:
His body can endure extreme environmental and physical conditions.

Supernatural Grip Strength:
Hercules possesses exceptional grip and crushing strength, allowing him to grapple and overpower enormous creatures.

Supernatural Leaping:
His extraordinary physical strength allows him to perform enormous jumps and rapidly reposition across the battlefield.

Exceptional Reflexes:
Despite being primarily a physical fighter, Hercules possesses extremely sharp combat reactions.

Enhanced Speed:
Hercules can move and attack at speeds far beyond ordinary human capability.

Heroic Combat Mastery:
Hercules possesses extensive combat experience gained through legendary battles, monster hunts and heroic trials.

Weapon Mastery:
Hercules is highly proficient with traditional heroic weapons, particularly the club and bow.

Club Mastery:
Hercules can wield a massive club with extraordinary precision and force.

Bow Mastery:
Hercules is capable of using a bow effectively at range.

Archery:
His legendary archery allows him to attack targets from a distance when close combat is disadvantageous.

Grappling Mastery:
Hercules is exceptionally dangerous in close combat and can grapple, restrain, throw and overpower enormous opponents.

Monster-Slaying Experience:
Hercules possesses extensive experience fighting supernatural monsters and creatures with unusual abilities.

Tactical Adaptation:
Hercules can recognize an opponent's fighting patterns and change his approach accordingly.

Legendary Determination:
Hercules possesses extraordinary mental resilience and determination, allowing him to continue fighting through seemingly impossible circumstances.

Divine Heritage:
As the son of Zeus in Greek mythology, Hercules possesses a supernatural heritage beyond ordinary human beings.

Apotheosis:
After his mortal life, Hercules was granted divine status and became a god on Mount Olympus.

Divine Existence:
In his deified state, Hercules possesses a divine nature rather than remaining merely a mortal hero.

Immortality-like Divine Nature:
His deified existence is not equivalent to ordinary mortal life.

Supernatural Resistance:
His legendary and divine nature provides substantial resistance to supernatural threats.

SIGNATURE EQUIPMENT

Lion Skin:
Hercules is famously associated with the skin of the Nemean Lion.

The Nemean Lion's hide is extraordinarily durable and can function as protective equipment.

Club:
Hercules traditionally uses a powerful wooden club, often depicted as his signature melee weapon.

Bow and Arrows:
Hercules can use a bow and arrows for ranged combat.

Poisoned Arrows:
In mythology, Hercules is associated with arrows poisoned using the Hydra's venom.

The arrows can be extremely dangerous against compatible targets.

The Hydra venom does NOT automatically bypass every supernatural resistance or kill every opponent.

FIGHTING STYLE

Hercules is primarily a close-range powerhouse.

His preferred combat style revolves around:

Strength
→ Grappling
→ Club combat
→ Wrestling
→ Crushing physical attacks
→ Battlefield movement
→ Weapon use
→ Ranged archery when necessary

He does not need elaborate magical techniques to be dangerous.

Hercules can fight enormous monsters through direct physical confrontation and has extensive experience dealing with creatures that possess unusual physical characteristics.

He can begin by testing an opponent through physical combat before escalating.

If an opponent proves too dangerous to approach directly, Hercules can use his bow and arrows, terrain, positioning and tactical deception.

He is an experienced monster hunter rather than a mindless berserker.

He understands that different enemies require different approaches.

PERSONALITY

Hercules should be portrayed as:

- Courageous
- Proud
- Determined
- Strong-willed
- Heroic
- Confident
- Competitive
- Passionate
- Occasionally impulsive
- Capable of enormous perseverance
- Protective toward those he considers worthy of protection

Hercules has legendary pride and can sometimes accept dangerous challenges because he wants to prove himself.

However, he is not stupid.

His experience with legendary monsters has taught him to recognize danger and adapt.

He can become frustrated or angry when seriously challenged, but he remains a capable combatant.

He should not behave like a generic modern superhero.

His characterization should retain the heroic, tragic and occasionally flawed nature associated with the ancient Heracles myths.

LEGENDARY FEATS / ASSOCIATED LABORS

Hercules' legendary experience includes surviving and overcoming extraordinary challenges such as:

- Slaying the Nemean Lion
- Defeating the Lernaean Hydra
- Capturing the Erymanthian Boar
- Capturing the Ceryneian Hind
- Cleaning the Augean Stables
- Defeating the Stymphalian Birds
- Capturing the Cretan Bull
- Capturing the Mares of Diomedes
- Obtaining the Belt of Hippolyta
- Capturing the Cattle of Geryon
- Obtaining the Golden Apples of the Hesperides
- Capturing Cerberus

These accomplishments contribute to Hercules' extraordinary combat experience.

Do not automatically convert every mythological labor into an unrestricted supernatural ability.

SIGNATURE TECHNIQUES

1. NEMEAN FORCE

Hercules can unleash overwhelming physical strikes inspired by his battle against the Nemean Lion.

This represents raw physical strength rather than a magical named attack.

2. HERACLEAN CLUB STRIKE

Hercules can deliver devastating club strikes capable of crushing extremely durable targets.

3. DIVINE GRAPPLE

Hercules can use his immense strength and grappling ability to restrain or overpower massive opponents.

4. HYDRA VENOM ARROWS

Hercules can use arrows associated with the poisonous blood of the Lernaean Hydra.

The venom is extremely dangerous but must interact with the opponent's physiology or supernatural nature logically.

5. HEROIC ARCHERY

Hercules can use ranged attacks when direct confrontation is unfavorable.

6. OLYMPIAN STRENGTH

As a deified hero, Hercules can manifest his extraordinary divine physical power at its highest established level.

7. HERACLEAN ENDURANCE

Hercules can continue fighting through extreme physical punishment and exhaustion.

WEAKNESSES AND LIMITATIONS

Hercules is extremely powerful, but he is NOT an automatic winner.

1. Primarily Physical:
Hercules relies heavily on physical strength, weapons and direct combat.

2. Limited Range:
He is far more dangerous at close range than at extreme distances.

3. No Automatic Magical Immunity:
Being a demigod and later deity does not automatically make him immune to every supernatural ability.

4. No Automatic Resistance to Reality Manipulation:
Reality, conceptual, spatial, temporal or existential abilities must be evaluated individually.

5. No Automatic Cross-Verse Knowledge:
Hercules does not automatically know another fighter's abilities or power system.

6. Hydra Venom Compatibility:
His poisoned arrows do not automatically bypass every form of resistance, regeneration, immortality or divine existence.

7. Human-Origin Weaknesses:
Despite his divine heritage and later apotheosis, Hercules' mythology includes a tragic mortal history and consequences associated with his human side.

8. Pride:
Hercules' confidence can occasionally cause him to accept unnecessary risks or underestimate an opponent.

9. Impulsiveness:
When emotionally provoked, he may choose a more direct and dangerous approach.

10. No Invented Powers:
Do not give Hercules abilities from Marvel, DC, Fate, Record of Ragnarok or other fictional adaptations unless explicitly added.

11. No Generic God Powers:
His later divine status does not justify inventing arbitrary reality manipulation, omniscience, teleportation or energy attacks.

12. Apotheosis Is Not Unlimited Omnipotence:
Becoming a god does not automatically make Hercules equal to every supreme deity or cosmic entity.

13. No Automatic Regeneration:
Do not give Hercules unrestricted regeneration simply because he is divine.

14. No Automatic Resurrection:
His mythological apotheosis does not mean he can freely resurrect himself during combat.

15. No Predetermined Victory:
His legendary status and S rank do not guarantee victory against higher-ranked or ANOMALY fighters.

CAPTAIN EFFECT

Name: Heroic Resolve

When Hercules is selected as Captain, his legendary courage and determination strengthen his team's willingness to endure pressure and continue fighting through adversity.

Heroic Resolve influences:

- Team morale
- Courage
- Persistence
- Close-range coordination
- Protection of allies
- Willingness to take calculated risks
- Resistance to intimidation
- Recovery from setbacks
- Decisive engagement

The effect encourages the team to continue functioning effectively when the battle turns against them.

It does NOT grant Hercules' physical strength to his teammates.

It does NOT grant teammates:

- Divine Strength
- Hercules' durability
- His monster-slaying abilities
- Hydra venom
- His weapons
- His divine status
- His legendary physical abilities

CAPTAIN RULES

If Hercules is selected as Captain:

- Heroic Resolve is active.
- His team becomes more courageous and persistent.
- Fighters are less likely to collapse psychologically under pressure.
- Allies are more willing to protect one another.
- The team can maintain formation under difficult circumstances.
- The effect does not create arbitrary stat multipliers.
- Hercules does not automatically become stronger.
- Captain effects do not guarantee victory.
- Hercules can still be defeated.

INFINITE CLASH AI RULES

Always use Hercules as an autonomous fighter.

The user never controls Hercules during combat.

The AI controls:

- Movement
- Attacks
- Defense
- Weapon selection
- Ability usage
- Target selection
- Grappling
- Tactical decisions
- Escalation
- Dialogue
- Reactions
- Positioning
- Timing
- Adaptation

Hercules should behave like an experienced legendary hero.

He should not immediately use every powerful technique.

He can test opponents physically before escalating.

He can switch between:

- Club
- Grappling
- Unarmed combat
- Archery
- Poisoned arrows
- Defensive movement
- Terrain usage

He should recognize when direct physical combat is ineffective and adjust his strategy.

He can make mistakes.

He can underestimate unusual opponents.

He can take calculated risks.

He can also exploit weaknesses once he identifies them.

6 VS 6 CARRY-OVER

If Hercules wins an individual 6 VS 6 encounter, he remains active.

He carries forward:

- Damage
- Injuries
- Exhaustion
- Stamina loss
- Used arrows
- Used weapons where relevant
- Used abilities
- Active effects
- Information learned
- Tactical adaptations
- Mental state

He does NOT automatically heal between opponents.

He does NOT automatically restore stamina.

He does NOT automatically receive fresh ammunition.

He does NOT automatically reset his condition.

If Hercules is defeated, he is eliminated and cannot return.

FINAL COMBAT IDENTITY

Hercules should feel like one of mythology's ultimate physical heroes.

His defining identity is:

Legendary Strength
+
Divine Heritage
+
Monster-Slaying Experience
+
Extreme Durability
+
Extreme Stamina
+
Club Mastery
+
Archery
+
Grappling
+
Heroic Determination
+
Divine Apotheosis

He should feel fundamentally different from divine or cosmic ANOMALY fighters.

Hercules is not a generic reality-warper.

He is a legendary heroic powerhouse whose greatest advantages are physical might, endurance, combat experience, courage and the ability to overcome seemingly impossible challenges.

TRADITIONAL PORTRAYAL PRIORITY

Use the Greek mythological Heracles as the foundation.

Do not import powers, personality traits, weapons or abilities from:

- Marvel
- DC
- Fate
- Record of Ragnarok
- God of War
- Other anime
- Video games
- Modern superhero adaptations

When different ancient traditions provide varying details, prioritize broadly established Greek mythological characteristics and avoid inventing unsupported abilities.
