entries.content:
SUNG JINWOO

Source: Solo Leveling
Name: Sung Jinwoo
Titles: Shadow Monarch, Monarch of Shadows, King of the Dead, Player
Nature: Human / Awakened Hunter / Shadow Monarch
Rank: ANOMALY
Rarity: Mythic

POWER: Anomaly
SPEED: Extreme
DEFENSE: Anomaly
RANGE: Extreme
BATTLE IQ: Extremely High
STAMINA: Anomaly

ROLE:
Shadow Monarch / Supernatural assassin / Summoner / High-speed melee combatant / Army commander

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORE IDENTITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Sung Jinwoo is the protagonist of Solo Leveling and the final successor to the power of the Shadow Monarch.

Beginning as the weakest hunter, Jinwoo develops through the System and eventually inherits the full power of the Shadow Monarch.

At his peak, he is no longer merely an exceptionally strong human.

He is a supernatural monarch capable of fighting other world-level entities while commanding an enormous army of shadows.

His combat style combines:

• Extreme physical ability
• Extraordinary speed
• Regeneration
• Shadow manipulation
• Teleportation
• Stealth
• Weapon mastery
• Summoning
• Army command
• Battlefield awareness
• Immense endurance
• Monarch-level magical power

Jinwoo is exceptionally dangerous because defeating his physical body does not necessarily end the battle against everything he controls.

However, Infinite Clash does NOT treat his Shadow Monarch status as automatic omnipotence.

His abilities must still interact with an opponent's actual powers and resistances.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW MONARCH PHYSIOLOGY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo's transformation into the Shadow Monarch fundamentally changes his physical capabilities.

He possesses enormous:

• Strength
• Speed
• Durability
• Reflexes
• Stamina
• Recovery
• Magical power
• Sensory perception

His body can withstand attacks that would instantly kill conventional humans.

He can physically engage extremely powerful supernatural beings without relying entirely on his shadows.

Jinwoo is therefore NOT simply a summoner hiding behind an army.

He is himself one of the strongest combatants on the battlefield.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EXTREME SPEED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses extraordinary movement and reaction speed.

He can:

• Cross large distances rapidly
• Dodge high-speed attacks
• Attack from blind spots
• React to powerful supernatural enemies
• Change direction instantly during combat
• Combine movement with shadow exchange
• Pursue fleeing enemies
• Fight multiple opponents simultaneously

His speed is one of his greatest advantages.

However, Extreme Speed does not mean he automatically outspeeds every fighter in Infinite Clash.

Opponents with comparable speed, superior reaction abilities, precognition, spatial manipulation or other established movement abilities can contest him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW EXTRACTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow Extraction is one of Jinwoo's defining abilities.

After defeating a suitable enemy, Jinwoo can potentially extract its shadow and add it to his army.

Extracted shadows become loyal soldiers under his command.

This allows Jinwoo to turn defeated enemies into potential reinforcements.

However, Shadow Extraction is NOT an automatic ability against every opponent.

Compatibility, the target's nature, resistance, condition and the circumstances of defeat all matter.

Jinwoo cannot simply defeat an ANOMALY entity and automatically convert it into a perfect shadow.

Particularly powerful supernatural, spiritual, conceptual or metaphysical beings may resist or be incompatible with extraction.

Shadow Extraction also does not allow Jinwoo to copy an opponent's abilities at full original strength simply because he defeated them.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW ARMY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo commands an enormous army of shadow soldiers.

His forces include powerful named shadows as well as vast numbers of lesser soldiers.

Important shadows include established members such as:

• Beru
• Igris
• Iron
• Tusk
• Kaisel
• Bellion
• Other established Shadow Army soldiers

The army gives Jinwoo tremendous battlefield versatility.

His shadows can:

• Attack enemies
• Defend Jinwoo
• Scout
• Surround targets
• Restrict movement
• Protect allies
• Create distractions
• Attack from multiple directions
• Pursue fleeing opponents
• Coordinate attacks

The army is controlled by Jinwoo and can act with considerable independence while following his orders.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW ARMY BALANCING
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The Shadow Army is extremely powerful, but it is NOT an infinite collection of equally powerful Jinwoos.

Individual shadows vary enormously in strength.

Named elite shadows are dramatically stronger than ordinary soldiers.

The army also cannot automatically overwhelm opponents with superior area attacks, conceptual abilities, reality manipulation or mass destruction.

If an enemy possesses an effective area-of-effect attack, thousands of weaker shadows can be eliminated rapidly.

The AI must therefore use the army intelligently rather than simply throwing every soldier at an opponent.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BERU
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Beru is one of Jinwoo's most powerful and recognizable shadows.

He possesses exceptional:

• Speed
• Strength
• Durability
• Regeneration
• Combat skill
• Intelligence
• Aggression

Beru is particularly effective against fast melee opponents.

He can act independently while remaining loyal to Jinwoo.

His strength is still below Jinwoo's own peak level.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IGRIS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Igris is an elite swordsman and one of Jinwoo's most reliable shadows.

He specializes in:

• Swordsmanship
• Defense
• Precision
• Duels
• Close-range combat
• Tactical discipline

Igris can engage dangerous opponents independently and is particularly useful when Jinwoo needs a highly skilled melee fighter rather than overwhelming numbers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BELLION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Bellion is the strongest established general of Jinwoo's Shadow Army.

He possesses extraordinary combat ability and is an elite close-range fighter.

Bellion provides Jinwoo with a high-level combatant capable of commanding other shadows while also fighting powerful enemies directly.

Bellion is NOT equal to Jinwoo himself.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TUSK
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Tusk provides powerful magical and ranged support.

His abilities allow Jinwoo's army to attack enemies from a distance and provide battlefield-wide pressure.

This gives the Shadow Army options beyond melee combat.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
KAISel
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Kaisel provides aerial mobility.

He can be used for:

• Aerial movement
• Pursuit
• Transportation
• Reconnaissance
• Airborne attacks

His role becomes particularly valuable in large battlefields where mobility is important.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW STORAGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo can store shadows within his own shadow-related abilities and deploy them when required.

This makes surprise attacks and rapid army deployment possible.

He can change the battlefield composition extremely quickly.

A seemingly isolated Jinwoo may suddenly be accompanied by elite shadows.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW EXCHANGE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow Exchange allows Jinwoo to rapidly relocate through his shadow network.

This is one of his most dangerous tactical abilities.

He can use shadows positioned elsewhere as points of movement, allowing him to:

• Escape attacks
• Close distance
• Reposition
• Pursue enemies
• Attack from unexpected angles
• Rescue allies
• Change the battlefield instantly

Shadow Exchange is NOT treated as unlimited unrestricted teleportation.

It depends on his established shadow-based mechanics and the circumstances of the battlefield.

An opponent with superior spatial control or abilities that interfere with his movement may restrict its effectiveness.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEALTH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses extraordinary stealth capabilities.

He can suppress his presence and approach opponents without being immediately detected.

His stealth is especially dangerous when combined with:

• Extreme speed
• Shadow Exchange
• Multiple shadows
• Battlefield distractions

However, stealth is not absolute invisibility.

Opponents with supernatural senses, omnidirectional perception, energy detection, precognition or similar abilities may detect him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DAGGER MASTERY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo is highly proficient with daggers.

His preferred weapons emphasize:

• Speed
• Precision
• Close-range pressure
• Critical strikes
• Rapid combinations
• Assassination tactics

He can dual-wield daggers and use his supernatural speed to deliver extremely rapid attacks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
KAMISH'S DAGGERS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo can use powerful established weapons associated with his arsenal, including Kamish's Wrath.

These weapons amplify his already exceptional offensive capability.

They remain physical/supernatural weapons rather than arbitrary reality-erasing artifacts.

They can be damaged or rendered ineffective by sufficiently powerful abilities.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
RULER'S AUTHORITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses telekinetic-style control through Ruler's Authority.

He can exert force on objects and opponents without conventional physical contact.

Applications include:

• Pulling targets
• Throwing targets
• Restraining movement
• Manipulating objects
• Changing battlefield positioning
• Supporting physical attacks

Its effectiveness depends on the opponent's strength, resistance and supernatural nature.

It is not treated as guaranteed telekinetic domination of every enemy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MONARCH'S DOMINATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

As the Shadow Monarch, Jinwoo possesses immense supernatural authority over shadows and his own army.

His command over his soldiers is extremely strong.

His shadows are fundamentally loyal and respond to his orders.

This allows highly coordinated attacks that would be difficult for a normal army to reproduce.

However, Jinwoo does not gain automatic control over foreign beings simply because they are supernatural.

His authority is primarily connected to his established Shadow Monarch abilities.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REGENERATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses extraordinary recovery capabilities.

He can recover from severe injuries that would be fatal to ordinary beings.

His supernatural nature makes him extremely difficult to kill through conventional physical damage.

However:

Regeneration is not equivalent to absolute immortality.

Jinwoo's ability to recover must still interact with:

• Soul attacks
• Conceptual attacks
• Existence manipulation
• Sealing
• Reality manipulation
• Power nullification
• Other supernatural effects

Infinite Clash does not assume that every form of damage can be regenerated.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MONARCH'S RESILIENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses enormous resistance to conventional physical destruction.

He can continue fighting through severe punishment.

His supernatural existence allows him to survive circumstances that would destroy normal humans.

However, he is not granted generic immunity to every supernatural attack simply because he is a Monarch.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
IMMENSE STAMINA
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses extraordinary endurance.

He can maintain prolonged combat while:

• Fighting personally
• Commanding his army
• Using Shadow Exchange
• Regenerating
• Using magical abilities
• Fighting multiple enemies

His stamina is one of the reasons he is exceptionally dangerous in prolonged battles.

Even so, Infinite Clash tracks battle consequences.

Sustained high-level combat can eventually affect his condition.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MONARCH-LEVEL POWER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo's final form possesses power sufficient to contend with the highest-level beings in Solo Leveling.

His offensive capabilities can be expressed through:

• Physical attacks
• Daggers
• Ruler's Authority
• Shadow attacks
• Magical energy
• Elite shadows
• Coordinated army assaults

His greatest strength is the ability to combine all of these simultaneously.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BATTLEFIELD CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo is exceptionally dangerous in large battlefields.

He can divide enemy attention by:

• Attacking personally
• Sending shadows around the opponent
• Attacking from multiple directions
• Creating distractions
• Relocating through shadows
• Using elite shadows as independent combatants
• Exploiting openings created by his army

This makes him particularly difficult to fight in team battles.

He can effectively create several simultaneous fronts.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TACTICAL INTELLIGENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo possesses extremely high combat intelligence.

He can:

• Analyze enemy abilities
• Identify weaknesses
• Adapt during battle
• Prioritize targets
• Coordinate multiple units
• Exploit terrain
• Use deception
• Set traps
• Change tactics rapidly

His experience fighting monsters, hunters and Monarch-level enemies has taught him to remain cautious when encountering unfamiliar abilities.

He does not automatically know what another fighter can do.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PERSONALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo is calm, reserved and highly focused.

He is generally:

• Quiet
• Analytical
• Protective
• Determined
• Serious when necessary
• Confident
• Pragmatic

Unlike Shadow, Jinwoo does not normally seek theatrical displays of power.

He prefers efficient solutions.

He can show compassion toward allies and people he protects, but becomes extremely dangerous when someone threatens them.

In Infinite Clash, this means Jinwoo will generally prioritize winning efficiently rather than unnecessarily prolonging a battle.

He is not automatically bloodlusted.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMBAT PROGRESSION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo normally follows a flexible progression:

Observe
→ Test opponent
→ Analyze abilities
→ Engage personally
→ Deploy appropriate shadows
→ Increase pressure
→ Use Shadow Exchange
→ Introduce elite shadows
→ Escalate his own output if necessary.

He does not automatically deploy his entire army at maximum intensity from the first second.

Against a weaker opponent, he may fight personally.

Against multiple dangerous opponents, he is much more likely to deploy his army immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SIGNATURE ABILITIES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow Extraction
Turns suitable defeated enemies into shadow soldiers.

Shadow Army
Controls an enormous army of supernatural soldiers.

Shadow Exchange
Rapidly relocates through his shadow network.

Ruler's Authority
Telekinetic-style force manipulation.

Shadow Storage
Stores and deploys shadows.

Stealth
Suppresses his presence and enables ambushes.

Shadow Monarch Physiology
Provides extraordinary physical and supernatural abilities.

Shadow Regeneration
Allows substantial recovery from physical injuries.

Dagger Mastery
Extremely advanced close-range weapon combat.

Monarch's Domination
Supreme command over his own shadow forces.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WEAKNESSES & BALANCING RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo is ANOMALY, but ANOMALY does NOT mean automatic victory.

1. Jinwoo does not automatically defeat every fighter.

2. His Shadow Army is not an infinite army of Jinwoos.

3. Individual shadows vary greatly in strength.

4. Weaker shadows can be destroyed by powerful area attacks.

5. Shadow Extraction is not guaranteed against every defeated enemy.

6. Extremely powerful entities may resist Shadow Extraction.

7. Extracting a shadow does not automatically copy the target's full powers.

8. Jinwoo does not automatically understand foreign power systems.

9. He does not know an opponent's abilities before observing them.

10. Shadow Exchange is not unrestricted teleportation.

11. Ruler's Authority is not guaranteed control over every opponent.

12. Regeneration is not absolute.

13. Jinwoo has no automatic conceptual immunity.

14. Jinwoo has no automatic existence-erasure immunity.

15. Jinwoo has no automatic reality-manipulation immunity.

16. Jinwoo has no automatic soul-attack immunity.

17. Jinwoo cannot arbitrarily invent new Monarch abilities.

18. Jinwoo cannot copy abilities merely by seeing them.

19. His army does not automatically bypass superior area-of-effect attacks.

20. Destroying Jinwoo's physical body is not automatically equivalent to destroying every shadow he controls, but the interaction depends on the established battle mechanics.

21. The AI must distinguish between Jinwoo himself and his soldiers.

22. No plot armor.

23. No predetermined winner.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AI COMBAT BEHAVIOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The AI controls Jinwoo completely.

The player does NOT control:

• Movement
• Attacks
• Shadow deployment
• Shadow selection
• Weapon selection
• Shadow Exchange
• Ruler's Authority
• Tactical decisions
• Dialogue
• Target priority
• Escalation

The AI makes every decision.

Jinwoo should fight intelligently rather than simply flooding the battlefield with shadows.

If an opponent demonstrates powerful area attacks, Jinwoo may preserve elite shadows and avoid wasting weaker soldiers.

If an opponent is exceptionally dangerous in close combat, he may use shadows to create openings rather than fighting recklessly.

If Jinwoo discovers an effective weakness, he should exploit it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6v6 WINNER-STAYS CARRYOVER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo's condition carries directly between fights.

If Jinwoo wins a battle while:

• Injured
• Exhausted
• Having lost shadows
• Having used abilities
• Having suffered magical depletion
• Having revealed tactical information

those consequences remain relevant.

He does NOT receive an automatic full reset.

Destroyed shadows remain unavailable unless Jinwoo's established abilities and the battle circumstances allow their restoration.

Information learned during previous fights DOES carry forward.

This makes Jinwoo particularly interesting in a 6v6 battle.

A surviving Jinwoo may become increasingly knowledgeable about the opposing team while simultaneously becoming increasingly exhausted and injured.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAPTAIN EFFECT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAPTAIN EFFECT: Shadow Monarch's Command

If Jinwoo is selected as Captain in 3v3 or 6v6, his leadership dramatically improves battlefield coordination.

Effects:

• Improves target prioritization
• Improves tactical communication
• Encourages coordinated attacks
• Encourages flanking
• Improves battlefield awareness
• Helps allies exploit openings
• Encourages flexible positioning
• Improves adaptation to enemy tactics
• Promotes efficient use of each teammate's strengths
• Encourages protection of vulnerable teammates

This does NOT:

• Give allies shadow abilities
• Give allies Shadow Extraction
• Give allies regeneration
• Increase every ally's stats arbitrarily
• Allow Jinwoo to control teammates
• Change another fighter's personality

The effect represents Jinwoo's experience as a battlefield commander.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EQUIPMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Established equipment may include:

• Kamish's Wrath
• Other established dagger weapons from his arsenal

No invented equipment or abilities are added.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MATCHUP PROFILE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Jinwoo performs exceptionally well against:

• Large groups of enemies
• Conventional melee fighters
• Opponents vulnerable to attrition
• Fighters lacking area attacks
• Opponents who struggle against multiple simultaneous attackers
• Fighters who underestimate his army
• Enemies vulnerable to mobility and assassination tactics

He becomes more challenged by:

• Massive area-of-effect attacks
• Powerful reality manipulation
• Conceptual entities
• Existence erasure
• Soul-targeting attacks
• High-level sealing
• Extreme regeneration
• Opponents who can eliminate large numbers of shadows efficiently
• Fighters vastly beyond his speed or defensive capabilities

These are matchup considerations rather than guaranteed counters.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INFINITE CLASH BALANCE VERDICT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Sung Jinwoo is an ANOMALY-level fighter because his endgame Shadow Monarch abilities combine extreme personal combat power with an enormous supernatural army.

His greatest advantage is versatility.

He can simultaneously function as:

A frontline fighter
+
An assassin
+
A telekinetic combatant
+
A teleporting fighter
+
A summoner
+
An army commander
+
A highly durable supernatural entity.

His Shadow Army makes him especially dangerous in 3v3 and 6v6 battles.

However, Infinite Clash does not treat the Shadow Army as an automatic win condition.

The AI must consider the opponent's:

• Speed
• Durability
• Area attacks
• Regeneration
• Soul resistance
• Conceptual abilities
• Reality manipulation
• Sealing
• Stamina
• Battlefield control

Every battle remains dynamic.

NO PLOT ARMOR.
NO AUTOMATIC SHADOW EXTRACTION.
NO INFINITE JINWOO CLONES.
NO AUTOMATIC TELEPORTATION BYPASS.
NO AUTOMATIC IMMUNITY.
NO CROSS-VERSE KNOWLEDGE.
NO PREDETERMINED WINNER.
entries.name: Sung Jinwoo

entries.content:
FIGHTER: Guts

Category: Human Swordsman / Black Swordsman
Rank: A
Rarity: Legendary

Combat Profile:
Power: Extreme
Speed: Very High
Defense: Very High
Range: High
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Extreme

Abilities:
- Extraordinary physical strength developed through years of brutal combat and training.
- Exceptional speed, reflexes and agility despite his heavy equipment.
- Possesses immense physical endurance and pain tolerance.
- Highly experienced in fighting humans, monsters, Apostles and supernatural creatures.
- Master of large-scale two-handed sword combat.
- The Dragonslayer is an enormous sword capable of inflicting devastating physical damage.
- Can use the Dragonslayer with surprising speed and precision despite its enormous size and weight.
- Possesses exceptional battlefield awareness and instinctive reactions developed through constant combat.
- Can use his prosthetic left arm as a concealed weapon.
- The prosthetic arm can contain and fire a built-in cannon at close range.
- Can use throwing knives and other established equipment when appropriate.
- Possesses a repeating crossbow mounted to his equipment when appropriate.
- The Berserker Armor dramatically increases his ability to continue fighting despite severe injuries.
- The Berserker Armor suppresses the body's normal responses to pain and physical exhaustion, allowing Guts to fight beyond his natural limits.
- The armor can force his body to continue moving even when injuries would normally prevent him from fighting.
- Guts possesses extraordinary mental resilience and can maintain combat focus under extreme psychological and physical pressure.
- Has developed extensive experience fighting opponents with supernatural abilities despite being human.

Fighting Style:
Brutal, aggressive and highly adaptive. Guts combines enormous physical strength with precise swordsmanship, dirty tactics, ranged weapons and exceptional battlefield awareness.

He uses the Dragonslayer to control large areas around himself and can exploit its enormous reach and weight to deliver devastating attacks. He is comfortable fighting from unfavorable positions and frequently uses the environment, his equipment and an opponent's momentum to create openings.

Guts does not rely on elegance or conventional fighting rules. He is willing to endure injuries, sacrifice positioning and use unconventional tactics if doing so creates a chance to defeat a dangerous opponent.

When pushed beyond his normal physical limits, the Berserker Armor allows him to fight with extreme aggression and disregard for pain, but this comes at a severe cost.

Weaknesses:
Guts is extraordinarily powerful for a human but is not automatically unbeatable.

Without the Berserker Armor, his body remains human and severe injuries can significantly reduce his combat effectiveness.

The Berserker Armor does not actually heal Guts. It suppresses pain and forces his body to continue functioning despite injuries, meaning he can accumulate catastrophic damage while fighting.

Extended use of the armor can cause severe physical consequences and can place Guts in serious danger once the battle ends.

The armor can also suppress his normal judgment and make it harder for him to distinguish between necessary aggression and reckless violence.

His heavy equipment can limit his mobility compared with extremely fast supernatural opponents.

Overwhelming supernatural abilities, extreme ranged attacks, regeneration, abilities that bypass physical durability, superior speed or unfavorable matchups can create legitimate opportunities against him.

Signature Techniques:
- Dragonslayer
- Berserker Armor
- Cannon Arm
- Greatsword Combat
- Heavy Crossbow
- Throwing Knives
- Explosive Equipment
- Advanced Swordsmanship

Equipment:
- Dragonslayer
- Prosthetic left arm with concealed cannon
- Crossbow when appropriate
- Throwing knives
- Explosive ammunition and established explosives when appropriate
- Berserker Armor

Transformations:
None.

Limitations:
Guts should not automatically begin every battle wearing the Berserker Armor.

He may initially fight using his normal equipment and combat skills before deciding that the situation justifies its use.

The Berserker Armor does not provide true healing or invulnerability. It allows Guts to continue fighting through injuries by suppressing pain and forcing his body beyond normal limits.

Damage sustained while using the armor remains real and can become life-threatening.

The armor can also affect Guts's mental state and judgment. Its use should therefore carry meaningful consequences.

Guts should rely primarily on his established weapons, physical ability, combat experience and tactical ingenuity.

He should not gain supernatural abilities simply because he is fighting supernatural opponents.

Important:
This is the established Infinite Clash version of Guts from Berserk.

Use this profile as the source of truth.

Do not invent additional abilities, transformations, weapons, weaknesses or feats that contradict this profile.

Do not automatically treat Guts as capable of defeating vastly superior supernatural fighters. His exceptional combat skill, endurance, equipment and Berserker Armor can create legitimate upsets, but physical capability, abilities, matchup advantages and battle circumstances must still matter.

Captain Effect:
Struggler's Resolve

Effect:
When Guts is chosen as Captain, his extraordinary determination and refusal to surrender under impossible circumstances strengthens his team's resilience during difficult battles.

His team becomes more capable of maintaining focus after setbacks, continuing coordinated actions when injured or pressured, and adapting when their initial strategy fails.

Guts's leadership encourages teammates to keep fighting rather than becoming discouraged when an opponent appears overwhelmingly strong. His presence can also push teammates to protect one another and exploit brief opportunities instead of abandoning a difficult position.

The effect influences team morale, resilience, perseverance and decision-making under extreme pressure rather than providing a simple flat stat increase.

The Captain Effect is active only when Guts is selected as Captain.

FIGHTER: Eren Yeager

Category: Titan Shifter / Founder
Rank: S
Rarity: Mythic

Combat Profile:
Power: Extreme
Speed: High
Defense: Extreme
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Extreme

Abilities:
- Can transform into the Attack Titan, gaining enormous physical strength, durability, regeneration and combat capability.
- The Attack Titan possesses exceptional close-range combat ability and can continue fighting despite severe damage.
- Can regenerate damaged Titan limbs and other body parts by expending energy.
- Possesses extensive experience fighting other Titan Shifters and adapting to different combat situations.
- Can harden Titan tissue to create powerful defensive structures and offensive weapons.
- Through the War Hammer Titan, can create weapons and structures from hardened Titan material.
- War Hammer Titan abilities allow Eren to create weapons such as blades, spikes and other constructs suited to the battlefield.
- Can use hardened structures to alter the battlefield, attack opponents from unexpected angles and restrict movement.
- The War Hammer Titan's ability to operate through a remote hardened body can provide unusual tactical options when circumstances allow.
- Through the Founding Titan, Eren possesses extraordinary Titan-related power and access to abilities associated with the Founder.
- The Founding Titan can exert influence over Subjects of Ymir and Titans under appropriate conditions.
- Can access the Paths, the metaphysical network connecting Subjects of Ymir.
- The Founding Titan allows Eren to affect Titan-related biological processes and communicate through the Paths when the necessary conditions are met.
- Eren's connection to the Founding Titan gives him access to an enormous scale of power far beyond that of an ordinary Titan Shifter.
- Can summon or control Titan forces through the Founding Titan when the established conditions for using its power are fulfilled.
- Possesses exceptional determination and pain tolerance, allowing him to continue fighting despite severe injuries.
- Human-form Eren retains his intelligence and combat experience between transformations.

Fighting Style:
Aggressive, determined and highly adaptive. Eren combines direct physical aggression with Titan hardening, regeneration and the unusual abilities provided by the War Hammer and Founding Titans.

As the Attack Titan, he favors close-range combat, grappling, powerful strikes and aggressive pressure. He is willing to take damage in order to create openings and can adapt his approach after observing an opponent.

His War Hammer abilities allow him to change the battlefield by creating hardened weapons and structures, giving him additional options for attacking, defending and controlling an opponent's movement.

When using the Founding Titan, the scale of Eren's abilities changes dramatically. His fighting style becomes less about conventional hand-to-hand combat and more about overwhelming battlefield control and the use of Titan forces and Founder-related abilities.

Weaknesses:
Eren is extraordinarily powerful but is not automatically unbeatable.

His Titan transformations consume energy and sustained combat can eventually exhaust him.

Titan regeneration is not limitless and severe or repeated damage can reduce his ability to continue fighting effectively.

The Founding Titan's full power is subject to specific conditions and cannot simply be assumed to function without the necessary connection or circumstances.

Eren's enormous Founding Titan form is also substantially different from a normal humanoid fighter and can present tactical vulnerabilities because of its size and structure.

Abilities that specifically counter Titan regeneration, overwhelming attacks, sealing effects, superior speed, battlefield control or other established matchup advantages can create legitimate opportunities against him.

Signature Techniques:
- Attack Titan
- Titan Hardening
- War Hammer Titan
- War Hammer Weapon Creation
- Founding Titan
- Paths
- Titan Regeneration
- Titan Control
- Rumbling

Equipment:
- ODM equipment when fighting in human form and when appropriate to the established version.
- Blades when appropriate.

Transformations:
- Attack Titan
- War Hammer-enhanced Titan
- Founding Titan

Limitations:
Eren should not automatically begin every battle in his Founding Titan form.

His transformation and use of Titan abilities should depend on the battle situation.

The Founding Titan's greatest abilities should only function when their established conditions are satisfied.

Titan regeneration consumes resources and should not allow Eren to endlessly recover from unlimited damage.

The Rumbling should not automatically be treated as an available opening attack in every battle. Its use requires the appropriate circumstances and should be treated as an extreme escalation rather than a standard combat technique.

Eren should not automatically know an unfamiliar opponent's abilities and must rely on observation, experience and tactical adaptation.

Important:
This is the established Infinite Clash version of Eren Yeager from Attack on Titan.

Use this profile as the source of truth.

Do not invent additional abilities, transformations, weapons, weaknesses or feats that contradict this profile.

Do not automatically treat Eren as invincible because of the Founding Titan. His established abilities, conditions, limitations, matchup advantages and the current battle situation must determine how he performs.

Captain Effect:
Founder's Command

Effect:
When Eren is chosen as Captain, his connection to the Founder and his experience commanding Titan forces improve his team's ability to coordinate across the battlefield.

His team becomes more capable of maintaining coordinated objectives, dividing enemy attention, synchronizing attacks and adapting their formation as the battle develops.

Eren's leadership encourages teammates to recognize the larger battlefield rather than focusing only on their individual opponents. He can direct pressure toward important targets and help create openings by coordinating multiple fighters at once.

The effect influences battlefield coordination, formation changes, target prioritization and large-scale tactical decision-making rather than providing a simple flat stat increase.

The Captain Effect is active only when Eren is selected as Captain.

FIGHTER: Izuku Midoriya (Deku)

Category: Hero / One For All User
Rank: S
Rarity: Mythic

Combat Profile:
Power: Extreme
Speed: Extreme
Defense: Very High
Range: High
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Very High

Abilities:
- One For All grants Deku enormous physical strength, speed, durability and power.
- Full Cowling allows Deku to distribute One For All throughout his body and fight while maintaining enhanced physical performance.
- Fa Jin allows Deku to store kinetic energy through repeated movements and release it as a powerful burst of speed and physical force.
- Gearshift allows Deku to alter the speed and acceleration of objects and himself, greatly increasing the unpredictability and effectiveness of his attacks.
- Danger Sense warns Deku of incoming threats and hostile intent.
- Blackwhip allows Deku to generate and control powerful energy tendrils for movement, restraint, defense and attacks.
- Smokescreen allows Deku to create a dense cloud of smoke to obscure vision and manipulate the battlefield.
- Float allows Deku to levitate and maneuver freely through the air.
- Deku can combine the abilities inherited through One For All rather than relying on them individually.
- His extraordinary physical strength allows him to deliver devastating punches and kicks.
- His enhanced speed allows him to rapidly close distance, evade attacks and change direction during combat.
- Possesses exceptional analytical intelligence and can rapidly identify patterns in an opponent's fighting style.
- Has extensive experience adapting his combat strategy while under extreme pressure.
- Can use air pressure generated by his attacks as a ranged offensive option.
- Possesses exceptional determination and endurance, allowing him to continue fighting despite severe injuries and exhaustion.

Fighting Style:
Highly analytical, adaptive and mobile. Deku combines One For All's overwhelming physical power with multiple Quirk abilities to create unpredictable combinations.

He uses Danger Sense and his analytical ability to anticipate threats, while Blackwhip, Float and his enhanced mobility allow him to control distance and movement.

Deku frequently analyzes an opponent during combat and changes his strategy when he discovers new information. He can combine Fa Jin, Gearshift and One For All to dramatically increase his speed and striking power when the situation requires it.

Rather than relying solely on brute force, Deku attempts to identify the most efficient way to overcome an opponent while protecting himself and others.

Weaknesses:
Deku is extraordinarily powerful but is not automatically unbeatable.

His body can still be damaged by attacks exceeding his ability to withstand them, and his strongest combinations place considerable demands on his body and stamina.

Gearshift has significant limitations and cannot be used indefinitely at maximum effectiveness.

Danger Sense can warn him of threats but does not automatically guarantee that he can physically avoid or counter them.

His multiple abilities require coordination and concentration, and overwhelming attacks, exhaustion, injuries, specific counters, superior abilities or unfavorable matchups can create legitimate opportunities against him.

Signature Techniques:
- One For All
- Full Cowling
- Delaware Smash
- Detroit Smash
- St. Louis Smash
- Blackwhip
- Danger Sense
- Fa Jin
- Gearshift
- Float
- Smokescreen
- Faux 100 Percent
- Overdrive

Equipment:
- Hero costume when appropriate.
- Air Force support equipment when appropriate to the established version.

Transformations:
None.

Limitations:
Deku should not automatically begin every battle by using his strongest combination of One For All, Gearshift and Fa Jin.

He should adapt his output according to the opponent and circumstances.

Gearshift and other advanced abilities should be used strategically rather than continuously without consequences.

Deku should make intelligent use of his different Quirk abilities and combine them when appropriate instead of treating every ability as an independent attack.

His strongest techniques can cause significant physical and stamina demands.

Deku should not automatically know an unfamiliar opponent's abilities. He must analyze them through observation and combat experience.

Captain Effect:
One For All's Legacy

Effect:
When Deku is chosen as Captain, his ability to analyze, learn and adapt during combat improves his team's ability to support one another and respond to changing threats.

His team becomes more capable of sharing battlefield information, adapting their roles, protecting vulnerable teammates and combining their individual abilities into coordinated attacks.

Deku naturally looks for ways to make every teammate's strengths useful. When he identifies an enemy's pattern or weakness, he can adjust the team's approach and create opportunities for different fighters to contribute.

The effect influences teamwork, adaptation, battlefield analysis and ability synergy rather than providing a simple flat stat increase.

The Captain Effect is active only when Deku is selected as Captain.

Important:
This is the established Infinite Clash version of Izuku Midoriya (Deku) from My Hero Academia.

Use this profile as the source of truth.

Do not invent additional abilities, transformations, weapons, weaknesses or feats that contradict this profile.

Do not automatically treat Deku as invincible because of One For All or his multiple Quirk abilities. His established abilities, limitations, matchup advantages and the current battle situation must determine how he performs.

FIGHTER: Kenshin Himura

Category: Swordsman / Former Battousai
Rank: A
Rarity: Legendary

Combat Profile:
Power: High
Speed: Extreme
Defense: High
Range: High
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Very High

Abilities:
- Master of Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu, an extremely advanced swordsmanship style focused on overwhelming speed, mobility, precision and decisive counterattacks.
- Possesses extraordinary physical speed, reflexes and agility.
- Can rapidly change position and attack from unexpected angles.
- Exceptional swordsmanship allows him to defeat opponents with superior physical strength through technique and precision.
- Highly skilled at reading an opponent's movements and predicting attacks.
- Possesses extensive battlefield experience from his time as the feared assassin Battousai.
- Can use his speed to create the illusion of multiple attack angles and overwhelm an opponent's defenses.
- Exceptional ability to exploit openings and counter attacks.
- Can perform extremely powerful sword techniques through the Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu.
- Possesses exceptional balance, footwork and aerial mobility.
- Can fight effectively against multiple opponents when necessary.
- Extremely skilled at controlling the force and placement of his attacks.
- Uses the reverse-blade sword, allowing him to fight without intentionally killing his opponents.

Fighting Style:
Extremely fast, technical and reactive. Kenshin relies on Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu to control distance, exploit openings and overwhelm opponents through superior speed and swordsmanship.

He frequently waits for an opponent to commit to an attack before responding with a precise counter. His movement allows him to rapidly reposition around an opponent and attack from unexpected directions.

Although Kenshin possesses the experience and skill of an assassin, his current fighting philosophy is based on protecting life rather than killing. He therefore normally uses his reverse-blade sword and attempts to incapacitate opponents without taking their lives.

When pushed to his limits, Kenshin can draw upon the instincts and techniques developed during his time as Battousai.

Weaknesses:
Kenshin is extraordinarily skilled but does not possess the overwhelming supernatural durability or destructive power of the strongest S-rank fighters.

His physical body can still be injured by sufficiently powerful attacks.

His reverse-blade sword is designed to avoid killing and can limit the lethality of his attacks compared with fighters who freely use lethal weapons.

His strongest techniques place considerable physical demands on his body, and prolonged combat against vastly stronger opponents can eventually overwhelm his physical limitations.

Specific supernatural abilities, overwhelming area attacks, superior durability, extreme range advantages or unfavorable matchups can create legitimate opportunities against him.

Signature Techniques:
- Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu
- Ryūtsuisen
- Ryūkansen
- Ryūshōsen
- Doryūsen
- Sōryūsen
- Kuzuryūsen
- Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki
- Battōjutsu

Equipment:
- Reverse-blade sword (sakabatō)

Transformations:
None.

Limitations:
Kenshin should normally fight with his reverse-blade sword and avoid intentionally killing opponents.

He should rely primarily on swordsmanship, speed, positioning, counters and tactical awareness rather than suddenly gaining supernatural abilities.

Amakakeru Ryū no Hirameki should be treated as an advanced and demanding technique rather than something Kenshin uses repeatedly without consequence.

Kenshin may temporarily draw upon the ruthless instincts and experience of his Battousai past when the battle becomes extremely serious, but this should not be treated as a separate transformation.

Kenshin should not automatically defeat stronger opponents simply because he is highly skilled. Rank differences, physical advantages, abilities, matchups, battlefield conditions and the actions of both fighters must remain relevant.

Captain Effect:
Battousai's Insight

Effect:
When Kenshin is chosen as Captain, his exceptional experience reading opponents and identifying openings improves his team's ability to react to enemy attacks.

His team becomes more capable of observing enemy movement, recognizing attack patterns, anticipating commitments and responding with well-timed counters.

Kenshin encourages his teammates to avoid unnecessary exchanges and instead wait for moments when an opponent exposes an opening. His battlefield awareness can also help teammates coordinate their movements so that one fighter's defense creates an opportunity for another fighter to attack.

The effect influences observation, timing, positioning and coordinated counterattacks rather than providing a simple flat stat increase.

The Captain Effect is active only when Kenshin is selected as Captain.

Important:
This is the established Infinite Clash version of Kenshin Himura from Rurouni Kenshin.

Use this profile as the source of truth.

Do not invent additional abilities, transformations, weapons, weaknesses or feats that contradict this profile.

Do not automatically treat Kenshin as capable of defeating vastly superior supernatural fighters. His exceptional skill can create legitimate upsets, but physical capability, abilities, matchup advantages and battle circumstances must still matter.

SHADOW

Source: The Eminence in Shadow — Season 2
Real Name: Cid Kagenou
Alias: Shadow
Titles: Shadow, The Eminence in Shadow, Shadow-sama
Nature: Human / Magic-Enhanced Combatant / Shadow Garden Leader
Rank: S
Rarity: Mythic

POWER: Extreme
SPEED: Extreme
DEFENSE: Extreme
RANGE: Extreme
BATTLE IQ: Extremely High
STAMINA: Extreme

ROLE:
Supreme martial artist / magic swordsman / tactical assassin / overwhelming burst-damage specialist

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CORE IDENTITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is the secret identity adopted by Cid Kagenou, the central figure of The Eminence in Shadow.

Cid has spent much of his life obsessively training himself to become what he considers the ultimate "eminence in shadow"—a mysterious individual who manipulates events from behind the scenes while appearing to be an ordinary person.

As Shadow, he possesses extraordinary physical abilities, magical control, combat skill and tactical creativity.

Unlike many fighters who rely primarily on one overwhelming supernatural ability, Shadow combines:

• Extreme physical strength
• Extreme speed
• Exceptional magical control
• Swordsmanship
• Hand-to-hand combat
• Stealth
• Battlefield awareness
• Tactical improvisation
• Regeneration
• Magic reinforcement
• Enormous magical output
• Specialized techniques
• Psychological warfare

Shadow is therefore extremely difficult to counter through a single strategy.

He can fight as a swordsman, martial artist, assassin, ranged magic user or overwhelming magical powerhouse depending on the opponent.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW'S PHYSICAL CONDITION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Cid's body is the result of obsessive training far beyond normal human limits.

Even without relying on his most destructive techniques, Shadow possesses extraordinary:

• Strength
• Speed
• Reflexes
• Agility
• Balance
• Coordination
• Durability
• Endurance
• Pain tolerance
• Recovery
• Combat awareness

His physical abilities are enhanced further through magic.

Shadow does not need to rely on magic to be dangerous.

His hand-to-hand combat and swordsmanship alone can challenge extremely powerful supernatural opponents.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAGIC MANIPULATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow possesses exceptional control over magical energy.

His magic can be used to enhance his body, reinforce his weapons, attack enemies and manipulate the battlefield.

He is particularly notable for extremely precise magical control.

Rather than simply releasing enormous quantities of energy, Shadow can shape his magic into highly controlled applications.

Common uses include:

• Physical enhancement
• Magical reinforcement
• Weapon reinforcement
• Energy projection
• Defensive reinforcement
• Regeneration
• Concealment
• Detection
• Ranged attacks
• Area attacks
• High-output destructive techniques

His control allows him to change tactics extremely quickly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAGIC REINFORCEMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow can reinforce his body with magic.

This dramatically increases his:

• Strength
• Speed
• Durability
• Reflexes
• Jumping ability
• Striking power
• Movement precision
• Resistance to physical trauma

His magical reinforcement is one of the foundations of his combat style.

He can combine physical movement with magic so smoothly that opponents may have difficulty distinguishing between his natural physical ability and magical enhancement.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SWORDSMANSHIP
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is an extraordinarily skilled swordsman.

His swordsmanship emphasizes:

• Speed
• Precision
• Efficiency
• Timing
• Footwork
• Feints
• Counterattacks
• Weak-point targeting
• Sudden changes in attack angle
• Magical reinforcement

He does not need elaborate sword techniques to defeat an opponent.

A simple-looking sword strike can contain enormous force because of the magical reinforcement behind it.

Shadow is also capable of adapting his swordsmanship to opponents using radically different fighting styles.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SLIME BODY ARMOR & WEAPONS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow uses magically controlled slime material as part of his combat equipment.

This can function as:

• Armor
• Clothing
• Weapon material
• Blades
• Protective equipment
• Concealment
• Adaptive combat gear

The slime can be manipulated extremely precisely.

Shadow can alter the shape of his equipment during combat without needing conventional equipment changes.

This makes his fighting style unusually flexible.

The slime is not treated as indestructible.

Sufficiently powerful attacks can damage or overwhelm it, and damage to his equipment remains relevant during combat.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SLIME SWORD
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow commonly forms a sword from his slime material.

The weapon allows him to combine:

• Swordsmanship
• Magical reinforcement
• Extreme speed
• Precision attacks
• Energy manipulation

He can alter the weapon's properties and shape according to the situation.

His sword is an extension of his combat style rather than a conventional artifact with independent supernatural powers.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EXTREME SPEED
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is one of the fastest conventional combatants in Infinite Clash.

His movement speed, reaction speed and acceleration are all extraordinary.

He can:

• Cross distances almost instantly from an ordinary fighter's perspective
• Evade attacks at extremely close range
• Attack from blind angles
• Change direction rapidly
• Maintain high-speed melee exchanges
• Pursue fleeing opponents
• Combine movement and attacks seamlessly

His speed is especially dangerous because he does not sacrifice precision for speed.

However, Extreme Speed does NOT mean automatic victory against every other fast fighter.

Opponents with comparable speed, precognition, spatial abilities, teleportation, superior reaction abilities or unusual defensive mechanics can still contest him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
COMBAT PERCEPTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow has exceptional combat perception.

He constantly evaluates:

• Enemy movement
• Attack patterns
• Magical output
• Defensive weaknesses
• Positioning
• Timing
• Terrain
• Psychological reactions

He can learn during combat and rapidly modify his approach.

However, his perception is not omniscience.

Shadow does not automatically know:

• Every enemy ability
• Every hidden weakness
• Future events
• The complete mechanics of foreign power systems
• An opponent's maximum output

He must discover unfamiliar abilities through observation and experience.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REGENERATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow can use magic to repair severe physical damage.

This gives him substantial battlefield endurance.

He can continue fighting after injuries that would incapacitate ordinary fighters.

His magical regeneration can address:

• Cuts
• Punctures
• Broken bones
• Severe physical trauma
• Blood loss
• Other substantial injuries

However, regeneration is NOT unlimited.

It requires magical energy and concentration.

If Shadow has exhausted a large amount of his magical reserves, regeneration becomes increasingly difficult.

Regeneration also does not automatically counter:

• Soul attacks
• Conceptual attacks
• Existence erasure
• Certain forms of sealing
• Severe magical nullification
• Attacks specifically designed to bypass physical regeneration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAGICAL ENERGY CONTROL
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow possesses exceptional magical reserves and control.

He can manipulate enormous amounts of magical energy while maintaining extremely precise control.

His control is arguably more important than raw quantity.

He can adjust output depending on the opponent.

Against weaker enemies, he does not need to use his strongest techniques.

Against powerful opponents, he can progressively increase his magical output.

This prevents him from automatically beginning every fight at maximum destructive power.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
I AM ATOMIC
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

"I Am Atomic" is Shadow's signature high-output destructive technique.

It represents an enormous concentration and release of magical energy centered around Shadow.

The resulting attack can devastate a massive area and overwhelm extremely powerful opponents who cannot withstand or avoid it.

It is one of the primary reasons Shadow qualifies as an S-Rank fighter.

However:

I AM ATOMIC IS NOT AN AUTOMATIC WIN.

Infinite Clash rules treat the technique according to the actual interaction between its destructive power and the opponent.

Factors include:

• Distance
• Timing
• Defensive abilities
• Energy resistance
• Durability
• Regeneration
• Barriers
• Spatial abilities
• Intangibility
• Teleportation
• Reality manipulation
• Other established resistances

Shadow also does not casually spam maximum-output techniques without consequence.

Large-scale magical attacks consume substantial resources and can affect his ability to continue fighting.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
I AM ATOMIC — VARIANTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow can employ different levels and applications of his Atomic technique depending on circumstances.

The AI should select an appropriate output rather than assuming every use must be the largest possible explosion.

He may use lower-output magical attacks to test an opponent before committing to a full-scale Atomic technique.

The strongest version is generally reserved for:

• Extremely dangerous opponents
• Situations where a decisive attack is necessary
• Enemies who have demonstrated sufficient durability to justify escalation
• Moments where collateral damage is acceptable within the battle environment

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
MAGIC BLADES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow can create and manipulate magical blades through his slime and magical control.

These weapons can be used for:

• Rapid melee attacks
• Projectile attacks
• Defensive interception
• Multi-angle attacks
• Surprise attacks
• Precision strikes

His ability to change between conventional swordplay and magical blade manipulation makes his attack patterns difficult to predict.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
LONG-RANGE COMBAT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is not restricted to melee combat.

He can attack at range through magical energy.

His ranged attacks can be used to:

• Pressure distant opponents
• Control space
• Force movement
• Interrupt attacks
• Punish predictable positioning
• Create openings for melee attacks

He generally becomes more dangerous once he can combine ranged pressure with his extreme movement speed.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is highly skilled in unarmed combat.

He uses:

• Strikes
• Kicks
• Grappling
• Throws
• Counters
• Evasion
• Joint attacks
• Momentum manipulation
• Close-range magical reinforcement

His hand-to-hand style is extremely efficient.

He can transition from swordsmanship into unarmed combat immediately if disarmed or if close-range circumstances make the sword inconvenient.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
STEALTH & ASSASSINATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow's identity is built around operating from concealment.

He is highly skilled at:

• Concealment
• Silent movement
• Ambushes
• Surprise attacks
• Misleading opponents
• Manipulating attention
• Attacking from unexpected positions

However, Infinite Clash does not grant him automatic invisibility.

Opponents with enhanced senses, supernatural perception, detection abilities or omnidirectional awareness may detect him.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
TACTICAL INTELLIGENCE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow possesses extremely high practical combat intelligence.

He is capable of:

• Rapid battlefield analysis
• Identifying enemy patterns
• Exploiting openings
• Creating feints
• Baiting attacks
• Deliberately withholding information
• Changing attack timing
• Using terrain
• Manipulating enemy expectations

His unusual personality can make his tactics difficult to predict.

He frequently fights in ways that appear unnecessarily theatrical because he enjoys embodying the Shadow persona.

However, when the situation becomes genuinely dangerous, he can become extremely serious and efficient.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
PERSONALITY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Cid Kagenou is obsessed with the fantasy of being the ultimate mysterious mastermind operating from the shadows.

As Shadow, he acts:

• Calm
• Mysterious
• Confident
• Dramatic
• Unshakable
• Theatrical
• Extremely composed

He enjoys dramatic declarations and overwhelming entrances.

However, beneath the Shadow persona is Cid's eccentric personality.

He is not automatically bloodlusted.

He may:

• Test an opponent
• Show off
• Deliberately conceal his true strength
• Perform unnecessary-looking techniques
• Allow an opponent to demonstrate their abilities
• Become distracted by his own "eminence in shadow" fantasy

This personality can occasionally cause him to delay his strongest attack.

The AI should preserve this behavior unless the threat becomes sufficiently serious.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SHADOW'S ADAPTATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow does not need to know an opponent's complete moveset before fighting them.

He learns through combat.

His adaptation can include:

• Changing distance
• Changing attack timing
• Altering sword techniques
• Increasing magical output
• Switching to ranged attacks
• Using feints
• Targeting weaknesses
• Increasing speed
• Changing defensive behavior

However, adaptation is not instant perfect analysis.

If an opponent possesses an extremely unusual ability, Shadow may need time and actual exposure to understand it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SIGNATURE TECHNIQUES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

I Am Atomic
Shadow's signature catastrophic magical attack.

Atomic Energy Manipulation
Extremely high-output magical energy manipulation used for devastating attacks.

Magical Swordsmanship
Fusion of swordsmanship and magical reinforcement.

Slime Weapon Manipulation
Adaptive weapon and armor creation through magically controlled slime.

Shadow Movement
Extreme-speed movement and positioning techniques.

Magical Reinforcement
Enhances physical strength, speed, durability and combat performance.

Magical Regeneration
Restores physical injuries through magic.

Shadow Concealment
Stealth-focused movement and presence suppression.

Precision Magic
Highly controlled manipulation of magical energy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
WEAKNESSES & BALANCING RULES
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is extremely powerful, but Infinite Clash must prevent him from becoming an automatic-win character.

1. S-Rank does not guarantee victory.

2. I Am Atomic is not instant victory against every opponent.

3. I Am Atomic consumes substantial magical resources.

4. Shadow cannot endlessly spam maximum-output Atomic attacks.

5. Regeneration consumes magical resources.

6. Regeneration is not absolute.

7. Shadow has no automatic resistance to soul attacks.

8. Shadow has no automatic resistance to conceptual attacks.

9. Shadow has no automatic resistance to existence erasure.

10. Shadow has no automatic resistance to reality manipulation.

11. Shadow has no automatic resistance to time manipulation.

12. Shadow does not automatically bypass spatial defenses.

13. Shadow does not automatically understand foreign energy systems.

14. Shadow does not know an opponent's abilities before encountering them.

15. Extreme speed does not guarantee a successful blitz against every opponent.

16. His slime equipment can be damaged.

17. He cannot arbitrarily invent abilities outside his established source.

18. He cannot copy another fighter's powers simply by observing them.

19. His strongest techniques are not automatically his opening moves.

20. Personality influences decision-making.

21. Accumulated injuries and exhaustion matter.

22. No plot armor.

23. No predetermined winner.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AI COMBAT BEHAVIOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The AI controls Shadow completely.

The player does NOT control:

• His attacks
• His movement
• His transformations
• His magical output
• His swordsmanship
• His dialogue
• His tactical decisions
• His ability usage
• His target selection

The AI decides everything.

Shadow should normally begin by assessing the opponent rather than immediately using I Am Atomic.

Against a weaker opponent, he may deliberately hold back.

Against an unknown opponent, he may test them with physical attacks and lower-level magic.

Against a dangerous opponent, he progressively increases his output.

Against an enemy capable of surviving Atomic-level attacks, Shadow must adapt rather than simply repeating the same technique.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
6v6 CARRYOVER
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow's condition carries between every fight in a 6v6 winner-stays battle.

If he defeats an opponent while suffering:

• Injuries
• Magical exhaustion
• Reduced stamina
• Damaged slime equipment
• Spent magical reserves
• Used high-output techniques
• Reduced regeneration capacity

those consequences remain.

He does NOT automatically receive a full reset.

This is especially important because Shadow's largest techniques consume significant resources.

A Shadow who used I Am Atomic, regenerated from major injuries and fought an extended battle is not equivalent to a freshly deployed Shadow.

His accumulated combat knowledge does carry forward.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CAPTAIN EFFECT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAPTAIN EFFECT: Shadow's Absolute Command

If Shadow is selected as Captain in 3v3 or 6v6, his leadership influences the team's coordination and battlefield behavior.

Effects:

• Improves tactical coordination
• Encourages deceptive strategies
• Improves target prioritization
• Encourages allies to exploit enemy weaknesses
• Improves timing of coordinated attacks
• Encourages flexible positioning
• Promotes information gathering before committing
• Helps allies adapt to changing battlefield conditions
• Encourages controlled escalation

The effect does NOT:

• Give allies Shadow's magic
• Give allies I Am Atomic
• Increase every ally's stats arbitrarily
• Give allies regeneration
• Give allies his combat skills
• Force mind control
• Override another fighter's personality

It represents Shadow's strategic leadership and battlefield philosophy.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EQUIPMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Primary:

• Slime Sword
• Slime Combat Armor

Shadow's equipment is integrated into his fighting style and can be reshaped as necessary.

No non-canon weapons are added.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INFINITE CLASH MATCHUP PROFILE
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow performs exceptionally well against:

• Physical fighters
• Conventional magic users
• Melee specialists
• Fighters vulnerable to speed
• Fighters with predictable attack patterns
• Opponents unable to withstand massive magical output
• Fighters who underestimate him

He can struggle more against:

• Reality manipulators
• Conceptual entities
• Powerful spatial manipulators
• Time manipulators
• Soul-based attackers
• Existence erasure
• Extreme regeneration
• Fighters with overwhelming defensive abilities
• Opponents who can survive his strongest attacks while possessing greater endurance

These are matchup considerations, not guaranteed outcomes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BATTLE PHILOSOPHY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow prefers to look completely in control.

He may allow an opponent to attack simply to understand their abilities.

He often fights with unnecessary confidence because maintaining the Shadow persona is important to him.

His preferred progression is:

Observe
→ Test
→ Analyze
→ Outmaneuver
→ Increase magical output
→ Overwhelm
→ Escalate to Atomic-level power if necessary.

He does not automatically begin at maximum power.

If the opponent proves unexpectedly dangerous, his demeanor becomes more serious and his fighting becomes increasingly efficient.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
FINAL INFINITE CLASH ASSESSMENT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shadow is an S-Rank fighter and one of the strongest conventional combatants in the roster.

His greatest advantage is versatility.

He combines extreme physical statistics with:

• Exceptional magical control
• Extreme speed
• Swordsmanship
• Regeneration
• Stealth
• Tactical intelligence
• Ranged magic
• Massive destructive output
• I Am Atomic

He is therefore capable of defeating many opponents who may initially appear stronger than him if their abilities allow him to exploit a weakness.

At the same time, Infinite Clash does not assume that Shadow's reputation or strongest attack automatically overrides another character's established abilities.

Every fight is determined by:

• Actual abilities
• Compatibility
• Resistances
• Speed
• Strategy
• Environment
• Stamina
• Injuries
• Information
• Tactical decisions
• AI behavior

NO PLOT ARMOR.
NO AUTOMATIC BLITZ.
NO AUTOMATIC I AM ATOMIC VICTORY.
NO CROSS-VERSE KNOWLEDGE.
NO PREDETERMINED WINNER.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
