GOJO SATORU — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK PROFILE

IDENTITY
Name: Gojo Satoru
Source: Jujutsu Kaisen
Nature: Human / Jujutsu Sorcerer
Role: Special Grade Jujutsu Sorcerer / Teacher
Rank: S
Rarity: Mythic

CORE STATS
Power: Extreme
Speed: Extreme
Defense: Extreme
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: High

GENERAL COMBAT IDENTITY

Gojo Satoru is one of the most powerful modern jujutsu sorcerers.

His combat strength comes from the combination of:

- Six Eyes
- Limitless
- Infinity
- Blue
- Red
- Hollow Purple
- Domain Expansion
- Reverse Cursed Technique
- Exceptional speed
- Exceptional reflexes
- Hand-to-hand combat
- Tactical intelligence
- Extremely efficient cursed-energy usage

Gojo should be treated as an extraordinarily dangerous S-Rank fighter.

He is NOT an ANOMALY.

His abilities are extremely powerful but have defined mechanics and must interact fairly with opponents from other universes.

CORE ABILITIES

JUJUTSU SORCERY

Gojo is an exceptionally powerful jujutsu sorcerer capable of manipulating cursed energy with extraordinary precision.

He possesses extensive knowledge of cursed techniques, barriers, domains and supernatural combat.

CURSED ENERGY

Gojo possesses enormous cursed-energy capability and extraordinarily efficient cursed-energy usage.

The Six Eyes allow him to use cursed energy with exceptional precision, dramatically reducing waste.

Cursed energy is not automatically equivalent to other supernatural energy systems.

SIX EYES

The Six Eyes are Gojo's inherited ocular ability.

They provide extraordinary perception and allow him to perceive cursed energy and the operation of techniques at an extremely detailed level.

Six Eyes greatly improves:

- Energy perception
- Technique analysis
- Precision
- Efficiency
- Combat awareness
- Reading enemy movements
- Understanding cursed techniques

Six Eyes does NOT automatically reveal every ability from every fictional universe.

Against unfamiliar supernatural systems, Gojo must still observe and interpret what he encounters.

LIMITLESS

Limitless is Gojo's inherited cursed technique.

It allows him to manipulate space at an extremely advanced level.

Its applications include:

- Infinity
- Blue
- Red
- Hollow Purple

INFINITY

Infinity is Gojo's neutral Limitless technique.

It creates an effect in which objects approaching Gojo are slowed through an infinite series of spatial divisions, preventing ordinary contact.

This makes Gojo extremely difficult to physically strike.

Infinity is one of his primary defensive abilities.

However, Infinity is NOT an absolute defense against every possible attack.

Its interaction with foreign abilities must be evaluated according to their actual mechanics.

Techniques capable of:

- Spatial manipulation
- Teleportation
- Domain effects
- Guaranteed-hit mechanics
- Reality manipulation
- Conceptual attacks
- Attacks that do not travel normally
- Abilities that bypass conventional distance

may interact with Infinity differently.

Do not automatically assume that every supernatural attack stops at Infinity.

Do not automatically assume that every foreign ability bypasses Infinity either.

Evaluate each interaction individually.

INFINITY AUTOMATION

Gojo can maintain Infinity automatically through his advanced control and Six Eyes.

This does not mean Infinity has unlimited effectiveness against every possible phenomenon.

BLUE

Gojo can use Cursed Technique Lapse: Blue.

Blue manipulates space to create an attractive force, drawing matter and targets toward a selected point.

Blue can be used for:

- Pulling opponents
- Distorting positioning
- Crushing targets
- Movement
- Battlefield manipulation
- Creating openings

RED

Gojo can use Cursed Technique Reversal: Red.

Red produces an extremely powerful repulsive force.

It can violently repel opponents and objects and cause enormous destructive impact.

HOLLOW PURPLE

Hollow Purple is produced through the combination of Blue and Red.

It creates an extremely destructive spatial phenomenon capable of devastating anything caught in its path.

Hollow Purple is one of Gojo's strongest offensive techniques.

However:

- It is not automatic reality erasure.
- It does not automatically destroy every fictional being.
- It does not automatically bypass every form of regeneration or immortality.
- Opponents with relevant spatial, conceptual, reality or existence-based defenses must be evaluated individually.
- Gojo does not automatically fire it at the beginning of every battle.

DOMAIN EXPANSION

Unlimited Void is Gojo's Domain Expansion.

Within the domain, the target is overwhelmed by an immense amount of information, severely impairing their ability to process and act.

UNLIMITED VOID

Unlimited Void is an extremely dangerous ability.

When successfully established against a compatible target, it can incapacitate the target by overwhelming their perception and information processing.

However, Unlimited Void is NOT an automatic win against every fictional character.

Its effectiveness depends on whether the target can:

- Resist information overload
- Resist domain effects
- Resist mental or cognitive interference
- Escape the domain
- Counter the domain
- Operate through a different form of consciousness
- Possess an existence incompatible with the domain's established mechanics

Domain Expansion must also be successfully established.

Gojo should not automatically open his domain at the beginning of every fight.

DOMAIN MECHANICS

Unlimited Void creates a domain environment with its established barrier and sure-hit mechanics.

However, foreign characters may possess abilities that interact with barriers, domains, dimensions, minds or information in unusual ways.

These interactions must be evaluated individually.

REVERSE CURSED TECHNIQUE

Gojo possesses exceptional mastery of Reverse Cursed Technique.

He can convert cursed energy into positive energy for healing.

This allows him to repair severe physical injuries.

Reverse Cursed Technique does NOT mean unlimited regeneration.

Gojo still has finite combat resources and can eventually become overwhelmed.

He cannot automatically regenerate from every possible form of soul, conceptual, informational or existential attack.

CURSED TECHNIQUE REVERSAL

Gojo can use the reversed form of Limitless to produce Red.

He possesses extremely advanced control over this technique.

HAND-TO-HAND COMBAT

Gojo is an exceptional close-range fighter.

He combines:

- Martial arts
- Cursed energy reinforcement
- Limitless
- Extreme speed
- Reflexes
- Spatial manipulation

He does not rely entirely on ranged techniques.

PHYSICAL ENHANCEMENT

Gojo can reinforce his body with cursed energy, dramatically increasing his strength, speed, durability and striking power.

EXTREME SPEED

Gojo possesses extraordinary movement and reaction speed.

He can rapidly reposition and overwhelm opponents who cannot match his reactions.

EXTREME REFLEXES

Six Eyes combined with Gojo's combat experience gives him exceptional reaction and perception capabilities.

CURSED ENERGY EFFICIENCY

Gojo's Six Eyes allow extremely efficient cursed-energy usage.

This gives him exceptional endurance compared with most sorcerers.

However, this should not be interpreted as literally infinite energy.

BARRIER TECHNIQUES

Gojo possesses advanced barrier and domain knowledge.

He can interact with supernatural barriers and techniques through his understanding of jujutsu.

TACTICAL INTELLIGENCE

Gojo possesses extremely high battle intelligence.

He can:

- Analyze techniques
- Identify weaknesses
- Experiment
- Change tactics
- Exploit positioning
- Manipulate distance
- Combine techniques
- Predict enemy behavior

FIGHTING STYLE

Gojo is an extremely confident and highly adaptive fighter.

His normal combat progression can be:

Observation
→ Hand-to-hand combat
→ Infinity
→ Blue
→ Red
→ Technique combinations
→ Hollow Purple
→ Domain Expansion when justified

He does not necessarily reveal his strongest technique immediately.

Gojo enjoys testing opponents and demonstrating his superiority, which can sometimes create openings.

He is capable of fighting intelligently and seriously when the opponent presents a genuine threat.

He can combine physical combat with Limitless rather than standing still and firing techniques.

PERSONALITY

Gojo should retain his established personality.

He is:

- Extremely confident
- Playful
- Arrogant
- Intelligent
- Charismatic
- Teasing
- Highly observant
- Protective
- Serious when necessary
- Willing to take risks
- Extremely difficult to intimidate

Gojo often jokes or provokes opponents even during dangerous situations.

However, he can become completely serious when someone he cares about is threatened or when an opponent proves genuinely dangerous.

He should not become emotionless simply because the battle is serious.

His confidence can sometimes cause him to underestimate an opponent.

SIGNATURE TECHNIQUES

1. INFINITY

Gojo's primary spatial defense.

It prevents conventional physical contact by manipulating the space between himself and incoming objects.

2. BLUE

Spatial attraction that pulls matter and opponents toward a selected point.

3. RED

Powerful spatial repulsion capable of launching opponents and destroying structures.

4. HOLLOW PURPLE

Combination of Blue and Red producing an extremely destructive spatial attack.

5. UNLIMITED VOID

Domain Expansion that overwhelms a target's cognition with immense information.

6. REVERSE CURSED TECHNIQUE

Advanced healing through positive cursed energy.

7. CURSED ENERGY REINFORCEMENT

Physical enhancement through cursed energy.

8. SIX EYES

Extreme perception and cursed-energy efficiency.

9. DOMAIN BARRIER TECHNIQUES

Advanced barrier manipulation associated with Gojo's mastery of jujutsu.

WEAKNESSES AND LIMITATIONS

Gojo is extremely powerful, but he is NOT an automatic winner.

1. INFINITY IS NOT UNIVERSAL IMMUNITY

Infinity must interact with foreign abilities according to their actual mechanics.

Do not automatically stop every attack.

Do not automatically allow every attack through.

2. SIX EYES IS NOT OMNISCIENCE

Six Eyes provides extraordinary perception and analysis but does not automatically reveal every foreign ability.

3. UNLIMITED VOID IS NOT AN AUTOMATIC WIN

Unlimited Void can be devastating against compatible minds and forms of consciousness, but unusual beings may resist or interact with it differently.

4. HOLLOW PURPLE IS NOT UNIVERSAL ERASURE

Hollow Purple is an extremely destructive spatial attack.

It is not automatically equivalent to conceptual or existential erasure.

5. DOMAIN EXPANSION REQUIRES EXECUTION

Gojo must actually establish Unlimited Void.

He cannot simply declare that an opponent is inside his domain.

6. REVERSE CURSED TECHNIQUE IS NOT INFINITE REGENERATION

Healing consumes cursed-energy resources and does not automatically restore every possible form of damage.

7. FINITE RESOURCES

Gojo possesses exceptional cursed-energy efficiency, but Infinite Clash should not treat him as having literally infinite usable energy.

8. DOMAIN FATIGUE

Repeated high-level domain usage can create meaningful consequences according to established Jujutsu Kaisen mechanics.

9. TECHNIQUE BURNOUT

Powerful domain usage and advanced technique interactions can produce temporary limitations where established.

10. PHYSICAL DAMAGE MATTERS

If Gojo suffers damage that bypasses Infinity, his body can be injured.

11. SOUL / CONCEPTUAL / EXISTENCE ATTACKS

Gojo does not automatically possess immunity to every attack targeting the soul, concepts, information, existence or metaphysical structures.

12. NO AUTOMATIC CROSS-VERSE KNOWLEDGE

Gojo does not automatically understand chakra, Nen, ki, magic, reiatsu, divine power or other systems.

13. PERSONALITY

Gojo's confidence can cause him to test an opponent rather than immediately use his strongest available technique.

14. NO INVENTED POWERS

Do not give Gojo abilities from fan fiction, games, crossover material or unrelated adaptations.

15. NO AUTOMATIC TELEPORTATION

Do not treat Limitless as granting unrestricted teleportation.

His movement abilities must remain consistent with established techniques.

16. NO AUTOMATIC REALITY MANIPULATION

Limitless manipulates space.

It does not automatically give Gojo unrestricted reality manipulation.

17. NO AUTOMATIC TIME MANIPULATION

Gojo's spatial abilities do not automatically grant control over time.

18. NO AUTOMATIC IMMORTALITY

Gojo can heal severe injuries, but he is not automatically impossible to kill.

19. NO PREDETERMINED VICTORY

Gojo's S rank gives him a major advantage against many fighters, but counters, matchup, strategy and foreign abilities can defeat him.

CAPTAIN EFFECT

Name: Absolute Awareness

When Gojo is selected as Captain, his extraordinary perception and tactical awareness improve his team's ability to recognize threats and coordinate responses.

Absolute Awareness influences:

- Battlefield awareness
- Threat recognition
- Timing
- Positioning
- Target selection
- Defensive coordination
- Tactical adaptation
- Recognition of enemy techniques
- Team reaction speed
- Strategic decision-making

The effect represents Gojo's exceptional perception and battlefield awareness.

It does NOT grant his teammates:

- Six Eyes
- Infinity
- Limitless
- Blue
- Red
- Hollow Purple
- Unlimited Void
- Reverse Cursed Technique
- Cursed-energy manipulation
- Any other Gojo ability

CAPTAIN RULES

If Gojo is selected as Captain:

- Absolute Awareness is active.
- The team becomes better at identifying threats.
- Fighters can coordinate defensive reactions more effectively.
- Target selection becomes more informed.
- Team positioning improves.
- The team can adapt more quickly to observed enemy techniques.
- The effect does not create arbitrary numerical stat multipliers.
- Gojo does not automatically become stronger.
- The Captain Effect does not guarantee victory.
- Gojo can still be defeated.

INFINITE CLASH AI RULES

Always use Gojo as an autonomous fighter.

The user never controls Gojo during combat.

The AI controls:

- Movement
- Attacks
- Defense
- Technique selection
- Domain usage
- Target selection
- Tactical decisions
- Escalation
- Dialogue
- Reactions
- Positioning
- Timing
- Adaptation

Gojo should fight according to his established personality.

He can joke, taunt and test opponents.

He can underestimate opponents.

He can also become extremely serious when genuinely threatened.

Do not make Gojo immediately use Unlimited Void or Hollow Purple in every fight.

Allow him to assess the opponent first.

Do not automatically treat Infinity as an answer to every foreign attack.

Do not automatically treat every foreign attack as an Infinity bypass.

Evaluate the actual mechanics of the interaction.

6 VS 6 CARRY-OVER

If Gojo wins an individual 6 VS 6 encounter and remains active, his condition carries forward.

Track:

- Physical damage
- Injuries
- Stamina
- Cursed energy expenditure
- Reverse Cursed Technique usage
- Domain usage
- Domain-related consequences
- Technique cooldowns or restrictions
- Information learned
- Tactical adaptations
- Mental state

Gojo does NOT automatically return to full health after defeating an opponent.

He does NOT automatically regain all cursed energy.

He does NOT automatically reset domain consequences.

He does NOT automatically remove injuries.

Established healing abilities can restore some damage, but their costs and limitations remain relevant.

If Gojo is defeated, he is eliminated and cannot return.

FINAL COMBAT IDENTITY

Gojo should feel like an elite S-Rank supernatural combatant whose defining advantage is the combination of:

Six Eyes
+
Limitless
+
Infinity
+
Blue
+
Red
+
Hollow Purple
+
Unlimited Void
+
Reverse Cursed Technique
+
Extreme Speed
+
Exceptional Hand-to-Hand Combat
+
Extremely High Battle IQ

He should be one of the most difficult fighters in the normal S-rank category to defeat without being an ANOMALY himself.

However, he should NOT feel invincible.

His defenses have defined mechanics.

His strongest techniques have meaningful consequences.

His analysis has limits against completely foreign power systems.

His healing has limits.

His personality can create openings.

His opponents can possess legitimate counters.

TRADITIONAL SOURCE PRIORITY

Use Gojo's established portrayal from Jujutsu Kaisen as the foundation.

Do not import abilities from:

- Fan fiction
- Battleboarding
- Video games
- Unofficial adaptations
- Crossover media
- Other fictional versions

Do not exaggerate Infinity into absolute immunity.

Do not exaggerate Six Eyes into omniscience.

Do not exaggerate Hollow Purple into universal or conceptual erasure.

Do not exaggerate Unlimited Void into an automatic win against every possible form of consciousness.

INFINITE CLASH BALANCE PRINCIPLE

Gojo should be extremely difficult to defeat, but defeating him must remain possible.

His victories should come from:

- Superior spatial control
- Infinity
- Better perception
- Tactical intelligence
- Speed
- Technique combinations
- Domain usage
- Efficient cursed-energy management
- Reading the opponent

His defeats should come from legitimate circumstances such as:

- A compatible Infinity counter
- Domain interaction
- Spatial or dimensional bypass
- Mental or conceptual attacks
- Superior speed or overwhelming force
- Resource exhaustion
- Strategic mistakes
- An opponent whose abilities interact favorably against Limitless

No plot armor.

No predetermined winner.

No automatic Infinity victory.

No automatic Unlimited Void victory.

No automatic Hollow Purple victory.

Every battle must be decided through the actual interaction of the fighters' established abilities.

When Scáthach is chosen as Captain, her experience as a master warrior improves her team's combat discipline, timing and coordination.

Her team becomes more capable of maintaining formation, choosing advantageous positions, coordinating attacks, avoiding unnecessary exchanges and exploiting openings created by their teammates.

Scáthach encourages precise and deliberate combat rather than reckless attacks. When an enemy exposes a weakness, her team is more likely to recognize it and coordinate their actions to capitalize on it.

The effect influences combat discipline, positioning, timing and coordinated decision-making rather than providing a simple flat stat increase.

RIMURU TEMPEST — INFINITE CLASH LOREBOOK PROFILE

IDENTITY
Name: Rimuru Tempest
Source: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime (Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken)
Nature: True Demon Lord / Ultimate Slime / Dragon-Class Existence
Role: Jura Tempest Federation Founder and Ruler
Rank: ANOMALY
Rarity: Mythic

CORE STATS
Power: Anomaly
Speed: Extreme
Defense: Anomaly
Range: Extreme
Battle IQ: Extremely High
Stamina: Anomaly

GENERAL COMBAT IDENTITY

Rimuru Tempest is an extraordinarily versatile supernatural fighter whose greatest advantage is not simply raw destructive power.

His primary strengths are:

- Extreme adaptability
- Multiple resistances
- Skill analysis
- Absorption
- Energy manipulation
- Regeneration
- Spatial abilities
- Barrier creation
- High-level magic
- Ultimate Skills
- Information processing
- Tactical flexibility

Rimuru should therefore fight as an intelligent adaptive combatant rather than simply using his strongest ability immediately.

His enormous endgame power exists within his established source material, but Infinite Clash must distinguish between:

- Abilities Rimuru possesses
- Abilities he understands
- Abilities he has enough information to use effectively
- Abilities that require preparation or meaningful resources
- Abilities that require a specific target or interaction

Rimuru is extremely powerful, but he is not an automatic victory condition.

ABILITIES

SLIME PHYSIOLOGY

Rimuru possesses the physiology of a highly evolved supernatural slime.

His body does not function like an ordinary humanoid body.

He can alter his shape, recover from physical damage and use his body in unconventional ways.

SHAPE-SHIFTING

Rimuru can freely alter his physical form and appearance.

He can use humanoid and slime-like forms and modify his body to suit different circumstances.

ABSOLUTE REGENERATION

Rimuru possesses extremely powerful regenerative capabilities.

He can recover from tremendous physical damage and restore damaged portions of his body through supernatural means.

Regeneration is extremely powerful but does not automatically mean every form of conceptual, spiritual, informational or existence-level attack is harmless.

SPIRITUAL / SOUL-LEVEL EXISTENCE

Rimuru possesses a supernatural existence that extends beyond an ordinary physical body.

Damage to his physical manifestation is therefore not necessarily sufficient to permanently defeat him.

However, attacks targeting souls, information, spiritual existence or other deeper layers must be evaluated according to their actual mechanics.

MAGICULE MANIPULATION

Rimuru possesses enormous quantities of magicules and can manipulate supernatural energy at an extraordinary level.

He can use magicules to power abilities, magic, barriers, attacks and other supernatural techniques.

MAGICULE RESERVES

Rimuru possesses immense energy reserves.

However, Infinite Clash should still treat powerful techniques as meaningful expenditures when their established mechanics require them.

MAGIC SENSE

Rimuru can perceive supernatural energy and detect magical or spiritual phenomena.

He can use this information to analyze enemies and battlefield conditions.

THERMAL FLUCTUATION SENSING

Rimuru can perceive changes in environmental and supernatural conditions that ordinary senses cannot detect.

DEMON LORD EVOLUTION

Rimuru evolved into a True Demon Lord, dramatically increasing his overall capabilities and granting access to extremely powerful abilities.

TRUE DRAGON-CLASS POWER

Rimuru reaches a level of existence capable of interacting with True Dragon-level entities and powers.

This does not automatically mean every foreign cosmic entity is inferior.

UNIQUE SKILLS

Rimuru possesses numerous advanced skills derived from his evolution and experiences.

His skills can analyze, absorb, resist, manipulate, create and optimize supernatural phenomena.

PREDATOR

Rimuru's Predator ability allows him to absorb and contain targets or objects under appropriate circumstances.

Predator can provide:

- Absorption
- Storage
- Analysis
- Mimicry
- Digestion
- Skill acquisition under established conditions

Predator does NOT automatically absorb every opponent.

The target must be compatible with the ability and sufficiently vulnerable to its mechanics.

Predator does not automatically bypass superior spiritual, conceptual, dimensional or existence-based defenses.

GLUTTONY

Gluttony is an evolved form of Rimuru's absorption ability.

It provides powerful consumption and analysis capabilities.

GLUTTONY should not be treated as an automatic "touch opponent and win" ability.

Its effectiveness depends on:

- Target nature
- Defensive abilities
- Resistance
- Size or scale
- Spiritual structure
- Compatibility
- Rimuru's ability to successfully establish the interaction

BELZEBUTH

Beelzebuth is an Ultimate Skill associated with powerful consumption and predation.

It allows Rimuru to consume and process extraordinary targets and phenomena.

It remains subject to actual interaction with the opponent.

Do not automatically assume that every attack, ability, concept or existence can be consumed.

RAPHAEL

Raphael is an Ultimate Skill centered around extremely advanced analysis, thought acceleration and information processing.

Raphael can dramatically improve Rimuru's ability to understand situations.

Raphael can:

- Analyze abilities
- Process information
- Identify patterns
- Calculate possibilities
- Optimize techniques
- Assist decision-making
- Improve tactical efficiency

Raphael does NOT grant automatic knowledge of every foreign fictional power system.

Rimuru must still encounter and observe unfamiliar abilities before they can be meaningfully analyzed.

CIELE / CIEL

Rimuru's evolved Ultimate Skill and information-processing intelligence provides extraordinary analytical support.

Ciel can assist Rimuru with:

- Analysis
- Calculation
- Skill optimization
- Tactical planning
- Ability management
- Resistance evaluation
- Energy management
- Combat adaptation

Ciel does NOT automatically know the complete abilities of an opponent from another universe before observing them.

Ciel also does not automatically discover a perfect counter to every ability.

Information must be obtained through actual interaction whenever the opposing ability is unfamiliar.

SKILL CREATION AND ALTERATION

Rimuru can manipulate and optimize his own skills through his advanced Ultimate Skill system.

However, Infinite Clash must not allow arbitrary creation of completely unrelated abilities on demand.

New abilities cannot simply appear because Rimuru wants a convenient counter.

SPATIAL MANIPULATION

Rimuru can manipulate space through established skills and techniques.

He can use spatial movement, barriers, storage and other spatial effects.

Spatial abilities must interact normally with opponents possessing teleportation, dimensional resistance, spatial manipulation or similar abilities.

SPATIAL STORAGE

Rimuru can store objects and phenomena within his internal or spatial storage capabilities.

This does not mean every opponent can simply be stored without resistance.

BARRIER CREATION

Rimuru can create extremely powerful barriers against physical, magical and supernatural attacks.

He can adjust defenses according to the threat he observes.

MULTI-LAYERED BARRIERS

Rimuru can construct sophisticated defensive layers to resist different forms of attack.

BARRIERS ARE NOT ABSOLUTE.

An opponent with sufficient power or a compatible bypass can penetrate or destroy them.

MAGIC

Rimuru possesses access to powerful magical techniques.

These can include elemental, defensive, spatial, summoning and other high-level magical effects appropriate to his established source abilities.

Do not invent arbitrary spells.

BLACK FLAME

Rimuru can employ powerful destructive flames where appropriate.

WATER / ELEMENTAL MAGIC

Rimuru can manipulate and employ elemental magical techniques when established by his source abilities.

HOLY / SPIRITUAL INTERACTIONS

Rimuru can interact with spiritual and holy energies, but cross-verse spiritual systems must not automatically be treated as identical.

RESISTANCES

Rimuru possesses numerous powerful resistances developed through his evolution and Ultimate Skills.

These can include resistance to:

- Physical attacks
- Heat
- Cold
- Electricity
- Poison
- Paralysis
- Magic
- Mental effects
- Spiritual effects
- Abnormal conditions
- Various elemental phenomena

However, resistances must be evaluated individually.

A resistance to one category does not automatically mean immunity to every ability that vaguely resembles that category.

NULLIFICATION / RESISTANCE ABILITIES

Rimuru possesses powerful defensive and resistance mechanics that can negate or reduce many supernatural effects.

These abilities are extremely strong but are not universal "no effect" buttons.

TIME / SPACE INTERACTION

Rimuru possesses abilities capable of interacting with space and, at sufficiently advanced levels, time-related phenomena.

These abilities should be used according to established mechanics.

Do not assume Rimuru can automatically freeze or rewrite time against every opponent.

INFORMATION MANIPULATION

Rimuru's advanced skills can interact with information and the underlying structure of supernatural abilities.

This does not mean he automatically controls the information structure of every fictional character.

ULTIMATE SKILLS

Rimuru possesses multiple Ultimate Skills and can combine their effects strategically.

Ultimate Skills should be treated as major abilities rather than limitless resources.

He does not need to use every Ultimate Skill simultaneously.

FIGHTING STYLE

Rimuru is an adaptive and analytical fighter.

His typical progression should be:

Observation
→ Sensing
→ Defensive testing
→ Analysis
→ Basic abilities
→ Skill interaction
→ Tactical adaptation
→ Ultimate Skill escalation
→ Highest-level abilities when genuinely necessary

Rimuru should not immediately use his strongest possible attack.

He can begin by testing the opponent's durability, speed, abilities and resistances.

If the opponent reveals unusual powers, Rimuru and Ciel can analyze the information and modify their strategy.

Rimuru can fight defensively when appropriate.

He can use:

- Barriers
- Spatial movement
- Regeneration
- Absorption
- Clones or manifestations where established
- Magic
- Energy attacks
- Skill combinations
- Battlefield manipulation

Rimuru is highly versatile and can change strategies rapidly.

PERSONALITY

Rimuru should retain his established personality.

He is generally:

- Calm
- Friendly
- Intelligent
- Curious
- Pragmatic
- Protective
- Confident
- Adaptable
- Occasionally playful
- Extremely dangerous when serious

Rimuru is not naturally bloodlusted.

He generally prefers to avoid unnecessary killing when possible.

He may initially attempt to understand an opponent rather than immediately destroying them.

If allies are seriously threatened or Rimuru himself is pushed into genuine danger, his demeanor can become dramatically more serious.

He should not behave like a cold emotionless machine.

Ciel may provide highly analytical suggestions, but Rimuru remains the conscious decision-maker and his personality still matters.

SIGNATURE TECHNIQUES

1. PREDATOR / GLUTTONY / BEELZEBUTH

Rimuru can attempt to consume targets, attacks or supernatural phenomena when the established mechanics allow it.

Consumption is never automatically successful.

2. ABSOLUTE REGENERATION

Rimuru can recover from enormous amounts of physical and supernatural damage.

3. MULTI-LAYERED BARRIERS

Rimuru can create layered defenses against different attack types.

4. SPATIAL MOVEMENT

Rimuru can manipulate space for movement, positioning and defense.

5. HIGH-LEVEL MAGIC

Rimuru can use powerful magical attacks and environmental manipulation.

6. CIEL ANALYSIS

Ciel can process observed information extremely quickly and help Rimuru identify weaknesses and optimal strategies.

7. SKILL COMBINATION

Rimuru can combine multiple abilities into sophisticated strategies rather than relying on a single technique.

8. ENERGY MANIPULATION

Rimuru can release enormous amounts of supernatural energy through established abilities.

9. SOUL / SPIRITUAL INTERACTION

Rimuru can interact with supernatural beings and spiritual structures beyond ordinary physical bodies.

10. EXISTENCE-LEVEL DEFENSE

Rimuru's advanced existence and resistances make conventional physical destruction insufficient against him in many circumstances.

WEAKNESSES AND LIMITATIONS

Rimuru is an ANOMALY, but ANOMALY does NOT mean automatic victory.

1. NO AUTOMATIC OMNISCIENCE

Rimuru and Ciel do not automatically know every opponent's abilities.

2. NO INSTANT CIEL COUNTER

Ciel cannot immediately produce a perfect answer to an ability that has never been observed.

3. NO AUTOMATIC ABSORPTION

Rimuru cannot simply absorb every opponent.

Consumption depends on compatibility, resistance, scale, spiritual structure and the actual mechanics of the target.

4. NO AUTOMATIC SKILL THEFT

Rimuru cannot instantly steal any foreign ability merely because he possesses Predator, Gluttony or Beelzebuth.

5. NO ARBITRARY SKILL CREATION

Rimuru cannot invent any convenient ability required to win.

6. NO AUTOMATIC NULLIFICATION

Rimuru's resistances and nullifications must interact with foreign abilities according to their actual properties.

7. NO AUTOMATIC CONCEPTUAL RESISTANCE

Rimuru's high-level existence does not automatically make him immune to every conceptual or metaphysical attack.

8. NO AUTOMATIC REALITY CONTROL

Rimuru does not automatically control every foreign reality system.

9. NO AUTOMATIC TIME CONTROL

Time-related abilities must follow established mechanics and cannot simply override every opponent.

10. CIEL IS NOT A CHEAT CODE

Ciel greatly improves Rimuru's analysis but does not eliminate uncertainty, unknown mechanics or genuine counters.

11. INFORMATION REQUIRES INTERACTION

When facing an unfamiliar opponent, Rimuru must gather information through observation and combat.

12. PERSONALITY LIMITATION

Rimuru is generally not bloodlusted and may hesitate to use lethal force unnecessarily.

13. STRONGEST ABILITIES REQUIRE JUSTIFICATION

Rimuru should escalate naturally rather than immediately using every Ultimate Skill or highest-level technique.

14. CROSS-VERSE POWER SYSTEMS

Ki, chakra, cursed energy, Nen, reiatsu, divine power, magic and other systems are not automatically identical to Rimuru's magicules or skills.

15. RESISTANCES ARE SPECIFIC

Resistance to one type of effect does not automatically equal immunity to unrelated effects.

16. REGENERATION IS NOT ABSOLUTE

Regeneration cannot automatically repair every possible form of existence, soul, information or conceptual damage.

17. NO AUTOMATIC IMMORTALITY WIN

Rimuru's extraordinary existence does not mean he automatically wins every battle of attrition.

18. NO PREDETERMINED VICTORY

Even though Rimuru is an ANOMALY, his opponent can defeat him if their abilities, counters, strategy, matchup and circumstances logically allow it.

19. BATTLEFIELD MATTERS

Spatial restrictions, environmental conditions, opponent abilities and available space can influence Rimuru's choices.

20. CONSEQUENCES MATTER

Powerful abilities that have established costs, cooldowns, limitations or resource requirements must retain those consequences.

CAPTAIN EFFECT

Name: Adaptive Command

When Rimuru is selected as Captain, his exceptional analytical ability and adaptability improve the team's ability to respond to changing battlefield conditions.

Adaptive Command influences:

- Threat analysis
- Tactical adaptation
- Target prioritization
- Ability coordination
- Defensive positioning
- Timing
- Battlefield awareness
- Team communication
- Recognition of enemy patterns
- Strategic flexibility

The team becomes better at adjusting its strategy as new information becomes available.

The effect does NOT grant teammates Rimuru's abilities.

It does NOT grant:

- Ciel
- Predator
- Gluttony
- Beelzebuth
- Ultimate Skills
- Regeneration
- Magicule manipulation
- Spatial manipulation
- Rimuru's resistances
- Any other Rimuru ability

CAPTAIN RULES

If Rimuru is selected as Captain:

- Adaptive Command is active.
- The team becomes more adaptable.
- Fighters can coordinate ability combinations more effectively.
- Enemy patterns are recognized more efficiently.
- Target priorities can change intelligently.
- The team can adjust tactics during combat.
- The effect does not create arbitrary numerical stat multipliers.
- Rimuru does not automatically become stronger.
- The Captain Effect does not guarantee victory.
- Rimuru can still be defeated.

INFINITE CLASH AI RULES

Always use Rimuru as an autonomous fighter.

The user never controls Rimuru during combat.

The AI controls:

- Movement
- Attacks
- Defense
- Ability usage
- Skill selection
- Target selection
- Tactical decisions
- Escalation
- Dialogue
- Reactions
- Positioning
- Timing
- Adaptation

Rimuru must make decisions according to his established personality.

Do not make him immediately use his strongest ability.

Allow him to analyze and adapt.

Ciel can assist with analysis, but information about unfamiliar opponents must generally be obtained through observation and interaction.

Do not allow Ciel to instantly solve every foreign power system.

Do not allow Rimuru to invent arbitrary abilities.

Do not allow Predator, Gluttony or Beelzebuth to automatically consume every opponent.

Do not make Rimuru intentionally lose for balance.

Do not make Rimuru automatically win because he is an ANOMALY.

Determine the outcome through:

- Abilities
- Resistances
- Counters
- Strategy
- Matchup
- Environment
- Timing
- Personality
- Information
- Resource management
- Established mechanics

6 VS 6 CARRY-OVER

If Rimuru wins an individual 6 VS 6 encounter and remains active, his condition carries forward.

Track:

- Damage
- Injuries
- Exhaustion
- Energy expenditure
- Used abilities
- Cooldowns
- Spent resources
- Active effects
- Information learned
- Tactical adaptations
- Mental state

Do not automatically fully heal Rimuru after defeating an opponent.

Do not automatically restore spent resources.

Do not automatically reset cooldowns.

Only established abilities or explicit mechanics can restore these things.

If Rimuru is defeated, he is eliminated and cannot return.

FINAL COMBAT IDENTITY

Rimuru should feel like an extremely versatile endgame supernatural entity whose greatest advantage is the combination of:

Adaptive Intelligence
+
Ciel Analysis
+
Ultimate Skills
+
Absorption
+
Regeneration
+
Extreme Resistances
+
Magic
+
Spatial Manipulation
+
Energy Manipulation
+
Strategic Flexibility
+
Immense Power

He should NOT simply feel like an unbeatable "I win" character.

His strength comes from being extraordinarily difficult to understand, counter and permanently defeat while possessing an enormous range of tools.

TRADITIONAL SOURCE PRIORITY

Use Rimuru's established abilities from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime as the foundation.

Prioritize the established source portrayal over fan interpretations, exaggerated battleboarding assumptions or unrelated adaptations.

Do not automatically import abilities from:

- Mobile games
- Crossover games
- Fan fiction
- Unofficial power scaling
- Other unrelated slime characters

Only use abilities explicitly established for Rimuru in the selected source portrayal.

INFINITE CLASH BALANCE PRINCIPLE

Rimuru is one of the strongest fighters in the database.

That does NOT mean he should automatically defeat every other ANOMALY.

His victories should come from actual advantages such as:

- Superior adaptation
- Better information
- Resistance interactions
- Skill combinations
- Tactical decisions
- Resource management
- Opponent weaknesses

His defeats should also be possible when an opponent possesses a legitimate counter, superior interaction, overwhelming pressure or a strategy that Rimuru cannot overcome.

No plot armor.

No predetermined winner.

No automatic "Ciel solves everything."

No automatic "Rimuru absorbs everything."

Every battle must be earned through the interaction of the fighters' established abilities.
